name: Creality K1 CFS extruder tube fix
description: This is a fix for the PTFE tube not staying in the extruder when the teeth break on the fitting. Creality molds the fitting into the extruder housing so the only option is replace the whole extruder. With this fix you remove the black plastic push button and clip this piece in.
details:
Remove black cap/button on extruder that you would push to remove PTFE tube.
Remove the star teeth that held the tube in place and make sure you get it all out or it will get into the extruder and ruin it.
Insert FIX into extruder it should click in, insert screw on top and snug up to hold PTFE tube.
I printed in PETG to keep from warping from heat so far so good. I would not recoment PLA. Printed upside down on plat top with a brim.

name: SapoLAB_DIY EgiBox - Emergency Eging Kit
description:
EgiBox is a small and compact spool and box that fits in the pocket, and contains the egi bait itself and the wire, all ready to fish.
EgiBox it's tought to be a "all you need" kit for eging, for those times when you want to cast a egi, but you don''t have all your equipment with you!
keep it in the car, in the bag, or in the pocket. 
Have you Egibox always at hand, ready to cast!
Or just use it for convenience 😉


compatible with SapoLAB Egis Vol.2,3,4.

Features:
Ergonomic design.
Printinplace opening lid to keep your egi safe and secure.
Point and launch spool shape.
Hole for fixing the start of the wire.
Lateral cuts to fix the end of the wire before parking the egi.
Keychain holes.
Parking tracks to use as stand to display your egi.
Flat base to use it as display for your special egis.
Can be customized with your own text (ask a quote).

Instructions:
Wrap 20 or more meters of wire to the top half (see the limit markers on the sides)
Knot a egi bait to the end of the line

Usage:
Easy safe way is to unwrap the line on the ground and manually launch and slowly recover the egi 
My way, hold the line with 2 fingers, 1 meter from the egi, spin the egi on your side, keep your first finger on the top wire turn on the spool, so the line starts to unwrap from the top,  allign the top of the egibox to face the direction of the launch, release the spinning line from the fingers. be carefull!!

description:

Son utilisation principale est de servir de conduit de fluide (eau, air, câble), de liaison structurelle rigide (tige, barre) ou de guide d'axe long dans un mécanisme. Dans les systèmes mécaniques, il peut servir de support d'entretoise long ou de tube de protection pour des composants plus petits. On le retrouve dans les châssis de machines, les systèmes de tuyauterie, les imprimantes 3D (pour les guides de mouvement) et la robotique pour les bras longs.

name: CHANGEUR D’OBJECTIF DE REMPLACEMENT  MANTIS ELITE V2  RÉFÉRENCE 202-B0445 - Vision Engineering
description:
CHANGEUR D’OBJECTIF DE REMPLACEMENT POUR VISION ENGINEERING MANTIS ELITE V2

Cette pièce est une monture de remplacement compatible avec le changeur d’objectif du microscope stéréoscopique sans oculaire Vision Engineering Mantis Elite Version 2.

Elle remplace la pièce d’origine portant la référence constructeur :

202-B0445

Cette pièce est également désignée par certains distributeurs comme :

• changeur d’objectif ;

• tourelle d’objectifs ;

• support de lentilles ;

• Lens Changer ;

• Turret Assembly ;

• référence MET-445.

Le changeur permet de maintenir deux objectifs et de passer rapidement d’un grossissement à l’autre par rotation de la tourelle.

UTILISATION

Cette pièce est destinée à remplacer une monture d’origine cassée, fissurée ou devenue inutilisable.

Elle permet de réutiliser les objectifs, la visserie et les éléments de fixation d’origine du Mantis Elite.

Le téléchargement comprend uniquement le fichier de la pièce imprimable.

Le microscope, les objectifs, les vis, les écrous et les autres accessoires visibles sur les photographies ne sont pas inclus.

CARACTÉRISTIQUES

• Compatible avec le Vision Engineering Mantis Elite Version 2.

• Référence de la pièce d’origine : 202-B0445.

• Permet le montage de deux objectifs Mantis Elite.

• Rotation permettant de sélectionner rapidement l’objectif souhaité.

• Conception monobloc.

• Compatible avec l’impression FDM en PETG.

• Compatible avec l’impression SLS en PA12.

• Pièce fonctionnelle destinée à la réparation d’un équipement professionnel.

• Dimensions du modèle : 130,1 × 67,8 × 33,7 mm.

• Impression à l’échelle 100 % recommandée.

CONTENU DU TÉLÉCHARGEMENT

• Un fichier STL : Mantis Elite Lens Changer.STL

• Dimensions : 130,1 × 67,8 × 33,7 mm

Le fichier doit être imprimé sans modification d’échelle afin de conserver le positionnement des objectifs et les dimensions des clips.
details:
Matériau recommandé : PETG

Hauteur de couche recommandée : 0,15 à 0,20 mm

Diamètre de buse : 0,4 mm

Nombre de périmètres : au moins 5

Remplissage : 40 à 60 %

Supports : nécessaires

Orientation : respecter l’orientation présentée sur les photographies du plateau d’impression.

Échelle : 100 %

Après impression, retirer soigneusement les supports et nettoyer les surfaces recevant les objectifs, les clips et les éléments de fixation.

IMPRESSION SLS

Le modèle a également été imprimé avec succès en PA12 sur une imprimante Formlabs Fuse 1.

Pour une pièce professionnelle durable, l’impression SLS en PA12 constitue une excellente solution grâce à sa précision, sa résistance mécanique et sa bonne tenue en fatigue.

Paramètres de l’impression réalisée par un utilisateur :

• matériau : PA12 ;

• remplissage : pièce pleine ;

• résolution : 0,11 mm ;

• masse de poudre utilisée : environ 43 g ;

• durée d’impression observée : environ 4 heures.

CHOIX DU MATÉRIAU

PETG

Convient pour une impression FDM classique. Il offre une meilleure résistance aux chocs et à la fatigue que le PLA.

PA12

Recommandé pour obtenir une pièce plus proche d’une pièce technique industrielle. Le PA12 présente une bonne résistance mécanique et une légère flexibilité adaptée aux clips de maintien.

PLA

Déconseillé pour une utilisation professionnelle prolongée, car les clips peuvent être plus cassants et se déformer ou se fissurer avec les manipulations répétées.

Résine

Utiliser uniquement une résine technique résistante aux chocs. Les résines standards peuvent être trop cassantes pour les clips et les zones soumises à des efforts.

MONTAGE

Retirer soigneusement la monture endommagée du Mantis Elite.
Récupérer la visserie, l’écrou et les éléments de fixation d’origine.
Nettoyer la pièce imprimée et vérifier que tous les supports ont été retirés.
Vérifier que l’écrou est complètement inséré dans son logement et qu’il ne dépasse pas de la surface arrière.
Installer les objectifs sans forcer sur les lentilles ni sur les clips.
Vérifier que chaque objectif est correctement maintenu et centré.
Installer le changeur dans le microscope.
Effectuer plusieurs rotations manuelles afin de vérifier l’absence de frottement ou de point dur.
Contrôler l’alignement optique avec les deux objectifs avant une utilisation régulière.

PRÉCAUTIONS

Les objectifs du Mantis Elite sont des composants optiques coûteux. Vérifiez soigneusement leur maintien avant de remettre le microscope en service.

Ne forcez jamais un objectif dans son logement.

Si un clip est fissuré, déformé ou insuffisamment rigide, n’utilisez pas la pièce.

Un filament PETG classique n’est pas nécessairement dissipatif ESD. Pour une utilisation dans une zone protégée contre les décharges électrostatiques, utilisez un matériau compatible ESD et validez la pièce selon les procédures de votre atelier.

COMPATIBILITÉ

Cette pièce a été conçue pour le Mantis Elite Version 2.

Avant l’impression, comparez la référence de votre pièce d’origine avec la référence 202-B0445.

La compatibilité avec les autres générations de Mantis, notamment Mantis Compact, Mantis PIXO ou d’anciennes versions du Mantis Elite, n’est pas garantie.

MARQUE

Vision Engineering et Mantis Elite sont des marques appartenant à leurs propriétaires respectifs.

Ces noms sont cités uniquement pour indiquer la destination et la compatibilité de cette pièce de remplacement.

Ce modèle n’est ni fabriqué, ni approuvé, ni sponsorisé par Vision Engineering.

LICENCE

Ce modèle est destiné exclusivement à un usage personnel.

La redistribution, le partage, la mise en ligne ou la revente du fichier numérique est interdite.

La vente des objets physiques imprimés à partir de ce fichier n’est pas autorisée par la licence standard.

name: AIR VOLUME NOZZLE AMPLIFIER (DCBL722B)
description:
**AIR VOLUME NOZZLE AMPLIFIER FOR DCBL722B **

**GO FROM 350 CFM TO 750 CFM WITH THE SAME TOOL


Do you know the Venturi effect? It’s a physical principle that creates suction through openings positioned perpendicular to the movement of a fluid — linear air flow inside a cylindrical shape! The faster the air moves, the stronger the suction!
The original blower generates approximately 350 CFM (Cubic Feet per Minute) based on the diameter of its tube and the air velocity produced by the motor. The nozzle, however, with its doubled diameter (compared to the tool’s original tube), generates the Venturi effect and, through its side openings, produces over 740 CFM.
The velocity generated by the tool’s motor, combined with the installed nozzle, creates air suction through its 10 trapezoidal openings around it, thus increasing the total air volume (CFM) output.

-Very easy to install
- Easy to print


Thank for your trust !

name: Tow Hook Hole Cover for Nissan Micra K11
description:
Description

Tow Hook Hole Cover for Nissan Micra K11

This 3D-printed cover is designed to fit the tow hook opening of the Nissan Micra K11.
It was modeled based on a 3D scan of the actual hole, ensuring a precise and secure fit, though the shape differs slightly from the original factory part.

The piece is designed to snap in place without screws or glue, which makes for a clean installation — but may make removal more difficult. For a smoother fit, light sanding of the clips may be required.

The tow hook fits perfectly through the central opening, which has been redesigned to look more discreet and visually integrated than the OEM version.

Designed in Fusion 360, optimized for easy printing and durability.

Note:

Two versions of the tow hook cover are included:

Version A: With a precisely sized hole for the tow hook — ready to use without any modification.

Version B: Designed to completely remove the tow hook and store it inside the vehicle. This version has a smooth, continuous surface that perfectly follows the bumper’s original lines, providing a clean and seamless look.


---------------------------------------------------------------------


Descripción

Tapa del agujero del gancho de remolque para Nissan Micra K11

Tapa impresa en 3D diseñada para cubrir el agujero del gancho de remolque del Nissan Micra K11.
Se ha modelado a partir de un escaneo 3D del hueco real, lo que garantiza un ajuste preciso y firme, aunque el diseño difiere ligeramente de la pieza original.

Está pensada para encajar a presión, sin tornillos ni pegamento, ofreciendo una instalación limpia. Sin embargo, esto puede hacer que la extracción sea algo más difícil; si se desea un ajuste más suave, puede ser necesario limar ligeramente las sujeciones.

El gancho de remolque entra perfectamente en el orificio, que ha sido rediseñado para ser más discreto y estético que el de la versión original.

Diseñada en Fusion 360, lista para imprimir y montar fácilmente.

Nota:

Se incluyen dos versiones de la tapa del gancho de remolque:

Versión A: Con el agujero ajustado al gancho de remolque, lista para usar sin modificaciones.

Versión B: Pensada para eliminar el gancho y guardarlo dentro del vehículo. Esta versión presenta un acabado liso y continuo, que sigue perfectamente la línea original del paragolpes, ofreciendo un aspecto limpio y uniforme.
details:
Intended use: Exterior car part — tow hook hole cover (exposed to sunlight, rain, and heat).

Recommended material:

ASA → Best for outdoor use; UV and heat resistant (up to ~95 °C).

Alternatives:

PETG → UV-resistant and easy to print.

ABS → Good heat resistance, but needs UV protection (paint or clear coat).

Suggested print settings:

Layer height: 0.16 – 0.2 mm (for smooth surface finish).

Infill: 20 – 30 % (grid or gyroid).

Walls: 3 – 4 (for strength and fit).

Nozzle temperature:

ASA: 245 – 255 °C

PETG: 235 – 245 °C

ABS: 240 – 250 °C

Bed temperature:

ASA / ABS: 90 – 100 °C

PETG: 70 – 80 °C

Cooling fan:

ASA / ABS: off or ≤20 %

PETG: 40 – 50 %

Bed adhesion: PEI surface, Kapton tape, or Magigoo adhesive.

Post-processing and fitting:

If the fit is too tight, lightly sand the clips to achieve the desired adjustment.

Apply UV-protective paint or clear coat for long-term outdoor durability.

No screws or glue needed — the piece snaps securely into place.



Uso previsto: Exterior del vehículo — tapa del agujero del gancho de remolque (exposición a sol, lluvia y calor).

Material recomendado:

ASA → Ideal para exteriores. Alta resistencia a los rayos UV y al calor (hasta ~95 °C).

Alternativas:

PETG → Buena resistencia al sol y fácil de imprimir.

ABS → Resistente al calor, pero requiere protección UV (pintura o barniz).

Configuración de impresión sugerida:

Altura de capa: 0.16 – 0.2 mm (para mejor acabado superficial).

Infill / Relleno: 20 – 30 % (tipo “grid” o “gyroid”).

Perímetros / Paredes: 3 – 4 (para dar rigidez).

Temperatura de boquilla:

ASA: 245 – 255 °C

PETG: 235 – 245 °C

ABS: 240 – 250 °C

Temperatura de cama:

ASA / ABS: 90 – 100 °C

PETG: 70 – 80 °C

Ventilador de capa:

ASA / ABS: apagado o máximo 20 %

PETG: 40 – 50 %

Adhesión: superficie PEI, cinta Kapton o adhesivo tipo Magigoo.

Post-procesado y ajuste:

Si el encaje resulta demasiado firme, lima suavemente las sujeciones hasta lograr el ajuste deseado.

Se recomienda aplicar una capa de pintura o barniz UV para proteger del sol y mejorar el acabado.

No requiere tornillos ni pegamento: encaja a presión en el hueco original.

name: Losi NASCAR Pit Box Chassis (for HD Ridgid 1.0 Toolbox)
description:
Update: There is now a version for the Gen 2.0 Ridgid toolbox.  Link can be found here:
https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/tool/losi-nascar-pit-box-chassis-for-hd-ridgid-2-0-toolbox

I was tired of having all my tools and support equipment for my 1/12 Losi NASCAR rolling in a bag so I decided to design this pit box chassis to hold all my batteries, controller, and misc. parts.  It is modular so you can swap componets as you need.  I plan to add more modules as the system advances.  

There are two versions of the tire holder.  One for one set of tires and one for two sets of tires.  It is designed for the standard Losi set that comes with the vehicle. 

This was designed for the Gen. 1.0 Home Depot 22" toolbox 
https://www.ridgid.com/us/en/22-in-pro-tool-box-black

THIS WILL NOT FIT THE UPDATED 2.0 TOOLBOX

The battery holder can accompodate the original Spektrum battery and the Gens Ace 7.4v 35c 2s 2300mAh battery as well (GEA232S35E2GT). 
https://www.horizonhobby.com/product/gens-ace-2300mah-2s-35c-7.4v-g-tech-lipo-battery-pack-with-ec2-plug/GEA232S35E2GT.html

The LiPo checker holder is designed for a generic Lipo checker. 
https://www.amazon.com/HobbyFly-Digital-Capacity-Balancer-Discharger/dp/B08X718GJP
details:
You will need a larger printer (Creality K1 Max) to print off the main chassis components.  Everything else can be printed on an X1C sized bed.  

You will need to print off the following number of components:
x1 of all the chassis parts
x4 of the 24 Support Posts
x2 of the 20 Support Posts
x4 Chassis Connectors (there are two versions, one that is standard and one that requires heat set inserts)
x4 of the Wheel Holders
x1 of all of the accessory holders


This thing takes A LOT of screws.  65 to be exact.
x3 for LiPo Checker holder
x4 for Tire Carrier
x4 for Battery Carrier
x8 for SLT2 Carrier
x4 for Compressed Air Carrier
x4 for Storage Holder
x16 for Wheel Holders
x6 for Support Posts
x16 for Chassis Connectors

All of the screws are M3x12 contersunk screws. 

Everything can be printed out of PLA or PETG with 2 walls and 20% infill.  

Notes:
Assembly is pretty straight forward.  There are two versions of the Support Posts (20 &24).  These will only fit in their respective holes.  The 24's are placed in the corners and the 20"s are placed in the middle.  I have included a picture of the assembly.  

Disclaimer:
Tolerances and fitment can vary printer to printer.
Be carefull screwing things in.  You are screwing into plastic and can easilly strip out the holes for the parts. 
This was tested for a Gen. 1 Home Depot Ridgid 22" Tool box.  I know there is a 2.0 version but I havent gotten a chance to test fit it yet.

name: 3.50 Inch Pie Cut Jigs 9 & 15 Degree
description:
This kit is cutting straight tube into pie cut sections to then make custom bends for those tight and intricate jobs, or to show off your skills in fabrication and welding, these jigs will enable the ease of cutting and repeating for as many pieces as needed.

The jig will fit inside the clamp of the saw, it also uses the compression from the clamp to then grab a hold of the tube. Adjust the angle of the blade to match the jig and its ready to go.

There are included centerline markers for all the included tubing diameters.

I have included an excell sheet which calculates how much the tube needs to protrude from the jig for a given centerline radius, this can then be set up on a vernier gauge and perfectly symmetrical pie cuts can then be produced.

how to use jigs:
Use the included centerline markers two draw two lines down your tubing 180 degrees apart. You can use the 3 line version which are 90 degrees apart each, this will then give you a reference to measure with the vernier gauge to cut the pieces exactly the same.

Use the calculator to work out how far out the tube needs to protrude from the jig.

Fit the tube into the jig, then into clamp on the saw, make sure the engled cut slides up to the blade

Tighten the clamp down so it is just gripping the tube, adjust the amount of material to be removed to get your first angle,make the first cut, the piece that was removed will make up for the first cut

To cut the first pie section, loosen the clamp, and then roll the tube 180 degrees, set the material to be cut, then tighten back down and make a cut, repeat this for the desired amount of pie cuts.


Included Tubing diameters and angles:
(Matching centerline markers also included)

3.50 Inch
9 Degree
15 degree

name: M60 Yugo HEAT Rifle Grenade (Full & Cutaway Versions) – Highly Detailed 3D Model
description:
Step into Cold War history with this precision 3D model of the M60 Yugoslavian HEAT Rifle Grenade CUTAWAY AND FULL VERSION. Perfect for collectors, educators, and military enthusiasts, this package includes both a full external model and a cutaway version to showcase the internal layout of this iconic anti-armor grenade.

This model was created using open-source references and is dimensionally accurate for training, display, or historical collections. Whether you’re a reenactor, an ordnance enthusiast, or simply someone who loves Cold War tech, this is a must-have piece for your 3D-print collection.

Included Files

Full Version – A true-to-life external model, perfect for display or reenactments.

Cutaway Version – Shows the inner structure of the grenade, highlighting how it was designed to defeat armored vehicles.

Historical Background

The M60 Rifle Grenade was a Yugoslavian-produced High-Explosive Anti-Tank (HEAT) munition designed to be launched from standard service rifles using a blank cartridge. It was widely used during the Cold War era and was capable of penetrating armored vehicles thanks to its shaped charge warhead.

The M60 was simple, reliable, and a cost-effective anti-armor solution for infantry forces before the widespread adoption of dedicated rocket launchers like the RPG-7.

Fun Fact

Unlike many NATO rifle grenades of its era, the M60 had a distinctively blunt nose cone and finned tail section, which made it very recognizable. Despite its simple appearance, it could penetrate 200mm of rolled homogeneous armor, making it a serious threat to early Cold War tanks.

Features

Two Models Included: Full & Cutaway

True-to-Scale Dimensions for realism

This model is for educational, training, and display purposes only. It is completely inert, with no explosive components, and cannot be made functional.

name: Scale Model Airplane - Painting Stand / Jig - V 3.0
description:
**This is a major re-design, of my Scale Model Airplane - Painting Stands / Jigs ([V.2.0](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/tool/scale-model-airplane-painting-stand-jig-v-2-0) and [V.1.0](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/tool/scale-model-airplane-painting-stand-jig))**

This is a fully adjustable stand for painting scale model airplanes. It can accommodate model planes in scales 1/72 and 1/48 scale, or larger (tested with a 1/24 Spitfire and a 1/24 Bf109).

The overall height of the stand is low, so that it can be used inside a spray booth without issues.

Using the 3 head extensions, the height and/or angle can be adjusted further. The extensions can also be useful when building a biplane, to support both sets of wings.

**The triscele base is redesigned**
- 3 base sizes are included: 110mm, 160mm and 210mm radius.
- Each leg can be printed separately. This allows for longer legs, as previously the base size was limited by the size of the printer bed.
- That said, one-piece versions of the base are also included, so that you can print them instead, if your printer bed is large enough.
- The base is designed to fit snuggly on the small turntables (192mm diameter) that are usually included with paint booths.

**The vertical axes have been redesigned**
 - They now use larger thumbscrews (M6 instead of M3) to make adjustments easier.
 - Even with the new larger thumbscrews, the horizontal footprint of the vertical axes has been reduced.
 - I personally prefer that the vertical axis don't revolve horizontally, so I have added notches at the bottom. In case you don't, you can print the "universal" version that comes without a notch.
 - By removing the heads and inserting 3mm screws on top of the vertical axis, can use the landing gear bays of the model plane as contact points to the stand (so that the freshly painted bottom of the plane does not touch the stand).

**The heads are mostly the same as the V.2.0 design**
 - They have been modified to fit the new vertical axes.
 - The head extensions are the same as the V.2.0. They still use small M3 thumbscrews to avoid interference with the scale model. 

**Movement Limits:**
 - Horizontal, per axis (110mm arm):  30mm - 100mm
 - Horizontal, per axis (160mm arm): 30mm - 150mm
 - Horizontal, per axis (210mm arm): 30mm - 200mm
 - Vertical: 67mm - 100mm
 - Vertical (using the extensions): 75mm - 168mm

**Printed Parts:**

**Basic Stand:**
 - 3x Horizontal Arms (choose between 110mm, 160mm or 210mm)
 - 1x Central Base Axis
 - 3x Vertical Arms (*)
 - 3x Vertical Arm Braces
 - 1x Head (U-shaped)
 - 2x Heads (Flat)
 - 6x M6 Thumbwheels

(*)
 - For rotating arms: print 3 "universal" Vertical Arms
 - For non-rotating arms: print 1 of each: "Front", "Left" & "Right" Vertical Arms 

**Vertical Extensions:**
 - 1x Head Extension (U-shaped)
 - 2x Head Extensions (Flat)
 - 6x Head Extension Rods
 - 12x M3 Thumbwheels

**Non-printable Parts:**
 - 6x M6x20 hex screws
 - 1x M6x16 hex screw (for the Central Axis)
 - 7x M6 hexagonal nuts
 - 12x M3x20 hex screws (for the extensions)
 - 12x M3 hexagonal nuts (for the extensions)
 -  (optional) Foam tape for the top of the heads

description:
3D Printable Vacuum Gripper  for Motoman / Yaskawa GP7 Robot

This vacuum gripper is a 3D-printable, modular end-of-arm tool, designed for lightweight robotic automation tasks such as pick-and-place, palletizing, and general material handling. It is ideal for prototyping and custom integration in flexible manufacturing environments.

The gripper features internal vacuum channels built directly into the body, reducing external tubing and simplifying the overall pneumatic setup. It supports up to 12 standard suction cups with m5 thread. The suction ports are closed by default and must be manually drilled post printing, allowing the user to create only the connections needed. This provides a customizable configuration tailored to the object being handled.

The gripper is designed for direct mounting on a Yaskawa GP7 robot.
The mounting holes are arranged in a circular pattern with a diameter of 31.5 mm. A total of eight holes have been included to provide flexibility in mounting options. While it is optimized for the GP7, the gripper can also be mounted on other robots or flanges, or even integrated into a larger gripper system with multiple functions.

One model version are included:

Material: Optimized for FDM/FFF 3D printing (carbon-reinforced filament recommended)

Mounting Interface: GP7
(8 mounting holes are arranged in a circular pattern with a diameter of 31.5 mm.)

Vacuum Connections: Supports up to 12 suction cups; user-drilled ports for flexible configuration. M5 thread for suction cups and 1/8" BSP for vacuum connecting fitting.

Weight of gripper: Only 250g depending on print settings. lightweight design for increased payload efficiency.

description:
Take your riding experience to the next level with this precision-designed QuadLock mount support, tailored exclusively for the third-generation Yamaha MT-07 (2021–2024 models).

🔩 Perfect Fit – OEM Style
Mounts directly to the two dashboard screws with a 40 mm bolt spacing – no modifications required. Seamlessly integrates with your cockpit for a clean and solid installation.

📐 Engineered to Impress
This bracket features:

Carefully beveled edges and smooth chamfers for a premium look and feel

Functional and minimal design that ensures zero interference with handlebars or visibility

Printed and tested with high-quality engineering filament for excellent mechanical strength

📍 Smartphone Centered
Once paired with a QuadLock head (sold separately on TEMU / AliExpress), your phone will sit perfectly centered above the instrument panel, providing ideal visibility for navigation, dash apps, or ride stats.

🛠️ Recommended Materials: PETG, ABS, ASA – for heat resistance and outdoor durability.
💡 Orientation: Base flat on bed, no supports needed.

🎁 Price: Only €3.99 – Ready-to-print STL included
🔧 Installation time: < 5 minutes
💬 Questions? Message me!
details:
To ensure maximum mechanical strength and optimal surface finish, we recommend the following 3D printing settings:

Printer Type: FDM
Material: PETG, ABS or ASA (for heat and UV resistance)
Layer Height: 0.2 mm
Wall Line Count: 3 (or 1.2 mm total wall thickness)
Top/Bottom Layers: 5
Infill: 35–50% (Grid or Gyroid recommended)
Print Speed: 45–55 mm/s
Support: Enabled (for the overhangs in vertical orientation)
Build Plate Adhesion: Brim or Raft recommended for better grip
Cooling: Moderate for PETG, minimal for ABS/ASA after first layers
Nozzle: 0.4 mm (or 0.6 mm for speed with slightly less detail)

📐 Printing Orientation
For maximum strength under load, print the part vertically with the mounting face (the one with the two holes) facing up and the curved base standing on the bed — as shown in the third image above.

This orientation:

Maximizes layer adhesion in the direction of mechanical stress

Ensures high durability when supporting your smartphone via the QuadLock system

Requires support structures, but guarantees the best performance in real-world use

🧪 Post-Processing (Optional)
Supports can be easily removed due to flat angles and clean geometry

Light sanding may be applied to chamfers for aesthetics

Bolt holes spacing: 40 mm

Suggested bolts: M5 x 20–25 mm (not included)

Create a fern-frond texture in clay with this botanical pattern roller. The detailed leaf pattern adds a woodland element to your pottery and polymer clay projects. Use this 3D-printable texture roller to decorate pottery and polymer clay.

Included files:
- furn.stl

Print the roller model, then roll it across a clay surface with light, even pressure. Check the imported dimensions in your slicer and scale uniformly to your intended working size. Test reduced sizes because downscaling can reduce fine detail. The gallery shows the pattern to help you choose your design.

This exact design is included in the [Botanical Clay Texture Rollers official bundle](https://cults3d.com/en/bundles/botanical-clay-texture-rollers-lavender-rose-fern). Compare the included designs with files you already own before buying.

If you find a fault with a downloaded file, please contact me through Cults so I can investigate. Requests for custom changes can be discussed separately.

details:
Existing test setup: Prusa Mini, 0.6 mm nozzle and 0.15 mm layer height, using the standard PrusaSlicer profile for that printer and nozzle. No supports or raft were used.

Check the imported dimensions in your slicer and set your intended working size before printing. Scale uniformly to preserve the pattern proportions. Smaller sizes and different printers or materials may need a fresh detail test; downscaling can reduce fine pattern detail. A finer nozzle or layer height may help resolve the pattern.

Apply light, even pressure in clay and test on a small piece before decorating your project.

name: 3D Printed Yamaha YBR/Libero 125 Tachometer Lower Cover (Tachometer Lower Cover - Dashboard Housing)
description:
Esta pieza es un archivo STL listo para impresión 3D que se acopla perfectamente a la parte inferior del tacómetro de las motocicletas Yamaha YBR 125 / Libero 125, ofreciendo protección adicional y un acabado profesional al tablero. 

El diseño ha sido optimizado para imprimir en ABS a una resolución de 0.2 mm, con soportes mínimos en la zona de montaje y refuerzos internos que garantizan resistencia sin sacrificar ligereza. 

Ideal para entusiastas del bricolaje y encargos de personalización, este modelo facilita la sustitución rápida de cubiertas dañadas o la actualización estética de la motocicleta.
details:
A continuación encontrarás unos parámetros de impresión 3D optimizados para tu tapa inferior de tacómetro Yamaha YBR/Libero 125. Esta configuración te brindará un compromiso ideal entre resistencia mecánica, calidad superficial y eficiencia en tiempo y material.

Parámetros de impresión recomendados
Material
Filamento: ABS (Acrilonitrilo Butadieno Estireno)

Requiere cama caliente entre 85 °C y 110 °C para evitar alabeos y garantizar adhesión (85 – 90 °C recomendado.
.
Ambiente cerrado o carcasa: mantener la zona de impresión a 40 – 70 °C para mejorar puentes y minimizar tensiones internas en ABS 

Configuración de pared e infill
Wall Loops (perímetros): 6 contornos

Aumenta la resistencia estructural y protege el infill para evitar marcas superficiales 

Infill: 100% (rectilíneo)

Produce piezas completamente macizas; ideal si buscas máxima rigidez aunque incrementa tiempo y material 

Altura de capa y calidad de superficie
Layer height: 0.24 mm (balance tiempo–calidad)

Esta altura te dio bajos costos de tiempo y material; puedes reducirla a 0.12–0.16 mm para mejorar detalle y acabado, a costa de mayor tiempo de impresión 

Soportes
Tipo de soporte: Tree supports (soportes arbóreos delgado)

Tocan el modelo en muy pocos puntos, facilitando la remoción y reduciendo marcas 

Grosor de soporte: finos (anchura de línea baja)

Ángulo de generación: 30 – 45 °

En este rango obtienes un buen compromiso entre necesidad de soporte y facilidad de impresión; > 45 ° puede generar huecos o ramas demasiado delgadas 
.

Observaciones y ajustes adicionales

Brim (falda ancha): +5–10 mm si aún experimentas alabeo en paredes altas (especialmente con ABS) 


Retracción: 1–2 mm a 25–35 mm/s para evitar hilos y “stringing” en ABS, ajusta según tu extrusor.

Velocidad de impresión: 40–60 mm/s para ABS (puedes aumentar hasta 80 mm/s si tu impresora lo permite, supervisando la calidad)
4. **Enfriamiento:** Ventilador de capa apagado o al mínimo (< 20%) salvo en puentes (100% solo durante puentes) ([LulzBot][14]).
5. **Adhesión cama:** usa ABS slurry (ABS disuelto en acetona) o cinta Kapton/PEI para mejorar el primer layer ([Simplify3D][15], [MatterHackers][1]).

---

Con estos parámetros tendrás una pieza sólida, resistente y con una buena relación coste–beneficio en tiempo y material. Ajusta cualquier parámetro secundario (velocidades, temperatura de flujo, ángulos de retracción) para optimizar según tu impresora y entorno de trabajo.

name: Saturn 3 Ultra Build Plate holder
description:
Strong, durable and VERY EASY TO USE ! Simply place this holder over the resin tank screw (either side) and slide outwards to lock in position. It DOES NOT require the tank screw to be removed or loosened. It ALLOWS maximum size prints to drain with the lid on.

Using this Build Plate Holder can help you make a significant saving in resin by aiding the draining of resin back into the tank. Better draining  also helps with  quicker and easier cleaning of your printed items. 

Print it in resin (the example in the photos is in Elegoo Water Washable and printed on the Saturn 3 Ultra), there are three parts that simply require super glue to complete a rigid structure. The file is complete with supports so all you need to do is slice and print. 

The build plate is held at 20° to the vertical, found to be optimal for draining the majority of models and it can simply be turned through 180° if necessary to aid the draining process.

name: Rolex Submariner Ceramic Bezel Insert Press Tool 126610 124060
description:
Ceramic Insert Press Tool for Rolex Submariner 126610 – 2-Part Die for Safe and Precise Installation

This custom-designed 3D printable tool allows you to safely and evenly press the ceramic bezel insert into the bezel ring of the Rolex Submariner 126610. The die is carefully angled to apply uniform pressure, avoiding damage to the ceramic insert or bezel during installation. This die is also suitable for pressing the complete bezel back onto the case, ensuring a secure and even fit without damaging the components.

Key Features:

✅ Safe Installation: Designed with the correct angle to ensure even pressure across the ceramic insert—no risk of cracking or chipping.

🧩 2-Part System:

Part 1 (No Cutout): A solid version without a cutout for the lume pearl. Ideal for a cleaner and smoother surface during printing, and easier to post-process.

Part 2 (With Lume Pearl Cutout): Includes a notch for the lume pearl to avoid pressure on the protruding section.

🛠️ Manual Customization Option:

The solid version (Part 1) can be manually modified using a small file or rotary tool (e.g., Dremel).

Recommended cutout dimensions: approx. 3 mm wide × 1 mm high.

This approach gives more control and ensures optimal print quality and surface finish.

Printing & Finishing Notes:

🖨️ FDM Printing Only – Designed for PLA or ABS (resin printing not recommended).

🔍 Layer Height: Use the smallest layer height possible (e.g., 0.1 mm) to ensure a smooth, even contact surface. This improves pressure distribution and reduces the risk of damaging the insert.

✂️ Finishing Recommended: For best results, smooth the pressing surface using:

A sharp blade,

Fine sandpaper mounted to a rotary tool or lathe,

Or at least an electric screwdriver to spin the part while sanding.
This step significantly improves surface evenness and function.

What You’ll Need:

2x M6 nuts
A standard watch press (ideally the E25 model)

How to Use:

Print both parts (Part 1 and Part 2) in high quality.

Insert M6 nuts and mount the parts onto your watch press.

Choose the pre-cut version (Part 2) or modify Part 1 manually.

Insert the ceramic bezel into the bezel ring.

Use a watch press and this die to apply steady, even pressure until the insert clicks into place.

Compatibility:

✅ Tested and designed for the Rolex Submariner 126610.

⚠️ Potential Fit: May also work with the Rolex Submariner 124060 and possibly other models with similar bezel designs, but has not been officially tested. Use with care and at your own discretion.

Perfect for:

- Watchmakers

- Rolex modders and restorers

- DIY enthusiasts working with ceramic bezel inserts

Minor post-processing and size adjustments in the slicer may be necessary.

If you experience any problems, please feel free to contact me.

This files are intended for PERSONAL USE only.
They are not allowed to be reproduced and sold.
The intellectual property belongs exclusively to Teufel Technical Solutions.

name: Pen Refill Adapter: Waterman BP to D1 Mini + Others
description:
I present my pen refill adapter, for use in pens that take the Waterman BP refill. It allows such pens to use the Mini/Multi D1 refills instead.
The Waterman BP refill is around 112mm long and 5.6mm in diameter. The D1 refill is around 67mm long and 2.3mm in diameter.

I appreciate that the D1 refill is generally a less practical refill, compared to the Waterman BP, in terms of ink volume and manufacturer diversity (although it's close). However, there are D1 refills, like the Pilot Hi-Tec-C Slims or Zebra JSB, which are not available in the Waterman BP refill size, so this adapter exists to hopefully provide flexibility, between your favourite pens and refills.

I've also included Refill Adapter models that takes the:
Pilot Hi-Tec-C Coleto refill (93mm long and 3.1mm wide),
and Uni Signo UMR-109 (99mm long and 3.1mm wide).

Due to the very varied nature of pen design, I cannot guarantee that this adapter will work with any specific pen, although I've made every effort to make it as universal as possible.

(these adapters used to be sold on Shapeways, in an SLS printed plastic. However since their bankruptcy; I haven't found a viable solution that replicates the service they used to provide, so I'm making them available here)

details:

🖨 Recommended Print Settings
Layer Height: 0.2mm (for a balance of detail and strength)
Infill: 30-40% (for durability without excessive material use)
Perimeters/Walls: 3-4 (for extra strength and rigidity)
Supports: ❌ Not Required (designed for easy printing)
Build Plate Adhesion: Skirt or Brim (optional, depending on adhesion needs)
🔧 Recommended Filaments
PETG – Best choice for flexibility, impact resistance, and outdoor durability
PLA+ – Strong and easy to print, but avoid prolonged sun exposure
ABS/ASA – High durability and heat resistance, but requires an enclosed printer
🖨 Printing Tips
Ensure a well-leveled print bed for good first-layer adhesion.
Print at a moderate speed (40-50mm/s) for precision in snap-fit connections.
If using PETG, slightly reduce fan speed to improve layer bonding.
Print all three parts separately and check fit before final assembly.
🛠 How to Assemble & Use
Print the three parts of the holder.
Snap them together—no screws or glue required.
Insert elastic bands into the designated holes to secure fishing rods.
Place up to 4 fishing rods in the slots and carry them comfortably using the built-in handle.
🔹 Notes
If using PLA, avoid exposure to extreme heat or prolonged sun exposure.
PETG is recommended for outdoor use due to its weather-resistant properties.
Hand wash recommended to maintain long-term durability.

name: M18 Impact socket insert for Milwaukee Packout Organizer Compact (4932464083 / 48-22-8435)
description:
I always need my 1/2” Milwaukee impact wrench for my work. For this reason, I bought the 1/2” Packout impact socket set with the number 4932480943 so that I can store it on my Packout trolley and carry it with me.
This set contains impact sockets from 10 to 24mm, as well as a 75mm extension. 
However, as I also need larger impact sockets or extensions and adapters for my work and this set does not provide any storage space for them, I came up with a design myself that can hold all available 1/2” impact sockets from Milwaukee.

My design is made up of two parts and can therefore also be used individually to use the second side for storage space of any kind.

**Part 1** can hold all sockets and extensions from the 4932480943 set, as well as a 150mm extension.

**Part 2** can hold all Milwaukee sockets larger than 24mm, as well as an additional adapter to 3/4”.


**Note**
I use this set for the long version of the impact sockets, but it should also work for the short version without any problems. It may be necessary to adjust the height in the slicer so that the impact nuts sit properly in the holder.

**The set was designed for the metric version. There may therefore be problems with the inch version.**

If you need an imperial version, please contact me. I am happy to adapt my design

name: Seadoo 787 (140mm) Engine Alignment Tool
description:
Here is an engine alignment tool I created for the 140mm pump mount.  This is a 3-4 part print, depending how you do your printing.  The 2 larger pieces have 1/4' holes and can take a 1/4-20x1' to secure them together.  I have also included the tip for the 1/2" emt conduit, 1 short and 1 longer.  Items needed are below along with some tips and other information to know.  READ it all.

Items needed outside of all parts included to print:

1- 5' piece of 1/2' EMT conduit, this can be picked up at your local hardware store.  Cut to length you prefer, use 1000 grit sandpaper and smooth the whole pipe out that will be sliding through the alignment tool.  

2- 2, 1/4-20x1"  or longer if you are planning to use nuts. The screws will thread and hold pretty well. Any other screw and nut combo will work as long as it is 1/4” or smaller. This is used to hold the 2 halves together.

3- Some sort of lubricant, I used silicon lube out of the bottle.  This really helps the pipe slide through the alignment tool as the tool was created to be tight with very little play.

4- If you prefer to drill a hole through the emt into the tip and drive a screw through to hold it onto the pipe, feel free to. If you have epoxy or something to “glue” the tip in, that will work also. Make sure to secure the tip to the emt to keep the tip from getting caught in the PTO while aligning engine.

name: Filament wall mount
description:
Organiza tus bobinas de filamento de forma elegante y ahorrando espacio con este ingenioso soporte de pared para filamentos. Diseñado específicamente para el almacenamiento de filamentos, este modelo ofrece una solución óptima para guardar tus materiales de impresión 3D de forma ordenada y protegida.

Solución de almacenamiento perfecta
•    Este soporte está diseñado para varillas redondas de 20 mm de diámetro, con el fin de almacenar sus bobinas de filamento de forma estable y segura.
•    Su diseño está optimizado para albergar hasta 7 bobinas de filamento, que se pueden guardar de forma ordenada y clara.
Uso de un trozo de madera redonda de 1 metro de longitud
•    Para el soporte se necesita un trozo de madera redonda de 20 mm de diámetro y 1 metro de longitud, que se puede adquirir en casi cualquier tienda de bricolaje.
•    Si es necesario, la pieza de madera se puede cortar fácilmente en dos trozos de 500 mm cada uno para adaptarla mejor a espacios más reducidos.

Posibilidades de ampliación flexibles
•    Si desea utilizar piezas de madera redonda más largas (por ejemplo, de más de 500 mm de longitud), se recomienda imprimir un tercer soporte de pared. Este sirve como soporte central para aumentar la estabilidad y evitar que la madera redonda se doble.
•    Gracias a los orificios integrados en el diseño, el soporte se puede ampliar de forma flexible sin perder estabilidad.

Detalles prácticos
•    Los orificios integrados se pueden tapar con tapones si es necesario, lo que redondea el diseño y mejora el aspecto del soporte.
Fácil instalación
•    Su diseño para montaje en pared permite una fijación rápida y sencilla en cualquier pared. Los orificios de montaje perforados con precisión garantizan una sujeción segura, incluso con varios rollos de filamento.
•    Listo para usar en pocos minutos, con solo unos tornillos (no incluidos).

Orden
•    Perfecto para mantener tus filamentos ordenados y siempre a mano.

Diseño compacto y bien pensado
•    Su diseño compacto convierte a este soporte en la opción ideal para pequeños talleres, oficinas o salas de ocio.
•    Gracias a su diseño minimalista, se integra a la perfección en cualquier entorno sin resultar molesto.
Duradero y respetuoso con el medio ambiente
•    El modelo está optimizado para la impresión 3D y puede fabricarse con materiales duraderos como PLA, PETG o ABS.
•    Combina estabilidad y eficiencia, al tiempo que reduce al mínimo el consumo de material de impresión.

name: Low Profile VW ALH TDI Timing Belt Tensioner Tool
description:
I was doing a head gasket job on a VW ALH that had had a recent timing belt service done, but in order to use my existing tensioner tool to reinstall the belt, I would have had to remove the engine mount bracket.

I designed this low profile tool to fit in the tight space and get the job done successfully without further disassembly.  It requires the use of 3mm diameter metal pins, about 13-14mm long (I pulled the pins out of my existing tool that didn't fit the space).  I tried plastic printed pins but they were not strong enough to tension the belt.

I believe this will also fit the tensioners used on PD TDI engines.
details:
100% infill or 99 walls.  PLA is suitable for all parts except the pins (maybe there is another material strong enough to tension the belt, but metal worked reliably).

The 'bridge' piece is a press fit into the arm (printed separate in a different orientation for strength, and is a slip fit into the tool body (so it can be oriented as needed in 6 different positions).

Orientations and print settings are included in the .3mf file; I printed this on a Bambu A1.

name: GRINDER WEED
description:
Welcome to the world of perfect grinding with our 3D grinder design. This device has been meticulously designed to offer not only superior functionality, but also a unique aesthetic experience. Here are the key features of this revolutionary grinder:





Robust and Functional Design:


The teeth of our grinder have been strategically arranged to efficiently withstand the stresses associated with grinding material. Each component has been carefully designed to ensure uniform and effortless grinding.





Universal Tolerances:


We have considered variations in 3D printers when designing this model. Tolerances have been adjusted to suit a wide range of printers, from the simplest to those with automatic material systems such as bambulab printers.





Versatility in Printing:


The STL files provided are intended to be compatible with different types of 3D printers. Whether you are using a basic printer or a state-of-the-art one, this design is ready to adapt to your manufacturing needs.





Comfortable Grip:


The exterior of the grinder features knurling that not only adds an aesthetic touch, but also improves grip. Ergonomics have been a priority to ensure that using the grinder is a comfortable and hassle-free experience.





Customization with 3D Engraving:


On the top of the grinder, you will find a unique 3D engraving. This detail not only adds character, but also allows for customization. Depending on the version, the engraving can vary, which means that every user can have a unique and exclusive grinder.





Easy Assembly and Disassembly:


We have simplified the assembly process to make it accessible even for those new to 3D printing. In addition, the design allows for easy disassembly for easy cleaning and maintenance.
details:
Printing material: for the grinder body and lid, it is recommended to use a strong and durable material, such as PLA, ABS or PETG.





Layers: The thickness of each printing layer should be 0.2 mm to achieve good printing quality.





Filling: 30% filling is recommended for the grinder body and lid to achieve a solid and strong structure.





Printing speed: Suggested printing speed is 50-60 mm/s to ensure accurate and uniform printing.





Printing temperature: The printing temperature will depend on the material used. For PLA a printing temperature of 200-220°C is recommended, for ABS 230-260°C, and for PETG 220-240°C.





Adhesion to the bed: It is important that the part adheres well to the printing bed to prevent it from peeling off during printing. To achieve good adhesion, it is recommended to use a special 3D printing adhesive tape or a textured printing surface.


Supports: no supports are required to print these parts as they are designed to be printed without supports.

name: Creality K1 Max back exhaust hose adaptor
description: The activated carbon filter on the back of the printer has a very limited life when printing ABS.  Instead of filtering the fumes I made this flexible house coupling, it snaps into place on the two prongs that hold the original filter.  You can use a 4" (100mm) flexible hose and a plastic zip tie to direct the fumes outside.
details:
3D printing
Material: PETG, ASA or ABS as the air can get quite warm inside the k1Max when printing ABS or ASA.
Other settings: 0.20 mm layer height, 15% infill, 3 walls.
Printing orientation:  Square side down
Supports: yes, see the included image.

INSTALLATION
1.  Carefully remove the carbon filter, do not damage the two square flaps on the sides of the square cavity.
2. Insert the coupling so the side slots match the two square flaps.
3.  Push the coupling so the square surface is flush with the back of the printer, the square flaps have to click past a detent so they hold the part in place.
4.  Fit a 4" (100mm) flexible hose in the protruding cylinder and use a zip tie to hold it in place.
Now direct the other end of the hose outside.  I don't recommend a hose longer than 1 m (3') the fan doesn't have the power for that kind of pressure loss.

name: Rod Tool for Notching 40 mm Tubes
description:
This device is a high-precision tool specifically designed to facilitate the notching of 40 mm tubes, allowing to perform "fishmouth" cuts (Notching Tool). Ideal for those working in the automotive and racing fields, this tool allows to achieve a perfect fit between round tubes, ensuring solid and aligned connections in tubular structures.

The tool is primarily intended for the manufacture of roll cages, prototype tubular chassis and other automotive structures that require a high level of precision in tube-to-tube joints.

Functionality:

- Notch Angle Determination: The tool helps determine the exact notch angle required, eliminating the need for complex calculations or inaccurate manual adjustments. This is especially useful for joining pipes in angled configurations, where a fishmouth cut ensures a larger contact surface and a stronger connection.

- Cut Line Marking: Thanks to its design, the device allows the user to easily mark the cut line on the pipe, ensuring a uniform and accurate notch. Simply adjust the tool on the tube, align the guides, and follow the marked line to make the cut.

Technical Features:

- Compatibility: Designed specifically for 40 mm diameter tubes, which are commonly used in the manufacture of safety structures and racing chassis.

Applications:

This tool is essential for professionals and enthusiasts of:

- Automotive Competition: Tube connections in roll cages and reinforcement structures.

- Prototype Chassis: Allows the user to cut the tubes in a variety of ways. Prototype Chassis: Allows precise and professional joining of chassis sections.

- Automotive Structural Fabrication: Ideal for work on tubular structures where precision and exact fit are key to safety and durability.

You will need:

- 35 metal rods 150mm x 3mm in diameter
- 2 or 3 rubber bands to prevent rod movement.

name: ender6 direct drive with BMG extruder for stock machine double lineer
description:
This model is a precise and functional design for modifying the Creality Ender-6 3D printer to support a direct drive setup with a Bondtech BMG extruder on its stock machine frame, while retaining the double linear rail configuration for increased stability and precision. Below is a breakdown of the model's main design aspects and features:

1. Mounting Bracket for Direct Drive Configuration
Material: Designed to be printed in high-strength, heat-resistant materials like PETG, ABS, or nylon.
Geometry: Compact and optimized for the Ender-6’s constrained enclosure space, with a sleek bracket that secures the BMG extruder directly above the hotend.
Positioning: Precise alignment to keep the extruder close to the hotend for minimal retraction, improving extrusion control and reducing filament drag.
Adjustment Slots: Includes slots for fine-tuning the alignment of the extruder in the X/Y/Z axes to ensure perfect filament feed.
2. Double Linear Rail Compatibility
Rail Integration: The model is tailored to support the Ender-6's dual linear rails, ensuring smooth and stable movement along the X and Y axes, essential for direct drive extrusions.
Reinforced Frame Attachments: Enhanced mounting points to withstand the added weight of the direct drive assembly, helping prevent wobble and maintaining consistent layer lines.
Vibration Dampening: Incorporated vibration-reduction features that dampen the extruder's movement and reduce artifacts in prints.
3. BMG Extruder Mounting System
BMG-Specific Slotting: Precise cutouts to fit the Bondtech BMG extruder, ensuring secure positioning with minimal play.
Direct Path Filament Feeding: Optimized filament path from spool to hotend, eliminating bends and minimizing friction points.
Accessibility: Allows easy access for filament changes, motor servicing, and hotend swaps without disassembly of the entire carriage.
4. Cable and Tubing Management
Cable Clips and Guides: Channels designed along the bracket to hold the wiring harness and PTFE tubing neatly, preventing tangling and wear.
Flexible Conduits: Space for optional flexible conduits to protect wires from abrasion due to the added motion of the direct drive setup.
5. Weight Optimization and Balance
Lightweight Structure: Hollow sections within the bracket structure reduce weight without compromising rigidity, balancing performance with the mass of the BMG extruder.
Balanced Design: Ensures even weight distribution, minimizing strain on the X and Y stepper motors.
6. Enhanced Cooling Pathways
Dual Cooling Channels: Spaces on either side of the hotend to accommodate part cooling fans, ensuring consistent temperature around the print.
Heat Sink Mounts: Additional mounting spots for heat sinks if desired, to keep extruder motor temperatures low during extended printing sessions.
This design keeps the Ender-6’s structure intact, requiring only minor modifications to add high-performance extrusion capabilities with minimal impact on the original enclosure and mechanical systems. The model is built to be user-friendly, durable, and reliable, helping to maximize the Ender-6’s capabilities with a direct drive BMG extruder setup.

name: Air outlets dashboard Volkswagen LT Mk1
description:
I'm the proud owner of a 1980's VW LT Mk1. Unfortunately over time the plastic parts have started degrading. This also goes for the air outlets on top of the dashboard, which have been exposed to sun for more than 40 years. That's why I decided to design them from scratch to be able to print them. 

They are nearly identical to the original, except for the curvature of the ribs on top. I might change that in the future, but it doesn't affect the airflow or the looks I think.
details:
I printed them upright, as if they are mounted in the van. In the beginning I lost one print because it came of the print bed due to the small cilinder it rests upon, so now I print them with a raft underneath. No problems since then anymore.

The little clips on the sides are very fragile and should be printed 90 degrees tilted, but that made the finish on the top look worse. So be careful!

I FDM print those in Matte PET-G from fiberlogy, which looks quite nice:
https://fiberlogy.com/en/fiberlogy-filaments/matte-pet-g/

I think Carbon filled Filaments, either PCTG+CF or PA12+CF would work wonderfully as wel. I'd avoid PLA because of the high temperatures which may occur in the cabin when parked in the sun.

Of course an SLM process would also be great, that would make the clips stronger as well.

This mount is compatible with the FrSky TD MX receivers, and includes mounting plates both with and without antenna guides.

This requires the use of 1/2" wide Velcro double sided hook and loop tape, and some M2 self tapping screws. name: Hettich Rastex 15 Drill Guide
description:
A simple and quick drilling template for Hettich Rastex 15/24 and Rastex15/34 connecting fittings. At the moment only for 19mm chipboard. Hence “quick and easy”. You can mount the stop on one side for the 24 mm dowels and on the other side for the 34 mm dowels. The dowel holes can be drilled with an 8mm wood drill and the holes for the eccentrics can be drilled with a 15mm Forstner bit.

For the second template, the 36mm copy sleeve and a 5mm dowel drill with a router are used. I recommend printing the second template twice so that you can align a board precisely at the front and back at the same time and then fix it with a clamp.

I deliberately made the guide for the 8mm wood drill screw-on so that on the one hand you need less support and on the other hand you don't have to reprint the entire template if the guide is worn out.

The holes have an edge distance of 50mm

For the movable stop tabs, 8x self-locking nuts and 5x20mm screws are required.
For the knurled screws, 2x normal M5 nuts and M5x20 hexagon screws are required.

Note:
Theoretically, the 29mm copy sleeve and an 8mm milling cutter can also be used for eccentric use. But I haven't tested it

Let me know if you want another copy sleeve or an adapter for your own copy sleeves. 
The large holes in the templates have a diameter of 36mm

name: DIY bottle label applicator for wet glue labels - Bottle Label Applicator with 3D printing
description:
This is the first DIY bottle labeling applicator for wet-glue labels - an innovative helper that basically consists of two different machines:





- The friction feeder: separates your labels precisely (https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/tool/3d-printed-friction-feeder).





- The label applicator: applies the label to your bottles fully automatically. The label applicator can also be used separately without the friction feeder.





My machine is designed to label round bottles and containers fully automatically. Thanks to the integrated glue roller, the glue of your choice is automatically applied to the labels, which are then deflected and applied to the bottle. You insert the bottle and press the start button.





Here is my video about the machine: https://youtu.be/EXu-7_3RnEY





Detailed description of the machine on my website: https://fraensengineering.com/diy-3d-printed-wet-labeling-machine-your-fully-automated-solution-for-labels/





Advantages and areas of application:


- Ideal for home brewers, wine, schnapps and honey producers.


- Processing of labels up to a height of 110 mm.


- Controlled by an Arduino.





Why wet glue labels?


- Cost-effective and flexible: design and print your labels at home without having to invest in large quantities.


- Perfect for small batches: Produce your labels in small quantities, customized to your individual needs.





Especially attractive for hobbyists and DIY enthusiasts: If you own a 3D printer, brew beer and like to realize projects, my label dispenser is a very great project! Most of the parts are made with a 3D printer. For all other parts there are Amazon links in the parts list.





Important note: This device is in the testing stage. You are purchasing a prototype, but it is already working well. Future updates are of course included in the purchase of the building instructions.





What you get:


- All digital files you need to build the Label Applicator.


- All .stl files for 3D printing


- Professionally created assembly drawings in .dxf and .pdf format


- Clear parts list of all required parts


- A complete 3D model in .step format of the Label Applicator


- A clear circuit diagram of the electronics.


- Amazon links for all purchased parts


- in case of problems I will be happy to help you quickly!





To build a fully automatic machine, you can extend the label applicator with the friction feeder. You can find the friction feeder in my Etsy store!





Start your labeling adventure with 3D printing technology!

Specifications:

Digital Files Included:

Why Choose Our 3D Printable Laser Fixture Plate?

    Precision and Versatility: The high-density grid pattern allows for precise positioning and secure fastening, making it ideal for complex and intricate engraving tasks.
    Easy Installation: The fixture plate is designed for straightforward installation, bolting directly onto your laser engraver's base without the need for additional modifications.

Please Note: This listing is for digital files only. Upon purchase, you will receive the STL and 3MF files needed to print the fixture plate yourself. No physical product will be shipped.

Elevate your laser engraving projects with our high-density fixture plate. Purchase your digital files today and experience the difference in precision and versatility!
details:
3D Printable Laser Fixture Plate - Printing Instructions

Enhance your laser engraving machine with our 3D Printable Laser Fixture Plate. To ensure optimal results, follow these detailed printing instructions specifically tailored for this model.

Printing Instructions:

    File Formats: Download the provided STL and 3MF files. Ensure your 3D printer software supports these formats.
    Printer Settings:
        Layer Height: For best results, use a layer height of 0.2mm.
        Infill Density: Set the infill density to 50% or higher to achieve the required strength and durability.
        Print Speed: Use a moderate print speed of 50mm/s to balance quality and printing time.
        Supports: Enable supports to ensure accurate printing of the threaded and precision holes.
        Shell Thickness: Use a shell thickness of at least 1.2mm to provide additional strength to the fixture plate.
    Material Recommendations:
        PLA: Easy to print and widely available. Suitable for light to moderate use.
        PETG: Offers better strength and heat resistance, ideal for more demanding applications.
        ABS: Provides high durability and resistance to impact, suitable for industrial use.
    Bed Adhesion:
        Use a heated bed set to 60°C for PLA and 90°C for ABS.
        Apply a layer of glue stick or blue painter’s tape to improve bed adhesion and prevent warping.
    Post-Processing:
        Carefully remove any supports once printing is complete.
        Ensure all threaded and precision holes are clean and free of debris.
        Sand any rough edges for a smooth finish.

Key Features:

    High Density Design: 256 M6 threaded and modeled holes along with 241 precision 6mm holes in a 12.5mm grid pattern.
    Perfect Fit: Designed to bolt directly to the top of your positioning table, compatible with standard 25mm or 50mm grid patterns.
    Durable and Robust: 15mm thick to withstand the demands of frequent use.

name: AC Vertical mold L
description:
Casting mold for metal casting with an inner diameter of


176mm x 130mm and a mold height of 40mm.


The holes can be drilled using the drill plate provided (I planned the hole to be 4mm and used M4 screws with nuts). This can then also be used as a base plate for cast models.





The other openings are planned in 3mm and serve as a template for M4 threaded holes (so that the closed molds can be used as attachments).





ATTENTION: Due to shrinkage, the diameter changes depending on the metal used for casting.


Nevertheless, use the base plate for drilling so that you can use it again later.





For the drill holes, I recommend using the base plate (match plate) for one half and then drilling through the second half using the first half of the mold.





The design of the mold allows them to be stacked on top of each other to increase the size of the mold, in which case we recommend drilling another hole in each case!





I recommend a resolution and layer height of 0.1 mm to simplify reworking.


The model is normally smooth enough for casting with 2-3 layers of varnish.





The enclosed closed mold allows the casting flask to be extended in height.


This can also be used separately as a small casting mold.





DIMENSION: 200x173x40mm





Please use an investment casting sand for this casting, but it is still recommended to rework the groove a little, e.g. with a fine drill grinder (Dremel)





ATTENTION METAL CASTING as a HOBBY:


Please note that casting metals of all kinds involves risks to life and limb.


Always ensure that work paths and work surfaces are clear and wear the appropriate protective equipment (heat shield, goggles, gloves, aprons, protective masks, etc.).


Always work in well-ventilated or open spaces!


No liability is accepted for improper handling!


If you are a professional, I assume that the necessary safety measures will be taken anyway.





Please also take a look at my MetalCasting collection: https://cults3d.com/en/design-collections/AC-Design/metal-casting

name: 3D printable Drone Body
description:
Ever since my graduation project, I had all my drones with this wire spaghetti everywhere. The drones look ugly with all the components exposed and just mounted on top. so, I decided to design a drone body that will keep all the wiring inside. it will look neat from outside. You can use whatever filament you want if you believe the type of motors you use won’t get too hot.

- Top and Bottom layers:     4

name: Artillery Genius Pro / Sidewinder X2 Hemera Extruder Mount
description:
I couldn't find a mount that suited my needs to upgrade the extruder on my Artillery3D Genius Pro with an E3D Hemera, so I decided to make my own

This set of parts will accommodate an Hemera extruder onto the original carriage of the printer while keeping the nozzle position pretty much the same as the original extruder. They allow for the Hemera to be mounted using either Revo, Volcano or V6 hotends, with either the "original" or the newer XS stepper, with or without ABL probe (two specific parts for the V6 as I could not make them compatible with all three hotend). My printer has the "E.Breakout V2.1" extruder board

These parts should also work on Sidewinder X2 since it's pretty much the same extruder on a bigger printer. I've tested them on older Sidewinder X1/Genius in with Revo/Volcano hotends

I attempted to reuse most of the screws from the original extruder but you'll still need a few additional ones, as well as the Hemera fixing kit supplied by E3D. Additionally, to save space and due to a shortage of fasteners on my end, you'll need to create some M3 threads directly into the "Board Mount" (Refer to the images for thread indication, along with screw length specifications).

The X and Y offsets of Artillery's factory Z Probe (ABL Probe) changed quite a bit, so you'll need to adjust that in the firmware as well (recompile the firmware or use an EEPROM editor -> X offset = 26mm / Y offset = -42.8mm). In my case, the Z offset is -1.15mm, but it may vary from one printer to another

General Assembly Instructions:

(1) Attach the Hemera Mount the the Hemera extruder. Pay attention the holes position based on the stepper and hotend configuration you have

(2) Fasten the Board Mount with the specified screws onto the Hemera's stepper

(3) Make all the required components connections to the extruder board and mount the Z probe with the same screws, then fasten the board itself to the Board Mount with the factory screws as well

(4) Assemble the extruder onto the printer carriage. This is the tricky part as the lower screw on the carriage is hard to access. Use an long Allen key and be careful with the connections on the extruder board. Alternatively, you can invert steps (3) & (4) but I found it harder to make the connections once attached to the carriage

(5) Finally, connect and mount the layer fan with the pre-assembled Layer Duct for your hotend configuration. You will need x3 M3x16 screw for this. I used DIN912 screws and reused some other from the original extruder

Huge thanks to :

Andreas Reiswig for his really accurate model of the Hemera Extruder (grabcad.com/library/e3d-hermes-hemera-v6-volcano-1)

"Rick and Morty" for a fairly accurate Sidewinder X1 model (grabcad.com/library/artillery-sidewinder-x1-1)
details:
Sliced with CURA 5.6.0. Print in the shown orintations

name: Parkside Battery Adapter
description:
Parkside Battery Adapter with underdischarge protection. Simple to build. I have 2 versions. With and Without a Switch.

All you need is:
1. XH-M609 Over Discharge Battery Protection
2. 2pcs 6.3mm (Blue ones) Electrical Crimp Terminals
3. Wire of your choice. I used 1mm2
4. 15*21mm ON/OFF switch
5. Glue for cover.

Assembly is straightforward.
1. Solder wires to male terminals. Do not crimp them but solder.
2. Heat male terminals and push them in a 3D-printed adapter.
3. Desolder input screw terminals (Green block) on XH-M609 and solder your wires from male terminals you just heat pushed in.
4. Solder in switch. All wires should stay under the module.
5. Make sure none of the wires are damaged put everything in place and push 3D printed pints in all 4 corners. You can use some glue to prevent them from coming loose.
6. On the cover there is a hole for a red LED. You can fill that hole with hot glue.

name: Snatch Block Pulley
description:
This is my design of a snatch block style pulley.  It requires a 608 bearing to function and was designed specifically for use with 1/2" diameter rope, on the pulley and in the eye anchor.  The single pulley consists of two side plates, two bolt pins, one eye attachment, and an s-style cotter/keeper pin.  Also included in this is a file for additional parts to stack two pulleys side by side.
     The pulley section that the bearings insert into is quite a snug fit, but that is by design.  
     I will not list a recommended load rating because of all the variations possible with filament, printers, user error, etc....  With the settings, filament and printer i used though, I was able to have a single pulley that did not fail until right at 400lbs.
     Enjoy and be safe.

P.S. If you download and make this please post some pictures of your makes and what you use them for!

name: 10/22 Charger Pistol Brace
description:
I set out to design a stabilizing arm brace for a Ruger 10/22 charger.  Two factors make it unique.
First, it is designed to be printed with minimal support.  That’s why it has flat faces at the back and along the top. Using four parts instead of one piece not only drastically lowers the required support material, but also allows the strongest directions of the print(s) to align with the highest-loaded directions in the final assembly.
Second, to mount a typical brace on a charger, one would need an adaptor (to either pic rail or buffer tube), and this is expensive.  Instead, this brace has the adaptor built in, saving space, complexity, and of course, money.  It mounts to the pistol stock using the factory bolt in the trigger block.  However, this direct-mount feature does mean that this brace cannot be used with other platforms relying on a buffer tube or vertical pic rail.  But if you have a 10/22 charger, this was literally designed for it.
It assembles with either bolts and inserts, or welding.  Welding the plastic is about as strong and doesn’t require hardware, but doesn’t look as clean. Also, it takes more dexterity, but the option is there.  Another option is holes for a QD sling swivel.  This can be mounted on either side, using two bolts going through the width of the mount piece.
The design takes about 120g of filament with the recommended settings.  No vitamins are required (except a Velcro strap, of course, which should be 1”-1.5” wide) if one chooses to forgo the sling mounts and weld instead of using bolts.  This will still require a soldering iron, though.  If one wishes to bolt the design together, three button head M4 bolts (1x8mm, 1x12mm, and 1x25mm) & three M4 threaded inserts (1x6mm and 2x8.1mm) will be needed.  If you desire a sling mount, I spaced the holes for [this one] (https://www.amazon.com/dp/B07ZNL5FMX?th=1), and it required an additional two 8.1mm M4 threaded inserts and two 35mm M4 bolts.
*Also, I did not design the grip pictured, it can be found for free* [here] (https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:4281898).
---
Since publishing this, I also have made a folding version: [creation 10-22-charger-folding-pistol-brace]

The spray can decanter is an innovative tool designed to transfer paint from spray cans into a container in a controlled manner for use in airbrush applications, for example. This practical solution makes paint transfer effortless and precise.

4 **Screw-on spray guide:** The spray guide can be screwed on, which ensures a secure and stable connection between the spray can and the collection container.





5 **Easy to use:** The spray can decanter is easy to use and makes the paint transfer process hassle-free, even for users with little experience.





**Areas of application:**





The decanter is particularly suitable for artists and hobbyists who want to use paint from spray cans for precise airbrush applications. Controlled transfer minimizes wasted material and allows paints to be efficiently dispensed into the desired container.





The spray can decanter makes preparing paint for creative projects a simple and clean affair.

name: Universal bobbin holder for FLSUN V400, alternatively with ball bearing
description:
The original spool holder of the FLSUN V400 is unstable and wobbly. The filament spool can hardly rotate on it. It is also difficult to access due to the height of the printer and its position at the back, especially for smaller people.





My alternative:





A spool holder is inserted into the grooves of the aluminum profile of the front printer columns, but can also be used in the grooves of the rear printer column. There is one coil holder for the left-hand groove and one for the right-hand groove. The spool holder can either be equipped with ball bearings or with a ball bearing dummy.


The type 6202 ball bearing used can be purchased from AliExpress for less than 1 euro or from Amazon for less than 5 euros.





If the spool holder is attached to the right-hand printer column in the rear groove, as shown in the photos, the filament spool is very easy to access.





There are 3 sizes of spool holders to choose from.


One for filament rolls in the standard width of approx. 65 mm and one for wider filament rolls such as Amazon Basics, while an extended roll holder brings the filament roll closer to the center.





The M9x12 screw is not necessary, it only makes sense to use it to prevent vibrations of the spool holder.





Note that the top cover plate of the printer column must be removed by loosening the 2 screws in order to insert the coil holder.
details:

100% speed, 4 walls, layer thickness 0.1 mm, line width 0.4 mm, infill 25% Gyroid (Cura).

name: 2"  TUBING NOTCH GUIDE PACK
description:
This is a pack of tools for notching tubing 2" (50.8mm) in diameter and also drawing centerlines on them and attaching them to a tube of the same size.

Use the guide to mark the tube and then remove the material which is not covered by the 3D printed tool, the tube will then perfectly mate with the other tube at the selected angle, it has slots at 10 degree intervals so it can be aligned with the centerline drawn on a tube or angled to suit your needs.

There are two versions of the centerline tool, one will mark two centerline at 180 degrees from the other, the second will draw three lines at 90 degrees from the other, it will accept a pen up to 14mm in diameter and uses an M4 x 20mm bolt to fix the pens, using a lighter or soldering iron heat the bolt and then thread into to hole to make the threads, I have included knurled knobs to fix to either a hex or allen bolt for ease of adjustment without the use of tools(If a larger size bolt is wanted please message me)

name: GRINDER BOO
description:
Today we present you a grinder designed to be 3D printed consisting of three parts: the body, divided into two parts and the lid. This grinder has been carefully designed and adjusted with all the necessary tolerances to ensure functionality and ease of use.





The grinder body features an ergonomic and elegant design that fits perfectly in the hand. It has a diameter of 50 mm and a height of 31 mm, making it large enough to grind large quantities of herbs, but small enough to be portable and discreet.





The grinder body is designed with a series of sharp teeth that are capable of grinding the herb with incredible efficiency. The teeth are strategically placed to allow for even and fast grinding. In addition, the lid has a flat surface that can be used as a base for loading the grinder.





Both parts of the grinder are designed to fit together perfectly, ensuring that the herb is ground evenly and smoothly. The lid fits the body with an internal and external thread, allowing for secure and easy closure.





One of the best features of this grinder is that it is designed to be 3D printed, which means you can print it on your own 3D printer at home. All you need is the design file, which is available online, and a 3D printer. Printing the grinder is easy and quick, allowing you to get a customized grinder in no time.

Supports: no supports are required to print these parts as they are designed to be printed without supports.
