name: MS-3 / MC-3 Anti-Lift Landmine – Full & Cutaway 3D Model
description:
Highly accurate and fully detailed representation of the MS-3 Anti-Lift Landmine to your training aids, ordnance collection, or instructional displays. This download includes both a complete external model and a full internal cutaway, showcasing the mechanical anti-lift and anti-disturbance components that make the MS-3 an effective booby-trap landmine.

The MS-3 is a mechanically triggered anti-handling device designed to initiate when lifted, moved, or disturbed—making it a common hazard for EOD technicians across multiple conflict zones. This 3D model recreates the internal striker assembly, shear components, springs, and pressure plate geometry with high accuracy.

Included Files
Full Version

Complete external MS-3 body

Correct top pressure plate profile

Threaded fuze section

Reinforced casing geometry

Ideal for display, inert racks, or technical demonstration.

Cutaway Version

Includes:

Striker assembly

Internal spring seats

Shear/locking elements

Housing and cavity layout

Lead strip blocking elements

Perfect for training, instruction, and hands-on visualization.

Mechanical Requirements (For Full Internal Function)

To complete the internal assemblies, the following material additions are recommended:

2.5 mm metal rod × 53 mm (Striker rod)

Music wire Cutting Trigger wire

Lead strips blocker 

14 mm × 0.5 × 10 mm spring 

8 mm × 0.5 × 20 mm spring 

These components allow the fuze simulation to move similarly to the real mechanism.

Historical Background

The MS-3 Anti-Lift Mine is a Soviet-designed mechanical anti-handling device intended to detonate when a victim or EOD technician attempts to lift, tilt, or disturb an object. Often used beneath larger mines or ordnance items, the MS-3 was deployed extensively throughout Cold War conflict areas, where it became known for its simplicity, reliability, and unpredictable activation behavior.

Its internal design uses:

A striker held under spring tension

A mechanical release triggered by upward movement

Lead or soft metal blocking strips to delay or prevent safe handling

A compact fuze body compatible with multiple munition types

Because of its anti-lift nature, the MS-3 posed a serious threat during clearance operations and remains a valuable training reference for modern EOD personnel.

name: Make Your Own Dual Color Filament
description:
This model allows you to make **your own dual color filament at home** using your 3D printer.

The design is based on a **spiral layout** that generates more than several meters of filament, enabling you to combine two or more colors in a single strand. By changing filament colors at specific layer heights during the print, you can create **unique, custom patterns and color transitions** that are impossible to achieve with standard filaments.

To ensure maximum compatibility, this model will be provided in multiple versions, designed to fit a wide range of build plate sizes — from compact printers like the **Bambu Lab A1 mini** to large-format machines H2S and others.

## Key Features

 - Generates several meters of dual color filament;
 - Spiral design optimized for efficient build plate usage;
 - Supports manual or automatic filament changes;
 - Multiple versions optimized for different build plate sizes. More versions will be released in future updates, as each pattern requires precise design and calibration;;
 - Ideal for creating exclusive and custom filament patterns

This model gives you full control over the final appearance of your filament — your creativity is the only limit.

> This may seem unnecessary at first, since dual color filaments are already available on the market. However, the goal here is to give you full freedom to create your own patterns — combinations that the market simply does not offer. You can control color proportions such as 50/50, 70/30, or any custom ratio, and even experiment with more than two colors. This model enables you to explore color combinations and patterns that have never been imagined or offered by the industry.


## Reference Table

| Size name | Build Plate Dimensions | Generated Lenght
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| Mini | 18cm x 18cm | >8m |
| Standard | 22cm x 22cm | >9.5m |
| Medium | 25cm x 25cm | >11m |
| Large | 30cm x 30cm | >13m |
| XL | 35cm x 35cm | >17m |

> For Creality printers, it is recommended to increase the "Brim-object gap" from 0.2 mm to 0.3 mm to improve print removal and avoid adhesion issues.  Alternatively, you can adjust the “Elephant Foot Compensation” value. When the brim adheres too strongly to the model and becomes difficult to remove, increasing this setting helps reduce the contact area, making the brim much easier to detach.

name: NAVAL NAVAL OFFICER
description:
Un oficial de la Armada es un profesional militar de las fuerzas armadas que, tras completar su formación en una academia naval, ocupa una posición de autoridad y liderazgo en la marina. Estos oficiales tienen responsabilidades que incluyen planificar y ejecutar misiones navales, dirigir buques, controlar sistemas de armas, y garantizar la seguridad marítima. 
Funciones principales
Comando y liderazgo: Ejerce el mando de las operaciones navales y lidera a las unidades bajo su responsabilidad.
Planificación de misiones: Elabora y ejecuta planes operativos para diversas misiones, como operaciones de combate, patrullas, asistencia humanitaria o rescate en desastres.
Operaciones navales: Se encarga del manejo de sistemas de armas, navegación y propulsión en buques.
Conducción de buques: Dirige el funcionamiento de las embarcaciones y realiza maniobras en el mar.
Seguridad marítima: Vigila y controla los espacios marítimos para garantizar la seguridad nacional.
Aviación naval: Los oficiales de aviación se aseguran de que las aeronaves de la armada puedan operar de manera segura. 
Formación
La formación de un oficial de la Armada, como la que se imparte en la Escuela Naval Militar, es una carrera profesional para hombres y mujeres que dura varios años, culminando en el grado de Guardiamarina.
Las especialidades incluyen áreas como la navegación de superficie y submarina, ingeniería naval, inteligencia naval y aviación naval.
La carrera puede estar orientada al Cuerpo de Comando, para el liderazgo de las operaciones, o al Cuerpo Profesional, para roles técnicos y administrativos.

name: Newton’s Cradle – Realistic Desktop Motion Toy (3D Model)
description:
This is a realistic 3D model of Newton’s Cradle, a classic desktop physics toy that demonstrates the principle of conservation of momentum and energy.
The design includes:

Five metallic spheres suspended with fine wires.

Yellow rectangular side frames for support.

Black solid base providing stability.

Perfect alignment for realistic motion simulation.


You can use this model for educational demonstrations, mechanical motion studies, or realistic renders.
Model created and rendered using SolidWorks with accurate proportions and clean geometry.

File format: STL / STEP / SLDPRT (editable)
Category: Educational / Physics / Desktop Toy
details:
1. Assembly Overview:
This model represents a Newton’s Cradle consisting of:

Two yellow rectangular frames (supports).

One black rectangular base.

Five metallic balls (stainless steel recommended).

Ten thin suspension wires for ball alignment and motion balance.


2. Printing Recommendations:

Printer type: FDM / SLA.

Material:

Frames: PLA or PETG (yellow filament).

Base: ABS or PLA (black filament, high infill for stability).


Layer height: 0.2 mm.

Infill density: 30–40%.

Supports: Not required for the base; minimal supports for frame tops.

Print orientation:

Base: flat on the bed.

Frames: print vertically for better strength.



3. Post-Processing:

Sand and smooth the printed parts if needed.

Paint or coat the frame and base for a polished look.

Use stainless steel or chrome balls (12–16 mm diameter recommended).

Suspend each ball with thin, equal-length nylon or steel wire for proper alignment.


4. Assembly Steps:

1. Attach both yellow frames to the black base using screws or glue (depending on design).


2. Thread the wires through the frame holes, making sure each pair aligns perfectly.


3. Attach the metallic balls in the center and adjust until all balls touch in a straight line.


4. Test motion by pulling one ball — it should transfer momentum smoothly through the row.



5. Optional Enhancements:

Add small rubber pads under the base to reduce vibration.

Apply clear coat for shine and protection.

Scale the model up or down for different desk sizes.

So I decided to design a shoot that passed thru the table and dumped into a 7.5 gallon trash can. The upper piece mounts to the printer using the existing screws. The piece thru the table I just used some stainless steel cabinet hinge screws. The middle piece is designed as a slip joint so you can slid it up and move your printer around if needed then line it up and slide the middle piece back into the lower shoot.
details: I used 2 walls, 15% gyroid infill, with a 10 mm outer brim.  the upper piece printed standing up right with normal supports, the middle piece i printed upside down no supports, and the lower piece i printed flange side down with no supports. I used olive green PLA+. Because of the height I printed each piece individually.

In this situation, don’t worry: simply go to Settings > Safety > Advanced Safety, then disable the optical sensors to allow the drone to descend properly.

Any misuse or incident resulting from improper installation will not be covered.

This was originally designed to hold a 6ft ladder on the side of the box, but is a versatile accessory to be used to hold whatever you may need in the moment. 

The mount is comprised of 2 pieces ( Rail mount and Hanger arm).
This design allows installation on any standard Milwaukee Packout box corner rail. You can install a single set to hold/hang tools or cables. Or install 2 or more to handle larger items like a 6 foot ladder. 

The mount can pivot to the box making a low profile when not in use. 

Install is relatively easy. Just need to remove the metal side rail from the box and slide the rail thought the rail mount cutout. 
Once this is done the hanger arm can be installed with a bolt, cotter pin, or what ever you may find works. 
 As a reference, the holes on both pieces are 8mm in diameter.

Feel free to share your makes and feedback as well as check out our other Packout designs here;

https://cults3d.com/en/design-collections/Atomic888/milwaukee-packout-accessories

name: 2.00 Inch Pie Cut Jigs 9 & 15 Degree
description:
This kit is cutting straight tube into pie cut sections to then make custom bends for those tight and intricate jobs, or to show off your skills in fabrication and welding, these jigs will enable the ease of cutting and repeating for as many pieces as needed.

The jig will fit inside the clamp of the saw, it also uses the compression from the clamp to then grab a hold of the tube. Adjust the angle of the blade to match the jig and its ready to go.

There are included centerline markers for all the included tubing diameters.

I have included an excell sheet which calculates how much the tube needs to protrude from the jig for a given centerline radius, this can then be set up on a vernier gauge and perfectly symmetrical pie cuts can then be produced.

how to use jigs:
Use the included centerline markers two draw two lines down your tubing 180 degrees apart. You can use the 3 line version which are 90 degrees apart each, this will then give you a reference to measure with the vernier gauge to cut the pieces exactly the same.

Use the calculator to work out how far out the tube needs to protrude from the jig.

Fit the tube into the jig, then into clamp on the saw, make sure the engled cut slides up to the blade

Tighten the clamp down so it is just gripping the tube, adjust the amount of material to be removed to get your first angle,make the first cut, the piece that was removed will make up for the first cut

To cut the first pie section, loosen the clamp, and then roll the tube 180 degrees, set the material to be cut, then tighten back down and make a cut, repeat this for the desired amount of pie cuts.


Included Tubing diameters and angles:
(Matching centerline markers also included)

name: 3D Printed Wind Turbine - STEPSTL3D
description:
This project comes from my TikTok account STEPSTL3D, where I share unique 3D printed designs and builds. The idea for this turbine started when I realized I could use miter gears to transfer the horizontal rotation of turbine blades into vertical rotation. This breakthrough allowed me to design a turbine body that contains no electronics or metal components, making it completely weather-friendly and capable of being placed outdoors without worrying about rust or water damage inside the turbine body.


By converting the rotation into a vertical axis, the turbine design is highly adaptable. It can be easily modified to fit different motor sizes, depending on what’s available at retail, which makes it practical for hobbyists and makers with varying setups.


The larger turbine parts are designed with big 3D printers in mind, such as the Creality K2 Max, Ender 3 V3 Plus, or CR-10. If the parts “13 - Fin” and “16 - Turbine Blade” don't fit on your print bed, I’ve also included those parts as STEP files if you choose to modify them in a CAD software of your choice.


I hope you enjoy building this turbine as much as I enjoyed designing it—it was both a fun and challenging project. The ZIP file includes all components and instructions needed to assemble the turbine. You will also need 40 airsoft BB's and 23, 10mm BB's and a motor (linked in the PDF).

name: ARGENTINE ARMY 4x4 AMBULANCE
description:
La fijación de la estructura al chasis del vehículo se realizó mediante bulones de acero M12 con paso 1.50, clase de calidad 12.9. Se usaron arandelas biseladas de 12mm y tuercas autofrenantes de 12mm con paso de 1.50. Los puntos de fijación coinciden con los ocho soportes originales del vehículo.

Los paneles que conforman la estructura del módulo consisten en dos caras de PRFV. Todos los paneles cuentan con una capa de 30mm de poliuretano. Los paneles están vinculados entre sí a través de perfiles de aluminio extruido de diseño propio.

En el techo cuenta con una claraboya expulsable de 500x500 mm, que funciona como salida de emergencia. Todo el módulo tiene una instalación eléctrica independiente a la del vehículo base, construida con cable antillama normalizado, con protectores y terminales de calidad automotriz. Cuenta con tomas interiores de 12 volt (normalizados) y una toma interior-exterior de 220 volt, con interruptor de protección.

En el techo se instaló un deflector aerodinámico, con cavidad para colocar un barral de luces. El barral sonoro-lumínico de la ambulancia cuenta con cúpulas construidas en policarbonato inyectado y está compuesto por luces sistema led trióptico de alta luminosidad, sirena electrónica microprocesada de 16 tonos diferenciados, 100 watt de potencia y megáfono con micrófono de palma.

Cada ambulancia se entregó con dos tubos de oxígeno de 2m3 con su correspondiente soporte y válvula. name: Mercedes GLC luggage cover universal (left-right) bumper top_bottom mountable
description:
This is a custom-designed, 3D printed stopper for the luggage compartment cover (cargo blind) of the Mercedes GLC. The part serves as a direct replacement for the factory unit and is designed to act as a robust end stop, ensuring the cargo cover stays in place during everyday use.

The model is printed from durable material to withstand repeated loading, making it a reliable alternative to the original part. The fit is precise, and installation involves just a few simple steps—no modifications needed. This solution is practical for those looking for an affordable and strong replacement if the factory stopper is damaged or lost. With its strength and tailored design, it can be a long-lasting fix for a common issue in the Mercedes GLC trunk cover system.

This 3D printed stopper for the Mercedes GLC luggage compartment cover is designed to be universal, so it can be used on both the left and right side of the cargo blind. The set includes two versions for mounting: one that attaches from above and one that can be fixed from below, making installation flexible depending on the situation.

Thanks to its mirrored, symmetrical design, the stopper is interchangeable for either side, making it a practical choice when replacing lost or broken factory parts. The mounting options provide extra convenience, helping users adapt to different attachment needs in the trunk area of the GLC. Both types are made to fit securely and stay durable with repeated use.

name: Compact cabinet with door and rotary lock - 3D printable furniture
description:
Voici une armoire compacte entièrement imprimable en 3D, conçue pour le rangement sécurisé d’objets personnels, de fournitures ou d’outils. Ce modèle comprend :

un corps d’armoire monobloc avec étagères intégrées,

une porte articulée,

un système de verrouillage rotatif avec loquet intérieur.

Idéale pour un usage dans un atelier, un bureau, ou un espace de travail domestique, cette armoire allie design fonctionnel et impression optimisée.
Ce projet complet vous permet d’imprimer votre propre armoire fonctionnelle en 3D, pièce par pièce, incluant :

le caisson principal,

une porte séparée,

des charnières imprimables à assembler,

un système de fermeture rotatif avec loquet mécanique.

Idéal pour un atelier, un espace maker ou un usage domestique, ce meuble offre une solution de rangement durable, personnalisable et sans pièces métalliques.

✅ Contenu du projet :
🟦 Caisson d’armoire avec étagères intégrées,
🟩 Porte imprimable à part,
🟧 Charnières à imprimer séparément (pivot + support),
⚙️ une poignée rotative avec système de verrouillage intégré,
et une vis centrale qui bloque le mécanisme de fermeture.


📐 Dimensions approximatives :
Hauteur : 252mm
Largeur : 150mm
Profondeur : 173mm
details:
Matériaux : PLA+ ou PETG (ABS possible pour usage intensif)

Remplissage :
Corps : 20 à 30 %

Poignée / loquet : 50 % minimum

Supports : selon orientation de certaines pièces (poignée et loquet notamment)

Buse : 0,4 mm recommandée

🛠️ Étapes de montage :

Imprimez chaque pièce séparément : caisson, porte, charnières, loquet, poignée.

Assemblez les charnières sur la porte et le caisson.

Fixez la porte sur le caisson via les pivots prévus.

Montez la poignée rotative à l’avant de la porte.

Installez le loquet à l’intérieur, aligné avec la poignée.

💬 Astuce : Un léger ponçage ou un ajustement via slicer peut améliorer les emboîtements selon les tolérances de votre imprimante.

name: CellPack Converter (Lead-acid battery to Lipo)
description:
**Battery Format Converter** is a 3D-printed modular system designed to transform cylindrical lithium-ion cells (18650/21700) into a standardized rectangular battery format. This project bridges the gap between modern Li-ion cell packs and traditional rectangular batteries (such as SLA or LiFePO₄ cases), making it possible to replace, upgrade, or prototype energy storage solutions while keeping compatibility with existing housings and devices.

[The Complete Guide To A Battery Management System](https://cmbatteries.com/the-complete-guide-to-a-battery-management-system/)

- **Mechanical stability**: Keeps cells firmly aligned and protected.  
- **Format compatibility**: Matches the dimensions of rectangular batteries commonly used in electronics, UPS, or small vehicles.  
- **Modularity**: Easily customizable for different series/parallel configurations and voltages.  
- **Open-source flexibility**: Can be adapted to different cell sizes or case requirements.
details:
# Assembly Specification – 3S Li-Ion Pack with BMS

## 📦 Components
- **9x Li-ion cells (18650 or 21700)**, 3.6–3.7 V nominal each.  
  - Configuration: **3S3P** → 3 groups in series, each group with 3 cells in parallel.  
  - Voltage range: 9.0 V (empty) → 12.6 V (full).  
  - Nominal voltage: ~11.1 V (close to 12 V SLA).  
- **BMS 3S (Battery Management System)**  
  - Provides overcharge, over-discharge, short-circuit and balance protection.  
  - Current rating according to load (e.g. 20–30 A).  
- **3D-printed case** with external terminals compatible with SLA battery housings.  
- **Wiring & nickel strips** (for spot-welding or soldering).  
- **Fuse** and optional **switch** for safety.

description:
🇮🇹 **Inclina Collettore per Minarelli Orizzontale – Modello 3D Sperimentale con Deflusso Ottimizzato**

Questo è un componente **sperimentale e ottimizzato** per motori Minarelli orizzontali a 2 tempi (50cc), progettato per garantire una **migliore fluidodinamica** rispetto alle soluzioni aftermarket più comuni.

Il collettore è stato **modellato con una geometria progressiva**, passando da un ingresso **circolare** (carburatore) a un'uscita **rettangolare** (pacco lamellare), eliminando completamente gli scalini che normalmente causano turbolenze nell’aspirazione. A differenza dei sistemi tradizionali, come quelli forniti da Malossi (che includono un adattatore per il deflusso), questa soluzione integra direttamente una **transizione perfetta e più efficiente** all’interno della struttura stessa.

✅ **Punti di forza:**
- Nessuno scalino nella zona di passaggio aria → flusso più regolare
- Superficie di appoggio precisa su collettore e pacco lamellare
- Geometria lineare e inclinata mantenuta lungo tutta la superficie
- Compatibile con **qualsiasi pacco lamellare** standard per Minarelli orizzontale
- Progettato per massimizzare le prestazioni in aspirazione

📐 Specifiche tecniche:
- File STL per stampa 3D (FDM)
- Consigliati materiali resistenti al calore: PETG, ABS, Nylon
- Installazione semplice con viteria e guarnizioni standard

🇬🇧 **Tilted Intake Manifold for Horizontal Minarelli Engines – Experimental 3D Model with Integrated Flow Smoothing**

This is an **experimental intake manifold**, designed for horizontal Minarelli 2-stroke engines (50cc), engineered to significantly **improve airflow smoothness** compared to standard or aftermarket solutions.

The internal geometry transitions smoothly from a **circular intake (carburetor)** to a **rectangular outlet (reed valve block)**, eliminating sharp steps that typically disrupt the airflow. Unlike systems like Malossi’s, which include a deflector insert, this model **integrates a more efficient internal flow guide** directly into the manifold body.

✅ **Key Features:**
- No airflow steps or turbulence zones

name: Harris Falcon ANPRC-152A
description:
El Harris Falcon III AN/PRC-152A es una radio de combate táctica portátil y definida por software, fabricada por L3Harris, que permite la comunicación simultánea de voz, video y datos de alta velocidad. Esta radio utiliza formas de onda de próxima generación para crear redes ad-hoc y autorreparadoras, lo que la hace adaptable para los soldados en movimiento, con certificaciones de la NSA para la transmisión de datos de alto secreto. 
Características clave:
Diseño compacto y portátil: Es un dispositivo de mano diseñado para la movilidad de los soldados en el campo. 
Comunicación de alta velocidad: Transmite simultáneamente voz, video y datos de banda ancha. 
Redes ad-hoc: Utiliza formas de onda de red de banda ancha, como la Soldier Radio Waveform (SRW) y Harris Adaptive Networking Wideband Waveform (ANW2®C), para capacidades de red auto-organizadas y flexibles. 
Definida por software: Su naturaleza definida por software y su cumplimiento con la Arquitectura de Comunicaciones de Software (SCA) del Joint Tactical Radio System (JTRS) le otorgan gran versatilidad y adaptabilidad. 
Seguridad de alto nivel: Cuenta con la certificación de la NSA para la transmisión de datos clasificados de "Top Secret". 
Multimisión: Es una radio multimisión capaz de operar con tecnologías de banda ancha. 
Interoperabilidad: Permite la conexión con sistemas de banda ancha, heredados y de seguridad pública.

name: 2. NISSAN LEAF ZE1 CHARGE PLUG LOCK GEAR WITH Ø 4.2 X 5 MM HOLE FOR FOR A STEEL SHAFT replacement part
description:
The 3D model “Nissan LEAF ZE1 Charge Plug Lock Gear with Ø4.2 × 5 mm hole for a steel shaft” is an upgraded version of the original component, designed for maximum durability and longevity. Instead of the fragile plastic shaft that commonly breaks under stress in the factory gear, this redesigned model features a precision hole (Ø4.2 × 5 mm) for inserting a metal shaft. By allowing the use of a strong metal insert, the risk of breakage is reduced to virtually 0%, making the part far more reliable in the long term. This modification effectively eliminates the common failure of the Nissan LEAF ZE1 charging port locking mechanism, providing a dependable and cost-effective solution for restoring proper function to the system.

This upgraded gear, when paired with a metal shaft insert and printed in a strong engineering filament, is a practical, durable, and fully tested solution for restoring the functionality of the LEAF’s charge port locking mechanism.
details:
3D PRINTING SETTINGS

"Nissan LEAF ZE1 Charge Plug Lock Gear with Ø4.2 × 5 mm hole for a steel shaft" has been thoroughly tested and can be successfully 3D printed using PLA filament, thanks to its reinforced design. The weak points of the original gear have been structurally redesigned to accommodate the metal shaft and prevent breakage entirely.

However, for best durability and long-term performance, especially for functional gears, it is recommended to print using engineering-grade filaments such as nylon (PA), or polycarbonate (PC). These materials provide superior strength, wear resistance, and flexibility compared to PLA.
It is not recommended to print with PETG, as it will break quickly due to its hardness and brittleness.
When printed with unsuitable materials, gear teeth are prone to frequent breakage, significantly reducing durability and reliability.
For best detail, it is recommended to print with a 0.2 mm nozzle, though a 0.4 mm nozzle is also suitable and provides good results.
Make sure to set the correct orientation of the gear in your slicer to ensure the print is strong and long-lasting.

Capacidad de carga: Puede transportar hasta 7 toneladas (15,000 libras) en carretera y 7.1 toneladas (15,652 libras) fuera de ella.

Motor: Utiliza un motor Caterpillar C12 de 11.9 litros y 425 caballos de fuerza. 
Transmisión: Cuenta con una transmisión automática Allison. 
Versiones: Además del MK23, existen otras variantes como el MK25 (con cabrestante) y el MK27 (con distancia entre ejes extendida). 
Usos: Se utiliza para transportar personal, equipo y suministros. 
Durabilidad: Está diseñado para ser duradero y operar en condiciones climáticas difíciles. 
Transporte aéreo: Puede ser transportado por aire, por ejemplo, en aviones C-130 Hercules.

description:
This is a custom-designed open-style case for the Leatherman ARC multitool, providing quick and easy access without the need for a flap or closure system. The design ensures the multitool is securely held in place while allowing fast retrieval during use.

Key features:

Quick-Access Open Design – No flap, snap, or zipper, allowing for rapid deployment of the multitool.

Precision Fit – Contoured internal geometry keeps the ARC firmly in place while minimizing movement.

Lightweight & Durable – Optimized wall thickness and internal supports for strength without excess weight.

Optimized for 3D Printing – Minimal overhangs and strong layer orientation for maximum print durability.

details:

Material: ABS (recommended for strength and heat resistance)

Layer Height: 0.2 mm

Perimeters/Walls: 5 walls for maximum durability

Infill: 30% (Grid or Gyroid recommended for balanced strength and weight)

Supports: Tree supports enabled, oriented as shown in the reference picture at 45° tilt for optimal surface quality and minimal scarring.

Bed Temperature: 100–110 °C (for good adhesion)

Nozzle Temperature: 240–250 °C (depending on filament brand)

Cooling: Minimal or off to prevent warping

Notes:

Print in an enclosed printer to reduce ABS warping and improve dimensional stability.

Printing at 45° with tree supports ensures clean overhangs, stronger layer bonding, and reduced post-processing.

Optional: acetone vapor smoothing can improve strength and give a premium finish.

This model is intended for personal carry — not a food-contact item.

name: airbankpump adapter for aliexpress pump kitesurf duotone
description:
This adapter is required for pumps that don't have a Duotone or old North kiteboard inflation connection.
It's designed for the Airbank pump thread and allows you to use the inflation hose from a Duotone kiteboard pump.
It's required for all electric pumps sold on AliExpress that don't have the Duotone kiteboard inflation adapter.
It's assumed that the thread of the pumps sold on AliExpress is identical to that of the Airbankpump, as I was able to verify with a pump purchased on AliExpress.
If there are air leaks, we recommend using Teflon tape for plumbing to easily resolve the problem.
This usually happens if the printer doesn't match the file dimensions, and the deviation is usually small, which causes small, negligible leaks. In some cases, two or three turns of Teflon tape can resolve the issue.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Questo adattatore e' necessario per quelle pompe che non possiedono un attacco per gonfiare kitesurf della duotone o vecchia north.
E' progettato su un filetto della pompa airbankpump e offre la possibilita di utilizzare il tubo di gonfiaggio di una pompa da kitesurf della duotone.
E' necessario per tutte quelle pompe elettriche vendute su aliepress che non possiedono l'adattatore della duotone per il gonfiaggio del kitesurf.
Si presume che il filetto delle pompe vendute su aliexpress sia identico a quello della pompa airbankpump come ho potuto testare su di una pompa comprata su aliexpress.
Nel caso ci siano delle perdite di aria, si consiglia per risolvere facilmente il problema di utilizzare del nastro di Teflon per idraulica.
Di solito questo accade se la stampante non rispetta le dimensioni del file e di solito lo scostamento è poco il che genera piccole perdite trascurabili o nel caso con due o tre giri di nastro di teflon la situazione si risolve.

name: EXPLOSIVES SPECIALIST
description:
Un desactivador de bombas, también conocido como especialista en eliminación de artefactos explosivos (EOD), es un profesional altamente capacitado que se especializa en la identificación, desactivación y eliminación segura de artefactos explosivos. En España, a estos profesionales se les conoce como TEDAX (Técnico Especialista en Desactivación de Artefactos Explosivos). 
Funciones principales:
Identificación:
Determinar el tipo de artefacto explosivo y su potencial de peligro.
Desactivación:
Utilizar técnicas especializadas y herramientas para neutralizar el artefacto explosivo.
Eliminación:
Retirar o destruir el artefacto de forma segura, evitando daños o lesiones.
Investigación:
Analizar los artefactos explosivos encontrados para ayudar en investigaciones futuras. 
Formación y entrenamiento:
Los desactivadores de bombas reciben entrenamiento intensivo en física, química, explosivos y técnicas de desactivación.
También se entrenan en el uso de equipos especializados, como trajes de protección y robots de desactivación.
Deben mantener un alto nivel de competencia y mantenerse actualizados sobre las últimas técnicas y tecnologías en desactivación de bombas. 
Riesgos:
La desactivación de bombas es una profesión de alto riesgo, ya que implica trabajar con artefactos explosivos que pueden detonar en cualquier momento.
Los desactivadores de bombas deben ser extremadamente cuidadosos y metódicos en su trabajo para minimizar los riesgos.
A pesar de los riesgos, estos profesionales son esenciales para la seguridad pública y la protección de la vida humana. 
Ejemplos en la cultura popular:
La película "The Hurt Locker" muestra el trabajo de un equipo de desactivación de bombas en Irak.
En series como "CSI", a menudo aparecen personajes que trabajan en la desactivación de artefactos explosivos.
La figura del desactivador de bombas es a menudo retratada como un héroe valiente y habilidoso.

name: AR-15 to Model 60 .22lr Stock V3 (Get Railed Edition)
description:
Allows the use of a Ar-15 Stock and Grip to be mounted to a Glenfield Marlin Model 60 - .22lr rifle as a replacement stock.

-- Now Upgraded with Picatinny Rails --

You will need 4 steel rods as pins to glue side A and B print together. Rod size must be 3mm diameter by 60mm long. Use a good Super Glue or other Cyanoacrylate Glue to assemble.
details:
Tested by printing on a resin printer but should work for FDM as well. This print is vary heavy! Use lots of supports if you print in resin.

(For resin printing) - Place (Part B) so the rifle cutout is facing the bead of the printer at a 45 degree angle and use heavy tree supports with a 80% density. Place (Part A) the same way so the threads and grip mount are at the top of the print. This way the thread pocket will not create a suction effect and ruin the print. details:
This is be printed with 100% infill.

The battery holder requires 3X M3 8mm bolts.

The holes are to be self-tapped using the M3 bolt.  When self-tapping, try to screw in 1/4 of the way and then unscrew the bolt and clean away the excess material.  Continue this approach until the screw is all the way though.  If you try to tap all the way through in one go then you risk cracking the 3D print (depending on how well your layer adhesion is)

For the hole where the latch goes, only tap this a maximum of 4mm in as the bolt will bottom out at 5mm.

This new part you just cut rubber mount to remove the elastic band out of the original, and then slide in the loops to the elastic band and snap them into sides of the mount. If you need to remove the band from the mount, pinch the sides of the loop together to release the clips and it will come off. name: Nosfet Aero Wedgie & Heel Grab
description:
This is my minimalist design to keep you locked in and comfortable on your beautiful yet powerful Nosfet Aero Electric Unicycle.

As we know the Aero comes with pads however they are very large for the Aero's size and cover up most of the looks of the Aero.

I have found that this wheel is very easy to leverage and very powerful thus not needing power and brake pads however with no pads you have no way to stay locked onto the wheels pedals for hoping and jumping,. This is where my Wedgie & Heel Grab come in!

The Wedgie is an innovative jump pad with a base plate that is large enough to stay attached to the wheel, matches the lower body curves with a protrusion of 85mm, ergonomic curve and under grips it is guaranteed to keep your feet on the pedals! As well all know a jump pad cant do this alone even with amazing spiked pedals... insert the Heel Grab! A lower heel pad designed to prevent your feet from sliding backwards during any gravity defying maneuvers! Between the Wedgie and the Heel Grab nothing should stop you from blasting through the air with confidence the wheel provides!
details:
Settings are NOT guaranteed as TPU varies on shore hardness, even different brands rated 95A will vary.

name: CZ75 9mm MagExtension GripTexture +4
description:
Je vous présente mon design,
une base de chargeur pour cz75 et autres alternative.
Compatibilité avec version 45acp et 10mm non connue.

L'intérêt de ce design : une extension pour plus de maniabilité, une meilleure prise grâce au forme sur le coté.
L'objectif de charger plus de munitions, sans avoir quelque choses qui dépasse abusivement et en gardant une tension de ressort nécessaire au bon fonctionnement.
Pour les alternative tel que le jericho, tanfoglio... les chargeurs mecgar et autres fabriquant se clips parfois difficilement, du au manque de jeu dans la base plate d'origine. Ce modèle réduis légèrement les dimension afin d'être compatible avec tout les châssis de type CZ75. Une amélioration utile et qui évite de renvoyer sa commande ;)

**Spécification :**

Chargement de **quatre** cartouches supplémentaires.
**Facilité** de montage et démontage (**30sec**).
Un **design original** pour plus de style.
Une **texture en relief** pour un bon grip
Des cotes ajuster pour une **bonne tenue** et pour être imprimer même avec **tout types de filaments** même a faible coût.
Une dimension ajuster pour une tension avec le ressort d'origine suffisante.

**Installation en vidéo :** [1 minute en vidéo c'est bien plus simple ;)] (https://www.veed.io/view/2db9ca51-cb6c-4514-a564-b1b0f4c399ce?panel=share)

**Montage :**

1. Maintenir la plaque de ressort a ras du chargeur.
2. Pousser le chargeur dans l'encoche prévue a cet effet jusqu'en buter avec l'insert.
3. Lever la plaque de ressort pour faire passer l'insert.
4. Continué de glisser le reste du chargeur jusqu'au bout.
5. S'assure que l'insert es bien encaster dans l'encoche.
6. S'il n'est pas dans l'encoche, a l'aide d'un petit tournevis jouer avec la plaque afin qu'il se clipse.

**Démontage :**

1. Pousser l'insert se situant en dessous a l'aide d'un petit tournevis (ou autres du même diamètre).
2. Glisser un tournevis sous la plaque du ressort a travers l'encoche situé a l'arrière.
3. Faire levier jusqu'à ce que la plaque ainsi que le ressort soit a hauteur du chargeur.
4. Tirer le chargeur en arrière en maintenant une pression sous la plaque.
5. Faire passer l'insert par dessus et sortir le tout.

Format des fichier et style (4 modèles) :
Version Simple
Piece pour grip Exterieur/Interieur
Version Bonus Gravé 9mm sur les cotés.



**⚠︎** *Possibilité d'imprimé a plat si utilisation de PLA "plus/pro" Avec une température maximale et sans refroidissement.* **⚠︎**
**⚠︎** *Imprimer face avant vers le haut au risque de voir le chargeur se vidé par le bas...* **⚠︎**
**⚠︎** *Impression en résine déconseillé du au contrainte exercer.* **⚠︎**


*Pour toute question allez sur le lien sur mon profil.*

description:
HELLO AGAIN!

This was an interesting one- 
Recently the blower fan blades shattered in my camper AC unit. 
I took as many measurements as possible and duplicated the fan based on those measurements. 

This fits most common D shaft Dometic style AC units

Its been multiple days in the June/SC heat and it runs the same as it did before!
I searched for a file for one first and didn't find one so here we are!

This is meant to be a temporary fix but can be made to be more permeant depending on your print quality and material choice. Please use at your own risk- to be fair the replacements are cheap. This could save you from a hot waiting period though.
details:
*THIS IS ORIGINALLY PRINTED IN PETG- MAKE SURE TO PRINT STRONG*

Increase wall thickness from .4 to .5 on all perimeters,
increase wall count from 3 to 4, 
Increase infill to 20% (i used grid infill)
Support required- I used Organic supports to reduce filament use

To increase heat resistance, add rigidity, and structural integrity I coated the part in UV resin (Sanded, brush coated with Printing resin, cured, washed, and repeated 3 times focusing mainly on the fins and joints)

If its a tight fit- add a touch of grease and/or lightly sand the shaft hole

The Aerodrink Tilt Bracket takes a minimalist approach to provide maximum versatility for an between-the-arms bottle mount. The low weight, high retention, and setback mount point give you everything you need and nothing you don't.

The mount is offset so that the center point of the bottle can sit well behind the attachment point. This allows the cage and bottle to be set further back on aerobars that would otherwise force the bottle forward to the point of being inaccessible.

The mount features a slightly dropped 'V' shape to help center it between the extensions and reduce the risk of the bottle interfering with narrow armrest positions. It accommodates a greater range of extension widths than previous models.

Why this bundle?

Because paint collections grow. Most hobbyists use more than one paint brand, and this bundle gives you the flexibility to mix and match trays however you want. It’s also the only version that includes all the latest accessories in one download.

Floral Pattern Clay Roller for Pottery, Polymer Clay, and Crafting

This 3D-printed clay roller is perfect for adding a floral texture to ceramics, polymer clay, pottery slabs, and even baking projects like pastry (if printed with food-safe filament).

🌸 Features:
Embossed floral pattern for rich texture
Printable in PLA, PETG, or resin
Compatible with polymer clay, ceramic clay, fondant, and more
Original 2D grayscale image included (used to generate this roller)

🧱 How it works:
This is a pattern roller: roll it across a clay surface to press the design into the material. The roller was made by wrapping a 2D image around a cylinder and using grayscale depth mapping for extrusion.

⚠️ Note on food use: PLA may be marketed as food-safe, but 3D prints are porous and can harbor bacteria. Please research or apply a food-safe coating if using with food.

🎨 Ideal for:
Clay crafts, pottery tools, ceramic modeling, slab rollers, embossing clay stamps, 3D printed texture rollers

name: 2.00 Inch Y Pipe Jig Set - 60 Degree
description:
This kit is for cutting 2.00" tube and making a Y connection, there are two jigs included to cut all 3 pipes

Each pipe is cut at a 30 degree angle giving a total split of 60 degrees between the two pipes. 

how to use jigs:

Part 1 is used to cut two two merging tubes. 
There are two cuts to be made using this jig and both can be done in the bandsaw, for this a section of tube can be cut at 75mm in length to not waste much tubing, you will need two of these. Bottom the tube in the jig, and then tighten the M8 retaining bolt, make the two cuts and repeat. 

Part 2 is used to cut the singular tube. 
The tube for this jig can be any length as the jig is bottomless, slide over the tube and tighten the M5 bolts evenly, again there are two cuts to make so the other tubes mate up perfectly, you can cut this in the saw or just use as a guide to draw round. 

With all the cuts made the pipes will join perfectly 

Parts included:
2.00 Inch - Part 1 Jig
2.00 Inch - Part 2 Jig
2.00 Inch - Example Y pipe

Extra parts needed:
2 x M5 x 50mm Allen socket head bolt
2 x M5 nut
1 x M8 x 30mm Allen socket bolt
1 x M8 nut


Commercial License available via a tier 1 membership on Patreon: patreon.com/RKDesigns_

Step 1: cut a hole in your box
Step 2: Put your scrap in that box
Step 3: Attach your frame to the box

As always please use eye protection when firing your airsoft replicas

description:

This mod allows to use no Creality beds or the ones that has the cleaner attached to it.

With the help of the magnets it's easy to change the silicone cleaner, take out the Lock part, remove the damage cleaner and insert a new one, no new to remove screws or use glue.

Maybe this mod work for the K1 Max and other variants but I don't have access to them to try it.

You will need to modify the nozzle cleaning position with this coordinates inside the printer.cfg file under "prtouch_v2" settings with this values

clr_noz_start_x: 65
clr_noz_start_y: 222

Save it and restart the printer

Configurações de Impressão 3D para o Cortador e Marcador “Mãe de Pet”

Para garantir uma impressão de qualidade, durabilidade e bom acabamento, siga estas configurações recomendadas:

1️⃣ Tipo de Impressora

✅ Impressora 3D FDM (Filamento) ou SLA (Resina)
✅ Área de impressão mínima: 10x10 cm (dependendo do tamanho desejado)

2️⃣ Configurações para Impressoras FDM (Filamento PLA, PETG, ABS)

Material recomendado: PLA (melhor para alimentos), PETG (mais resistente)

Altura da Camada: 0.2 mm (ou menor para mais detalhes)

Espessura das Paredes: 1.2 mm (mínimo)

Preenchimento: 20-30% (para maior resistência)

Temperatura do Bico: 200-215°C (PLA), 230-250°C (PETG)

Temperatura da Mesa: 60°C (PLA), 80°C (PETG)

Velocidade de Impressão: 40-60 mm/s

Suporte: Desligado (se bem projetado, não precisa)

Adesão à Mesa: Brim ou Raft (para melhor fixação)

 Dicas Extras

✔️ Lixar bordas: Para evitar rebarbas e melhorar o corte na massa
✔️ Higienização: Se for usado para alimentos, lave bem antes do uso
✔️ Armazenamento: Evite calor excessivo para não deformar

Com essas configurações, seu cortador e marcador terão excelente acabamento e precisão nos detalhes!

name: Piston Head
description: A **piston head 3D model** is a digital representation of the top part of a piston, which plays a crucial role in internal combustion engines by compressing the air-fuel mixture and transferring force to the crankshaft. The model typically includes features such as valve reliefs, dome or flat-top surfaces, and cooling channels. If 3D printed, it can be used for educational purposes, engine design prototyping, or mechanical demonstrations. Depending on the material, a printed piston head can serve as a display model, a fitment test piece for engine assemblies, or even a functional component in low-load applications if made from high-temperature-resistant materials.

name: Pen Refill Adapter: Sheaffer K & RB to D1 Mini + Others
description:
I present my pen refill adapters, for use in pens that take either the Sheaffer K refill, the old Sheaffer Ballpoint refill or the Sheaffer Rollerball refill. It allows such pens to use the Mini/Multi D1 refills instead.
The Sheaffer K refill is around 96mm long and 5.5mm in diameter.
The Sheaffer old BP refill is around 96mm long and 6.4mm in diameter.
The Sheaffer RB refill is around 108mm long and 7.8mm in diameter.
The D1 refill is around 67mm long and 2.3mm in diameter.

I appreciate that the D1 refill is generally a less practical refill, , in terms of ink volume. However, there are D1 refills, like the Pilot Hi-Tec-C Slims or Zebra JSB, which are not available in the Sheaffer refill sizes, so this adapter exists to hopefully provide flexibility, between your favourite pens and refills.

I've also included Refill Adapter models for the Sheaffer refills that can take:
Uni Jetstream SXR-80 refill (88mm long and 3.1mm wide),
Pilot Hi-Tec-C Coleto refill (93mm long and 3.1mm wide),
Uni Signo UMR-109 (99mm long and 3.1mm wide),
Fisher PR (89mm long and 4.8mm wide).

A recent addition is the Old Ballpoint to newer K refill adapter; that replaces the coloured plastic tail plug on the K refill with the winged type found on the older versions.

Due to the very varied nature of pen design, I cannot guarantee that this adapter will work with any specific pen, although I've made every effort to make it as universal as possible.

(these adapters used to be sold on Shapeways, in an SLS printed plastic. However since their bankruptcy; I haven't found a viable solution that replicates the service they used to provide, so I'm making them available here)
details: The adapter needs to be printed in resin or SLS plastic. FDM just doesn't have the dimensional accuracy needed (or at least it didn't used to). The D1 refill is held in place, by the adapter, using friction. The holes around the side of the adapter are present to help with the removal of unhardened resin from the core.

name: K2 PLUS - Printing plate holder + 2 front trays + 2 side trays
description:
Con este conjunto de piezas, podrás ampliar la capacidad de tu impresora al incluir un hueco para placas de impresión, así como dos bandejas frontales y dos bandejas laterales. El modelo se asegura en su lugar aprovechando el peso de la impresora y utilizando las patas como guía.

El diseño es coherente con la máquina y altamente funcional, ya que permite almacenar la mayoría de los utensilios de impresión que se utilizan habitualmente. Después de usarlo, se convierte en un elemento casi indispensable.

Piezas a imprimir:
• 4 esquinas
• 2 soportes frontales, 2 bastidores traseros
• 2 bandejas frontales, 2 bandejas laterales
• 4 tiradores largos
• Opcionalmente puedes organizar las bandejas con separadores (se incluyen 9 modelos para combinar)

Personalización: Personaliza el modelo según las piezas que imprimas. Por ejemplo, los frontales: uno en liso y otro con "K2 PLUS" o si lo prefieres piezas en varios colores. También puedes personalizar el interior de los cajones, dejándolos sin separadores o utilizando el modelo exclusivo que permite combinarlos y crear diferentes compartimentos según tus necesidades.

Ensamblaje:  Se realiza con tornillos y tuercas de inserto, lo que hace que sea fácil y robusto. Los tornillos que se utilizan son de cabeza plana con asiento cónico de M3 y 12 mm, y las tuercas de inserto M3 pueden ser de 4 mm o 5 mm.

Instalación:  Primero, comienza uniendo las patas traseras y sus bastidores traseros. Luego, colócalas debajo de las patas traseras de la impresora. Después, monta los soportes de bandejas delanteras junto con sus patas y colócalos bajo las patas delanteras. El modelo se centrará automáticamente con las patas. A continuación, desde los laterales de la impresora, ajusta la unión entre el conjunto de bastidores y soportes, y únelos mediante tornillos. No olvides asegurarte de que la impresora esté nivelada antes de colocar el modelo. ¡Y lo mejor de todo es que la instalación puedes hacerla fácilmente sin necesidad de ayuda!

El tamaño interior de almacenamiento de las bandejas es el siguiente:
•	2 Bandejas frontales: Cada bandeja tiene unas dimensiones de 168 mm de ancho, 283,5 mm de largo y 26 mm de alto. (Caso de no se alojar placas de impresión, hay un margen superior de 13 mm hasta la impresora.)
•	2 Cajones laterales: Tienen unas dimensiones de 40 mm de ancho, 231 mm de largo y 36 mm de alto.
•	1 Alojamiento para placas de impresión: Tiene una altura de 9 mm (cada placa suele tener un grosor de 0,70 mm).

Impresión de modelo: Se imprimió en ABS Sunlu Gris (también puede ser en PLA), y los separadores en Hyper PLA Creality Azul.
Parámetros básicos de impresión:
• Boquilla: 0,40 mm
• Altura de capa: 0,20 mm
• Perímetros: 5
• Capas arriba y abajo: 5
• Densidad de relleno: 40%

Colecciones: https://cults3d.com/es/usuarios/alfmar/modelos-3d

name: Peristaltic pump (by Adam Loose)
description:
Ich habe eine Peristaltikpumpe für einen Hochflexiblen 4x6 Silikonschlauch und 608er Kugellager entwickelt der mit einem Schrittmotor (Nema 17) angetrieben wird, Dateien sind optimiert für einen Resin Drucker. Toleranzen sind sehr eng bemessen, Zubehör an Schrauben M3 & M5 jeweils mit Muttern zum kontern.

Auf Montagelaschen habe ich bewusst verzichtet weil man die Schraubenlöcher eben so gut auf ein Gehäuse übertragen kann und dann einfach längere Schrauben nimmt. Ich habe mich bewusst für Muttern zum Kontern entschieden damit man die Pumpe immer wieder außeinanderschrauben und oder auch die Gewinde tauschen kann.

Bei den Gehäuseschrauben habe ich Formen für die Muttern hinten gelassen, hier würde ich empfehlen die Gehäuse schrauben von der innenseite eines Anbaugehäuses reinzusetzen und
sie dort an der Außenseite mit M5 Muttern zu befestigen dann das Pumpengehäuse von außen auf ihr Anbaugehäuse setzen damit ein Stück gewinde zur Vorderseite am Gehäuse hinausragt, so das man Vorne dann das Gehäuse mit Muttern verschraubt. Das hat den Vorteil das man nur die Mutter lösen muss und nicht die ganze Schraube enfernen muss wo dann anschließend auch noch das Gehäuse rumbaumeln würde wenn man mal den Schlauch wechseln möchte, so bleibt das Gehäuse an Ort und stelle weil es von den Schrauben gehalten wird.

name: AMMO CASE INSERT - 338 LAPUA, To suit "ToolPro"  Case (Small Black 260 X 245 X 175mm) from SupaCheap Auto + elsewhere
description:
This is an Ammo case insert, designed to hold custom reloads of much larger calibres , or simply to store your rounds more neatly and Far more securely. 
The first calibre offered here is the 338 Lapua. (More calibres will be added shortly, and those who have downloaded the files already will be automatically notified and able to download any additional calibres free of charge).

These inserts store all your ammunition very neatly, securely, and provide opportunity to store spent brass once used. The insert should be printed twice, once for each side of the case, thereby allowing people with smaller 3d printers to still print the inserts, for this larger case. It also therefore facilitates storing different calibres in the case if desired (different calibres to be added shortly).

The inserts easily slide into the case, & includes provision for the pressure relief valve.  (Message me if you need a different calibre or if you need different overall dimensions to suit any other containers).

This file is designed to fit into the  "ToolPro" brand / range of tough cases, (specifically their deeper "Small Black", 260 X 245 X 175mm sized tough case). These tough cases are available in Australia from SupaCheap Auto. I will attempt to locate a US distributor and list here also. 

This style container is:
inexpensive (AUD $39.99 at the time of uploading, & often on special)
IP65 rated, water & dust resistant
Heavy duty latches and handle
Pressure relief valve 
Pick and pull foam insert for maximum impact-absorbing protection and customisation
Padlock provision

NOTE: You may choose to place some layers of closed cell foam cut outs, on the inside base of the tough case, before placing the inserts into the case (depending on the COAL, or overall length of your cartridge choice once loaded). The 3d printed inserts can act as a template if you choose to cut out any foam which is ridiculously easy to do. For example I used one of the cheap black foam camping mats to make some additional bases (4 pack of mats for $9), in order to get the height just perfect between the base of my cartridges, and the projectile tips where they just make contact with the built in foam on the underside of the lid. 

NOTE: Manufacturing processes sometimes result in minute size differences in products by manufacturing companies, such as the ToolPro Tough Case type containers. This simply means that sometimes the 3d printed inserts will slip into the case easily, and other times they will be a very snug fit. This does not affect the functionality of these 3d Printed ammo inserts at all. If you have any questions, please feel free to send me a message at any time and I'll endeavour to respond as quickly as I can.

name: 76.2 mm 3 in 90° Straight Pipe Cutting Guide STL – Angle Grinder Marking Template
description:
3D printable marking template for making a straight 90-degree cut on a 76.2 mm (3 in) outside diameter pipe.

The template slides directly onto the pipe and provides a clear guide for marking a square cutting line around the entire circumference.

Place the template where the pipe must be cut, trace around its edge with a marker, move the template away and cut along the marked line using an angle grinder.

This practical manual tool is ideal when a band saw, cold saw, pipe cutter or other specialised cutting equipment is not available.

Designed for exhaust fabrication, stainless steel tubing, intercooler piping, roll cages, custom automotive projects, welding workshops and general metal fabrication.

The model is designed specifically for tubing with a 76.2 mm (3 in) outside diameter.

This is a digital STL file only. No physical template, pipe, marker or cutting tool is included.
details:
Recommended 3D printing settings:

- 2 perimeters
- 15% infill
- Supports are not required
- PLA, PETG, ABS or ASA can be used
- Print at 100% scale
- Check printer calibration before printing

The template is designed for pipe with a 76.2 mm (3 in) outside diameter.

To use the template:

1. Slide the template onto the pipe.
2. Position it exactly where the pipe must be cut.
3. Trace around the edge with a permanent marker.
4. Move or remove the template.
5. Cut carefully along the marked line using an angle grinder.
6. Deburr and finish the pipe after cutting.

Always verify the fit on your pipe before use. Actual pipe diameter and 3D printer tolerances may vary slightly.

Wear suitable eye, hand, hearing and respiratory protection when cutting metal.

name: Automatic Turntable for 3D scanning
description: I designed a turntable for 3D scanning using an iPhone. What makes this table different from others on the market? In this case, the scanner is a moving part and the scanned object is stationary. Thanks to this design, scanning with an iPhone is simpler and more effective. The table was designed to work with a 28BYJ-48 stepper motor controlled by Arduino Uno. The mounting holes have a diameter of 6 mm and in my finished project I used M6 x 30 steel screws and M6 nuts purchased in a construction store. I designed handles for them that make it easier to screw them together without the need to use tools.
details:
Assembly is very easy. The only thing you need to bring is at least 4 M6 screws and nuts to attach the "adapter", a phone stand and a counterweight basket. The counterweight basket is used to level the gear ring after mounting the phone on one side. You can put screws there, for example, to level it.  The stepper motor is mounted in a designated place on the table base. There is no need to screw it on, but if necessary, the holes are prepared. 

The project was printed and tested with PLA filament on Creality K1 and it works flawlessly

name: Filament dispenser without ball bearing (with PTFE tube)
description:
This design is ideal for anyone looking for an inexpensive, simple solution for the filament dispenser without having to rely on ball bearings or screws. If you already have a PTFE tube (4mm diameter, 16cm length) at home, you can get started straight away and produce the dispenser in no time at all. Due to its good sliding properties, the PTFE tube serves as a very good bearing and allows the filament roll to unroll very smoothly.





The dispenser can hold spools with a diameter of 20 cm (usual for 1 kg spools) and even smaller spools, e.g. 16 cm diameter. The width of the spools can range from approx. 43-72mm and thus cover a very wide range of common spools.





The design is very easy to manufacture as an aid for cutting the PTFE tube to length has also been added. All parts can be assembled without tools. Only a knife is needed to cut the PTFE pipe to length.





If necessary, a PTFE tube can also be attached to the spool as a feed to the 3D printer and guide the filament from the spool to the printer.

name: Electric cabinet key (triangle)
description:
# **Cabinet Key Design**

A **cabinet key** is a specialized tool designed to open specific types of locks found in technical cabinets, utility enclosures, and access panels. These keys are essential for maintenance personnel, technicians, and utility workers who require controlled access to restricted areas.

---

## **What is a Cabinet Key?**
A cabinet key is typically crafted with a unique **triangular, square, or other shaped head** that fits into corresponding locks on cabinets or enclosures. These locks are commonly found in:
- **Electrical panels**
- **Gas and water meter boxes**
- **Utility cabinets**
- **HVAC access panels**
- **Industrial machinery enclosures**

The most common type is the **triangular cabinet key**, featuring a head shaped like an equilateral triangle.

---

## **Purpose and Usage**
Cabinet keys serve several purposes:
- **Restricted access**: Prevent unauthorized tampering with critical systems.
- **Ease of use**: Standardized keys make it simple for authorized personnel to access multiple enclosures.

### **How to Use a Cabinet Key**
1. **Identify the lock type**: Ensure the key matches the shape of the lock (e.g., triangular or square).
2. **Insert the key**: Align the triangular head of the key with the corresponding slot in the lock.
3. **Turn the key**: Apply gentle pressure and rotate to unlock the cabinet.
4. **Access the cabinet**: Open the door or panel to perform necessary maintenance or inspections.
5. **Re-secure the lock**: Once work is complete, lock the cabinet to maintain security.


---

## **Applications**
- **Utility Maintenance**: Used by electricians, plumbers, and utility workers to access control panels and meters.
- **Industrial Access**: Provides controlled access to machinery panels and safety enclosures.
- **Public Infrastructure**: Common in street lighting, telecommunication cabinets, and vending machines.
- **Private Use**: Sometimes used for securing outdoor storage or HVAC units.

---

## **Why Are Cabinet Keys Important?**
Cabinet keys provide a **simple and secure solution** for managing access to critical systems and enclosures. Their standardized designs make them versatile, while their sturdy construction ensures they remain reliable in demanding environments.

Whether you're a professional technician or need a practical solution for occasional use, a cabinet key is an indispensable tool for secure and efficient access.

---

name: Repair inserts for Toyota Avensis T25 tailgate lid cover broke-off screws
description:
These are a set of inserts for Avensis T25 to repair broke-off screw of tailgate lid cover. For compatibility check the first picture. For installation you need 5pcs hex head M6x20 screws and 4pcs normal nuts and 1pc thin nut (DIN439), hand drill machine and 3mm drill bit.
There are some before-after pictures to 
see the expected result.
Recommended installation procedure:
1. Remove the trim strip and unclip the cover on the right side in the direction of travel, clean the area under the cover as needed. Slide the drilling template (triangular element with the small hole) in until it stops.
2. Place the fittings for the other mounting points in such a way that the check marks on each remain visible.
3. Test fit/fix with the four screws. Once the trim strip is in place, the position of the drilling template must also be checked to ensure that the hole to be made exactly coincides with the mounting point on the tailgate. This is not so easy to do due to the limited space, but it is necessary for the screw to be in the exact position. Based on feedback, some people marked it with an alcohol marker, while others checked it by taking a photo with a mobile phone.
4. Remove the trim, pre-drill with a 3mm drill, then remove the template and drill to a final size of 6mm.
5. Insert the triangular fixing element in place of the drilling template. The lid that was snapped off can also be put back in place.
6. Screw the trim loosely into place (it is worth first screwing the screw where the hole was made into place, then putting the nuts in place), and if everything is in place and stands nicely, tighten the screws.

name: dji osmo mobile 6 self-locking carrying case
description:
Descripción del producto:

Presentamos un estuche personalizado para el Osmo Mobile 6 de DJI, diseñado para ofrecer protección y organización óptima. Este estuche, fabricado con tecnología de impresión 3D, combina funcionalidad y estilo para satisfacer las necesidades de creadores y fotógrafos en movimiento.

Protección superior: El diseño incluye sujeciones específicas para inmovilizar el estabilizador desde la parte superior e inferior, garantizando la seguridad del dispositivo durante el transporte.

Espacios adicionales: Integra compartimentos diseñados para almacenar cables, accesorios y notas, manteniendo todo ordenado y a la mano.

Durabilidad y practicidad: Con dos bisagras robustas y un cierre automático confiable, este estuche es resistente al uso diario y asegura un acceso rápido y fácil.

Fabricación personalizada: Impreso en 3D con materiales de alta calidad, combina ligereza y resistencia, además de la posibilidad de personalizar colores o ajustes según tus necesidades.


Perfecto para proteger tu Osmo Mobile 6 y mantener todo organizado, este estuche es ideal para quienes buscan una solución práctica, compacta y moderna.
details:
Caja y herrajes: infill 20% gyroid , wall loops 3, temperatura y velocidad la que  utilices habitualmente, 
Soporte inferior y superior (la que sostiene al estabilizador) 
nfill 5% gyroid , wall loops 2, temperatura y velocidad la que  utilices habitualmente, No se utilizan soportes.
instrucciones de fabricacion:
Piezas a imprimir:
Bisagra.stl 4 unidades
Trabanuevo.stl una unidad y otra en simetría
Trabanuevo1.stl una unidad y otra en simetría.
Cuadrotraba.stl una unidad y otra en simetría.
Junta.stl una unidad
Pieza1chica.stl dos unidades

Djicontratapa.stl una unidad
Dji.stl una unidad


Modo de fabricación y armado del estuche para Osmo Mobile 6

1. Impresión de piezas:

Carcasas exteriores: Imprima primero las carcasas superior e inferior.

Conjunto de herrajes y junta: Continúe imprimiendo las bisagras, trabas, botones y la junta.

Interiores: Finalmente, imprima las piezas interiores que sostendrán el estabilizador en su lugar.

2. Armado del estuche:

Bisagras: Ensamble las bisagras utilizando un trozo de filamento de 1.75 mm como eje. Coloque las bisagras armadas en los compartimientos específicos ubicados en la parte posterior de las carcasas (primero en la carcasa inferior y luego en la superior).

Trabas y botones: Instale las trabas y botones en la parte anterior de las carcasas, asegurándose de que encajen correctamente.

Junta: Coloque la junta en el riel correspondiente de la carcasa inferior. Pegue firmemente con cianocrilato para asegurar su posición.



3. Montaje de los soportes internos:

Carcasa inferior: Coloque la pieza interior que sostiene el Osmo Mobile 6 en la carcasa inferior. No es necesario fijarla con cianocrilato, ya que encajará de manera segura.

Carcasa superior: Pegue con cianocrilato la pieza superior que inmoviliza el estabilizador en la carcasa superior.

Nota: Asegúrese de que todas las piezas queden bien alineadas durante el ensamblaje y permita que el cianocrilato se seque completamente antes de utilizar el estuche. Esto garantizará un ajuste preciso y una protección óptima para su Osmo Mobile 6.

name: K1 Max EZ-Load Bowden Guide
description:
This is a simple Design that mounts to the top-rear corner of the K1 Max's side panel. This modification allows a stable position to feed filament through. Subsequently, reducing tedious loadings of less-forgiving filaments such as TPU. By providing a stable position of the Bowden tube most of the forces from loading the filament are transferred into the filament; not the PTFE tubing run like default. This modification also makes it where the user is not having to hold the slippery PTFE tubing and attempt feeding new filament simultaneously. All around this modification makes loading and unloading filament much easier.

*This modification should work with the regular K1  but is untested as I do not own it. If you print this for the K1 and it works I would love to know!*
*Reviewing photos I do not believe this will fit the K1C as the bolt positions look much closer.*

**BOM**
This print does require purchase of:
2x PC4-M10 pneumatic connectors
1x longer run of PTFE to match your needs
2x M3*8 Button Head Screw (or equivalent)

Pneumatic connectors I used: [link](https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B07RDC3R3R/ref=ppx_yo_dt_b_search_asin_title?ie=UTF8&th=1)
PTFE Tubing I used: [link](https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B01CUPV9KC/ref=ppx_yo_dt_b_search_asin_title?ie=UTF8&th=1)
M3*8 Screws I used: [link](https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B0CP4B16KF/ref=ppx_yo_dt_b_search_asin_title?ie=UTF8&th=1)

**Installation**
Installation of this is straight-forward:
1. Verify no debris or burs are within the internal channel
2. Install 2x Bowden pneumatic connectors
3. Remove 2x M3 screws in the top rear of the K1's plexiglass plate
4. Install guide using 2x M3x8 screws (OEM screws will be too short)
5. Install extended Bowden tube from rear connector of guide to the filament runout sensor (make sure this is not too tight so the bends are smooth)
6. Install input Bowden tube to front connector of guide (Standard length ~8" [203mm])
7. Verify filament goes through new Bowden tubes and guide with no snags or tension

**Version Log**
V2 - First official iteration
V3 - Added geometric patterns to front face
V4 - Added more depth variation to geometric patterns
Update - Added Right side variant of model

I have also made the four main rotation angle markers longer, down the spine, then 90 degrees apart. This is to make it easier when looking at the rotation between sections.

📦2.75" Exhaust Fabrication Kit📦

Professional Modular Mock-Up System (STL Files)


Designing a custom exhaust system can be time-consuming, expensive, and often involves trial and error with costly materials. This 2.75" Exhaust Fabrication Kit eliminates that guesswork by giving you a precise, modular way to plan your entire system before you ever cut or weld metal.

Built for fabricators, performance builders, and serious enthusiasts, this kit allows you to physically mock up full exhaust runs using 3D printed components, accurately test fitment, and fine-tune routing in a controlled, repeatable way.


Every part in the system has been developed with real-world fabrication in mind — from true-to-scale dimensions and centre line radius options, to clearly marked angle increments that let you measure and replicate your design with confidence.


Whether you're building a high-performance system, developing a custom downpipe, or refining complex routing, this kit helps you:

Visualise your build before fabrication
Reduce wasted material and costly mistakes
Accurately transfer designs into metal
Improve speed and workflow efficiency

name: Lattice Generator for Blender Geometry nodes and 3D Printing 3D model
description:
**Note: **Images are Illustrative of what can be accomplished using the nodegroups and do not necessarily show what's in the file.

Blender 4.5+ Compatible

Have you ever seen those cool lattice structures for 3D printing? Perhaps you have an object that you want to make lighter? Perhaps you have used an slicer for FDM printers and love the gyroid infill, but now you want to print something in resin or a powder based printer and find out those options are nowhere to be seen. Maybe you're doing something exotic like RF frequency lenses and want an easy way to make variable gyroids structures! Normally these features are locked within expensive products, which are normally overkill for needs and budget. These geometry node groups are intended to help bring some of these features within the grasp of Blender users. They allow you to use non-destructive workflows, so that you can edit the designs and have the results generated for you.

These are mostly intended for 3d printing applications (especially for powder based printers that can take advantage of the geometry), but can also be used for more typical Blender uses. There is even a voronoi fracture node inside if you can find it!

I intend to add more functionality as time goes on.

So far the geometry nodes include:

Cubic Lattice structures> (Primitive cubic, Body Centred, BCC, Diamond Lattice, Kelvin and Weaire_Phelan Lattices)
Custom Lattice option> If you model a unit cell then it can be used by the suitable node group.
Complete Custom Lattice> Allows the use of a wireframe model to act as the entire lattice inside an object.
Triply Periodic Minimal Surfaces (TPMS)> (Gyroid, Schwarz P, Schwarz Diamond, I-WP, Neovius)
Stochastic Lattice> A random lattice based on a voronoi cell implementation. Open-cell foam, Bone-like organic structure.
An improved hollowing algorithm that works can work with non manifold meshes.
Modifier node> Ability to modify aspects of the Lattices, such as thickness, by using control meshes.
Add holes> Remove holes in exterior for powder removal, or additional light weighting.
Future improvements:

Increased range of modifiers, including unit size. Surface following lattices.

Multiple lattices within an object with seamless transitions. Useful for optimising properties in different areas.

Ease of use and performance optimisations.

Update V1.6

This includes a large number of behind the scenes improvements to increase the performance and reliability. I have also added a warning system which prevents you from accidentally adding voxel and unit cell values that are potentially too high and would cause blender to crash. It is simple to ignore these warnings or add your specific values if you think that your system can handle them.

Update V1.5

Rebuilt stochastic lattice generator with massive performance improvements.

Update V1.4

Various Bug fixes.
Improvement to stochastic lattice generator.

Update V1.3

Added a new isogrid like support that can be added to organic meshes. This allows for thinner walls that are more rigid. In Beta and will be integrated with lattices in later update.

Update V1.2

Added Custom Lattice import. Now you can model an entire lattice as a wireframe and use it to make the printable lattice. Weaire-Phelan structure. An idealised foam structure. Under the 'Cubic' structure options. Improved stochastic lattice. Now with conformal external shell. Fixed bug in 'remove hollows' feature.

Update V1.1

Fixed bug in Boundary offset setting. Boundary offset is now a unit value rather than a percentage. Test Polar coordinate TPMS structures for cylindrical parts. Ability to remove unprintable hollows. Useful for removing small hollow regions cut off from the main hollow region/s. Prevents trapping uncured resin within the part. Cubic Lattices typically have one hollow region, whilst TPMS can have 2.

Printing the Files

 • Designed for Adult Large, scale to 90% or less for smaller masks 


Making the Mask 

 • Sand around the edge touching face with 200 + sandpaper 

 • Fasten elastic cord to the attachments and adjust to desired tension 

 • Elastic chord, string, straps, or any variation can be used as ties 



Placing Filter 

• Existing clinical masks can be used as a filter by cutting them into 2.5 in squares, can get 6 filters from one mask 

• Place filter material on the inside of the mask and fasten by pushing holding ring and filter together into space 


Aseptic Technique 
 • These masks are reusable, but each person should have their own 

 • Masks can be cleaned and disinfected by soap and water as well as disinfectant agents 

 • Practice good hygiene by washing hands before and after changing filters and removing mask 

 • Clean mask often, change filter often

name: 1"-5/8 (1.625 Inch - 41.3mm) Merge Collector Tool
description:
This tool can be clamped into a reciprocating saw/band saw to cut pipe for an exhaust merge collector, it enables you to accurately cut multiple tubes with ease and repeatability.

This is for 1"-5/8 (1.625 Inch - 41.275mm) tubing with any wall thickness

It has 0.10mm clearnance all the way round the tube, for ease of installation but also not too much to cause the tube to move when cutting, some prints may require sanding slightly for the tube to fit perfectly.

For any other sizes please message or leave a comment

The listing includes:

11.5 Degree Merge Collector Jig
3.5 Degree Adapter(Increases the merge angle to 15 degrees)
3 Cylinder Cut Marker
4 Cylinder Cut Marker
5 Cylinder Cut Marker
6 Cylinder Cut Marker
8 Cylinder Cut Marker


Examples of 11.5 and 15 degree cut pipes for the various cylinder counts as well as complete merge collectors, I will add the other angles on request as these are to visualise the final merge collectors.

this tool also requires an M8 x 30mm Bolt(Bolt can be longer) and an M8 Nut.

To Use the tool:

Cut a pipe to the desired length(it may need to be slightly longer to be cut in the jig) and slide into the jig, and seat to the bottom of the hole.

Tighten the bolt so the pipe is held firmly in the jig.

Place in jig in the the clamp on the saw so the bottom of the jig sits flat and the bolt facing away from the saw blade

Set the jig so the blade will remove the desired amount of material from the tube from the pipe and tighten the clamp on the saw, then make the first cut.

(The depth of cut on the tube will determin the size of the exit when all of the tube are placed together, cutting more will make for a smaller hole, cutting less will make for a larger exit)

Select the desired cut marker for the number of cylinders you are merging and place onto the jig, then draw a mark on one end, loosen the bolt and rotate this mark to the other side of the cut marker and tighten down the bolt.

Make the second cut, the pipe can then be de bured and the next pipe installed to be cut without having to remove the jig from the clamp on the saw


Commercial License available via a tier 1 membership on Patreon: patreon.com/RKDesigns_

name: Tamiya AA Battery Box (20s)
description:
The idea isn't mine (obviously) as I have seen many of this design already and took my inspiration from them. I designed this model to hold 20 AAA batteries (I've seen mostly just 12 and 15) for Tamiya Mini 4WD players. Also, I separated the lock (latch) part from the lid to print it separately and in an orientation where it is more rigid that horizontal printing. Just use CA Glue or PLA glue to bond the lock to the lid as shown in the preview image.
Made this from scratch using Tinkercad and was planning to share it for free but it took me 7 hours to complete so I have to put a price on this model.
I designed this to have a thinner wall than most but still looks pleasing.
You can print this with 0.8 wall width and 20% infill for rigidity but it's up to you how rigid you want it to be. You can also print this with standard quality and 5% support density without any problem.
