name: Soft Jaw Insert Ø48mm | Moto Fork Stanchion | KTM WP · Husqvarna · GasGas ·  CRF · Yamaha YZ | 100 / 125 / 150mm Jaw | N52 Magnet | FDM Print Ready
description:
Every time a bare steel vise jaw contacts a chromed 48mm fork stanchion, the damage is invisible until it is not. A microscopic flat, a fine scratch running the length of the chrome, an oil seal that now weeps on every compression stroke because the surface it runs on is no longer round. Fork service done without proper workholding is fork damage on a delay.
The correct solution is a bore matched precisely to the stanchion diameter — full circumferential contact, even clamping force, zero point loading. This insert is bored to Ø48.4mm — 0.4mm total clearance across the diameter to compensate for FDM dimensional shrinkage, reproducing a true Ø48mm contact surface off the printer. When clamped to nominal size the flat jaw faces sit approximately 0.8mm apart, ensuring the insert material is under compressive load against the stanchion before the vise jaws bottom out. Proper clamping pressure on the tube, zero pressure on the chrome.
Four N52 neodymium magnet recesses per jaw half — sized for 8×5mm disc magnets, true press fit seated with the vise itself — hold the inserts firmly against the jaw face through the full clamping range. The DT3D size designation is recessed into both the top and front face of each block. In a drawer with multiple sizes, you read the number, you grab the right block.
This listing covers Ø48mm in three jaw width variants — 100mm, 125mm, and 150mm — included in a single purchase.

✅ Compatible Forks — Ø48mm Stanchion
WP Suspension — KTM

WP XPLOR 48 — KTM 125 / 150 / 250 / 300 SX, XC, XC-W (2015–present)
WP XPLOR 48 — KTM 250 / 350 / 450 / 500 SX-F, XC-F, EXC-F (2015–present)
WP XACT 48 — KTM factory and SXS variants
WP 4860 open chamber — KTM 125–530 SX / EXC / MXC / XC (2003–2014)

WP Suspension — Husqvarna

WP XPLOR 48 — FC 250 / 350 / 450, TC 125 / 250 (2014–present)
WP XPLOR 48 — FE 250 / 350 / 450 / 501, TE 150 / 250 / 300 (2014–present)
WP XACT 48 — Husqvarna factory and Rockstar Edition variants

WP Suspension — GasGas

WP XPLOR 48 — MC 125 / 250 / 450, EC 250 / 300 / 350 / 450 (2021–present)

WP Suspension — BMW

WP XPLOR 48 — BMW R 1250 GS / Adventure (2019–present)

Sh0wa 

Showa 48mm — C.R.F250R (2010–2017)
Showa 49mm — C.R.F250R (2018–present) — confirm OD before ordering; some variants measure 48mm at the stanchion tube

KYB — Yamaha

KYB 48mm — YZ250F, YZ450F (multiple model years — confirm stanchion OD)
KYB 48mm — WR250F, WR450F (multiple model years)

KYB — 

KYB 48mm — Africa Twin CRF1000L / CRF1100L (confirm variant)

Note: Fork designations and internal cartridge designations are often quoted rather than actual stanchion OD. Always verify your stanchion tube OD with a digital calliper before ordering. The stanchion is the inner tube — the chromed sliding tube — not the outer lower leg.

✅ What Makes This Different
Full-wrap bore geometry — the semicircular channel is bored to Ø48.4mm, giving 0.4mm total clearance across the diameter to compensate for FDM shrinkage and reproduce a true Ø48mm contact surface off the printer. Both jaw halves together provide near-full circumferential contact, distributing clamping force evenly around the tube. When clamped to nominal size the flat faces sit approximately 0.8mm apart — the insert is under load against the stanchion before the jaws bottom out, delivering proper grip and accommodating any tube that is marginally undersized.
Non-marring, non-scratching — ABS has sufficient surface hardness to grip positively without marking chromed stanchion tubes. The insert takes the contact force. The stanchion surface does not.
N52 magnet recesses — four 8×5mm disc magnet pockets per jaw half, arranged for even pull across the full jaw face. True press fit — seat them with the vise itself, no adhesive required. N52 grade holds the inserts firmly against the jaw face through the full clamping range.
Diameter-specific design — not a V-groove spanning multiple sizes, not a rubber pad compressing unevenly. One bore, one diameter, correct contact every time. The 48mm bore is the right tool for a 48mm stanchion. Nothing else is.
Three jaw widths in one purchase — 100mm, 125mm, and 150mm variants included. Fits the most common bench vise sizes without a second purchase.
Recessed size labelling — Ø48mm designation recessed into both the top and front face of each block. Readable in a mixed drawer without picking up every insert.
Infinitely reproducible — print as many pairs as needed in whichever jaw width suits your vise. Multiple vises? All three variants are in the download. One gets lost or damaged? Print another. The cost per pair is filament and twenty minutes of print time.

🔧 Application Examples

Fork leg removal and installation — grip the stanchion securely while removing or refitting the lower leg
Dust seal and oil seal replacement — hold the fork leg positively while driving seals without risk of rotation or damage to the stanchion surface
Top cap and air spring removal — hold the fork leg while applying torque to the top cap
Damper cartridge extraction and reinstallation — secure the leg during cartridge work on WP XPLOR and XACT systems
Fork oil level setting — hold the leg vertical and stable while measuring and adjusting oil level
Spring removal on coil spring forks — hold the leg while compressing and removing the spring retainer


⚠️ Material & Print Notes
ABS is the recommended material for this application. It has higher surface friction than PETG, which translates directly to better grip on the stanchion under clamping load. ABS also handles the elevated temperatures that can occur near suspension components during service without softening.
Avoid PETG for this application. PETG has mild self-lubricating surface properties that reduce friction against smooth chromed tube finishes. Lower surface friction means lower holding force under the same clamping pressure — the opposite of what a workholding insert needs.
Do not use PLA. PLA will creep and deform under sustained clamping load.
Print solid — 100% infill. This is a workholding tool. A solid insert is stiffer, more dimensionally stable under load, and resists the compressive force of the vise jaw across the full section. Non-negotiable for workshop use.

📦 What's Included
3× STL files — one for each jaw width variant: 100mm, 125mm, and 150mm. Each file prints twice to make a complete jaw pair; both halves are identical with no left or right, no mirroring required. Select the file that matches your vise jaw width.
The bore is Ø48.4mm — 0.4mm total clearance across the diameter, compensating for FDM dimensional shrinkage to reproduce a true Ø48mm contact surface off the printer. When clamped to nominal size the flat jaw faces sit approximately 0.8mm apart — intentional, ensuring compressive load on the stanchion before the jaws bottom out.
Four 8×5mm N52 magnet recesses per half. Recessed Ø48mm size designation on top and front faces. DT3D brand mark on top face.
Magnets not included — source 8×5mm N52 neodymium disc magnets locally. Standard size, widely available. Press them in using the vise — place the magnet over the pocket, position the jaw face-down, and close gently. Done.
details:
STL files are pre-oriented — import and print directly. Each insert stands upright on its side with the jaw face on the build plate and the full jaw width running in Z. The 150mm variant prints 150mm tall, the 125mm variant 125mm tall, the 100mm variant 100mm tall. This orientation places layer lines along the length of the jaw, perpendicular to the clamping direction, giving maximum resistance to the compressive load exactly where it is applied. No supports required on any variant.
0.2mm layer height. 100% infill — solid. ABS strongly recommended; print with an enclosure.

💬 Questions?
Drop a comment or message — DT3D responds to all technical queries. Need a different fork diameter, a jaw width outside the 100–150mm range, or a size for a specific fork not listed here? The full series covers motorcycle, MTB, hydraulic tube, and automotive shock absorber diameters. Check the DT3D collection or reach out before purchasing.

name: Joint-O-Mator 169 - Professional Magnetic King Size Cone Knockbox
description:
Joint-O-Mator 169 – Professional Magnetic King Size Cone Knockbox

Designed for professional users and high-volume pre-roll production. The Joint-O-Mator 169 is a heavily engineered batch cone filler built for scale, consistency, and a zero-friction workflow. This is not a flimsy stacking toy—it is a tightly integrated 5-part system built around an ultra-tight mechanical friction fit and a highly modular, polarity-guided magnetic core.


The Joint-O-Mator Ecosystem comes in 7 capacities: 
37 · 61 · 85 · 127 · 169 · 217 · 271 


⚙️ The Foundation: Ultra-Tight Friction Fit (Parts A, B & C)

The structural integrity of the main body does not rely on magnets. Instead, the core assembly is mechanically locked:

	•	Part A (The Honeycomb Tray): Holds 169 King Size cones.

	•	Part B (The TPU Damping Ring): Absorbs vibration shock and stops the unit from walking across your table.

	•	Part C (The Outer Hex Frame): The rigid exoskeleton.

When you slide Parts A, B, and C together, the tight tolerances create a permanent friction fit. They become a single, rock-solid block capable of handling heavy vibration without rattling apart. No screws, no glue, no play.


🧲 Modular Magnetic Interaction: Parts D & E

While the base is mechanically locked, the interaction with the knockbox is entirely magnetic. During slicing, you will schedule pauses to drop 8x3 mm neodymium magnets directly into the print. The polarity is strictly mapped so that parts will only snap together in the correct orientation.

The modularity of Part D (Lid / Base Plate) & Part E (Magnetic Insert): Both parts can be magnetically attached to either the top or the bottom of the solid A/B/C base, depending on your current workflow step.

	•	Manual Filling / Tapping Mode: Snap the Lid (Part D) to the top to prevent material from spilling while manually tapping the unit. Alternatively, snap it to the bottom to act as a solid base.

	•	Press-Fill Mode: Snap Part E magnetically under the Lid (Part D), then attach both to the top. As you push down slightly, Part E applies uniform downward pressure to manually pack and settle the material evenly across all 169 holes.

	•	Ejector Mode: Once filling is done, remove the Lid and snap Part E under the solid A/B/C base block. The perfectly aligned geometry pushes the entire batch of cones approximately 15 mm upward simultaneously. You get clean, tool-free extraction without crushing or individually digging out a single joint.


⚡ The “Shake it” Vibration Add-on (Sold Separately)
Manual tapping is obsolete in a production environment. The Shake it is an independent, heavy-duty magnetic vibration module powered by a 3650 motor and an 8x AA battery pack. Because it is fully battery-operated, your entire knockbox system remains 100% portable—no wall outlets or restrictive cables tying you to a desk.

Thanks to the universal magnetic layout, the Shake it snaps dead-center onto the lid (Part D) of any Joint-O-Mator size from 37 up to 271. Turn it on, and it violently but evenly shakes the solid A/B/C base to pack your cones perfectly in seconds.

https://cults3d.com/de/modell-3d/werkzeuge/shake-it-magnetic-vibration-add-on-for-joint-o-mator

🖨️ Technical Print Specifications

Build Volume Requirements:

	•	Sizes 37 / 61 / 85 / 127: Fit comfortably on any standard 256 x 256 mm bed (e.g., Bambu Lab X1C / P1S / A1).

	•	Sizes 169 / 217 / 271: Require a large-format printer with a minimum true build plate of 320 x 320 mm (e.g., Bambu H2D/H2S, Voron 2.4 350, Prusa XL).

🛒 Hardware Bill of Materials (BOM)

You will need standard 8x3 mm round neodymium magnets. A visual polarity guide is included in the project files.

	•	Joint-O-Mator 37 / 61 / 85 / 127: Requires 27x magnets total.

	•	Joint-O-Mator 169 / 217 / 271: Requires 45x magnets total.

	•	(If building the Shake it module: Requires an additional 20x magnets).

With this purchase you only receive the print files for the Joint-O-Mator version in the titel; no other sizes are included.

name: All Bungs - Welding Purge Bungs
description:
🔧 Product Description

This is a fully 3D printable welding purge bung designed to diffuse shielding gas evenly into tubing during welding applications. The internal diffuser design helps create a smoother and more consistent gas flow, improving purge coverage and helping achieve cleaner internal welds.

The bung is designed as a push-fit connection for 6mm OD tubing. For best results, it is recommended to glue a short section of tube into the inlet to reduce the chance of the line becoming detached during use, which could contaminate the weld.

Inside the bung is a network of internal passages that distribute the shielding gas more evenly throughout the tubing. This helps reduce direct gas jetting and turbulence, resulting in a more stable and effective purge.

🛡️ To further improve gas diffusion, the design also includes a recessed groove for installing fine mesh. The mesh helps smooth airflow and reduce turbulence even further, improving purge consistency across the tube diameter.

name: Mazda Power Window Motor Repair Gear Set (GJ6A5958X / G22C5858X)
description:
This is a notorious failure point in many Mazda vehicles: the internal plastic helical gear strips its teeth over time, causing the window to grind, click, and stop working. Dealerships only sell the complete expensive motor assembly (OEM Part Numbers: GJ6A-59-58X, G22C-58-58X, GJ6A5958XF, 742-801, 742-802).

With this 3D model, you can print the replacement gears and fix your motor for pennies! The large gear features the exact internal cutouts required to house the 3 original rubber shock-absorbing dampers (cushions). Simply transfer the rubber cushions from your broken gear into the printed one.

Compatible with window motors of:

Mazda 3 (2004-2010)

Mazda 5 (2006-2015)

Mazda 6 (2003-2008)

Mazda CX-7 (2007-2012)

Mazda CX-9 (2007-2015)

Mazda RX-8 (2004-2011)

⚠️ ENGINEERING & MATERIAL WARNING:
Window regulators experience extreme torque and stress, especially if the window freezes to the seals in winter.
❌ DO NOT USE: PLA, basic PETG, or brittle resins. They will snap immediately under load.

Upon reassembly, YOU MUST generously pack the gear teeth with plastic-safe grease (Silicone grease, PTFE, or White Lithium) to ensure smooth and quiet operation.

description:

So I have designed this version for hobbyists or people who need a smaller type of storage cabinet. Multiple Cabinets can also be linked together vertically with a slide link pin.

I have designed this cabinet so it can be printed on most FDM printers and needs very few supports. 

The overall size of this storage is Width: 178mm, Height: 174mm and Depth with Draws: 72mm
Mounting holes are 150mm apart Horizontal and 120mm Vertical.

name: Suzuki Vitara Rear Fog Light Bracket – Anti-Corrosion Replacement
description:
Is your **Suzuki Vitara's** rear fog light bracket rusted away? You’re not alone! The original metal elements are notorious for corroding over time. This 3D model is a **1:1 replica** of the original part, designed to restore your vehicle's lighting securely and permanently.

### Key Features:
* **Perfect Fit:** Designed to match the original Suzuki Vitara bumper mounting points perfectly.
* **Corrosion Proof:** Unlike the OEM metal parts, this 3D-printed version will never rust.
* **Modular Design:** One side consists of **3 easy-to-print elements** for maximum strength and accuracy.
details:
### Installation Instructions:
1. **Disassembly:** Remove the old, corroded brackets from the bumper.
2. **Prepping the Lamp:** Carefully drill out the rivets that connect the old metal mount to the fog light housing.
3. **Bracket Assembly:** Join the 3 printed elements together using **M3x16 screws** (suitable for plastic or metal).
4. **Final Mount:** Connect the lamp to your new 3D-printed bracket using new screws or rivets, then install the whole assembly back into the bumper.


### Recommended Print Settings:

* **Material:** **ASA** or **ABS** is highly recommended.  **PETG** also wil be good. These materials offer the necessary UV resistance and thermal stability for automotive exterior use. *Avoid PLA as it will warp under sun exposure.*
* **Layer Height:** 0.2 mm or 0.16 mm for better detail on screw holes.
* **Wall Line Count:** 3 or 4 (for maximum structural integrity).
* **Infill:** 30-40% (Grid or Gyroid for strength).
* **Supports:** Required (Tree)

### Hardware Required:
* **Screws:** You will need **M3x16 screws** (self-tapping for plastic or standard machine screws) to assemble the 3 parts of the bracket.
* **Mounting:** Use standard rivets or M4/M5 screws to attach the bracket to the fog light housing after drilling out the old ones.

name: 2.50 Inch Mandrel Bend Y Cutting Jig
description:
🔧 Product Description

This jig kit is designed for securely holding and cutting 2.50" mandrel-bent tubing to create accurate Y-connections from either 90° or 180° bends. It provides a stable and repeatable setup for precise fabrication, whether using a clamp or a bandsaw.

The jig features integrated alignment pins to assist when applying clamping pressure, as well as provisions for two M6 Allen bolts when a more controlled fastening method is required—ideal for bandsaw use.

Unlike standard jigs limited to 90° cuts, this design includes three additional angle options: 45°, 60°, and 75°. These angles are measured per side, meaning the final included angle of the completed Y will be double the selected value (e.g., 45° per side results in a 90° total angle).

⚠️⚠️Only 1.5D jig will cut with material all the way round the bend using the 45 degree mark properly, smaller CLR bends will not work.⚠️⚠️

🛠️ How to Use

Creating a 90° Y:

Position the bend so that the end of the tube sits flush against the face of the jig on the side that will remain uncut. Secure the tube using either a clamp or the M6 bolts. The exposed section of the bend can then be cut using a bandsaw, ensuring the blade removes only the visible excess material.

Creating Y-connections with smaller angles (45°, 60°, 75°):

⚠️ Take extra care when working with reduced angles. As the angle decreases, less of the tube is retained within the jig, reducing overall grip. Ensure the tube is firmly secured before cutting to prevent movement or dislodging during operation.

Setting the angle:

Insert a 1.6mm filler rod or tungsten through the corresponding alignment holes
Slide the tube into the jig until it contacts the rod
The offset hole positioning ensures the correct final angle is achieved
Tighten the jig bolts securely

Once positioned, the excess material extending beyond the jig can be marked(for tracking any movement) and removed. Cutting is best performed on a bandsaw. 

📏 Included CLR Options

2.50" (63.5mm) CLR – tight radius for compact routing
2.50" (76.2mm) CLR – balanced radius for general applications
2.50" (95.25mm) CLR – wider radius for smoother flow

📦 Additional Parts Required

2 × M6 x 65–70mm Allen socket head bolts
2 × M6 nuts

description:
Stop paying for a complete throttle body replacement! This high-precision 3D model allows you to replace only the stripped internal gear.

Fits: Nissan Qashqai (2006-2017), Juke, Note, and some Renault models.

Print Settings: 100% Infill, 0.12mm layer height.

Tested: Engineered for a perfect fit on the actuator shaft.

Boğaz kelebeğini komple değiştirmeye son! Bu hassas 3D model, sadece sıyıran iç dişliyi değiştirmenize olanak sağlar.

Uyum: Nissan Qashqai (2006-2017), Juke, Note ve bazı Renault modelleri.

Baskı: %100 Doluluk, 0.12mm katman yüksekliği.
details:
To ensure the longevity of the gear and prevent engine-related issues, please follow these technical recommendations:

Material: MANDATORY to use high-temperature resistant materials.

Recommended: ASA, Nylon (PA), or Polycarbonate (PC).

Acceptable: High-quality PETG (only for cooler climates).

Avoid: PLA (It will soften and fail due to engine heat).

Layer Height: 0.12mm or 0.10mm (Fine detail is necessary for the teeth to mesh perfectly).

Infill: 100% (Solid). This part handles mechanical stress; do not use hollow patterns.

Wall Line Count: 4 or 5 (For maximum structural integrity).

Orientation: Print with the flat side down on the build plate.

Support: Minimal supports may be needed for the center hub depending on your printer's bridging performance.

Post-Processing: Apply a small amount of lithium grease or silicone grease on the teeth during assembly for smooth operation.

Dişlinin uzun ömürlü olması ve sorunsuz çalışması için lütfen şu teknik talimatları izleyin:

Malzeme: Motor ısısına dayanıklı malzeme kullanılması ZORUNLUDUR.

Önerilen: ASA, Nylon (PA) veya Polikarbonat (PC).

Uygun: Kaliteli PETG (sadece ılıman iklimler için).

Kaçınılması Gereken: PLA (Motor ısısıyla yumuşar ve dişler sıyırır).

Katman Yüksekliği: 0.12mm veya 0.10mm (Dişlerin birbirine tam oturması için hassas baskı gereklidir).

Doluluk (Infill): %100 (Tam Dolu). Parça mekanik yük altında çalışacağı için boşluk bırakılmamalıdır.

Duvar Sayısı: 4 veya 5 (Yapısal sağlamlık için).

Son İşlem: Montaj sırasında dişlerin üzerine az miktarda lityum gres veya silikon gres sürülmesi çalışma ömrünü uzatacaktır.

name: 🛠️ Educational Roll Center Tool
description:
Educational tool for roll center analysis

This project is an educational tool designed to analyze and understand the roll center in double wishbone suspension systems, commonly used in RC car models and, at a conceptual level, in full-scale vehicles as well.

The model allows you to visualize and analyze suspension kinematics, clearly showing how suspension geometry and pickup point positions affect the roll center location and its variation during movement.

👉 This is not a functional racing component, but a study and learning model.

🎯 Purpose and field of use

This tool allows you to:

📐 Analyze roll center generation and movement

🔧 Study the influence of suspension geometry on vehicle behavior

🧠 Understand the effects of changing suspension pickup points

🎓 Support educational activities and technical self-learning

Ideal for:

Advanced RC modelers

Vehicle dynamics and mechanics enthusiasts

Students and technical hobbyists


Not an official product and not affiliated with any commercial brand

Not designed for racing use or as a track setup tool
details:
🧵 Recommended 3D printing material

PLA

The project is optimized for PLA 3D printing, which provides:

good dimensional stability

ease of printing

sufficient accuracy for an educational tool

High mechanical strength is not required, as this is a static analysis model.

📏 Printing tolerances and movement smoothness

For proper functionality, it is essential that the 3D printer used maintains dimensional tolerances within ±0.2 mm.

All moving parts are designed to be very free and smooth, ensuring accurate visualization of suspension kinematics and roll center behavior.

If some joints or sliding parts are too tight after printing, it is recommended to:

🧽 use fine-grit sandpaper

lightly refine the sliding surfaces

avoid invasive modifications that could alter the original geometry

🔩 Hardware and assembly

For fixing the tires/wheels, the following hardware is required:

🔩 M3 button head screw

📐 Length: 8 mm or 10 mm, depending on printed part thickness

⚠️ Important:
Do not overtighten the wheel fixing screws.
The wheels must remain free to slide, allowing them to correctly follow the movements imposed by the suspension geometry. Excessive tightening would compromise the educational purpose of the model.

name: Gold Horizontal Drift Concentrator Blue Bowl Miller Table
description:
Description

Build your own fully functional gravity-based gold concentrator – completely 3D printable, including a modified TPU micro recovery mat and TPU sealing gasket.

▶️ Projektvideo / Demo auf YouTube:
https://youtu.be/F6MSH0AcD-4

This design is a vortex-style gravity gold concentrator, engineered to efficiently separate gold from sand and quartz using controlled water flow and density separation.
It is optimized for mesh 20–60 material and tested with real concentrates.

The system uses a two-material design:

PETG for all structural and load-bearing components

TPU for the micro recovery mat and the sealing gasket, providing flexibility, sealing performance and improved fine gold capture

The TPU micro recovery mat is a custom-modified design, optimized for operation at a steep angle (approx. 15°) in the secondary recovery stage.
This allows fast clearing of light material while fine gold is retained in the micro-cell structure.

🔧 Features

100% 3D printable

Printer requirements:
All parts are designed to fit on a standard FDM printer with a minimum build volume of 250 × 250 × 250 mm.

No large-format or industrial printer is required.

Structural parts printed in PETG

TPU micro recovery mat + TPU gasket INCLUDED

Micro-cell geometry optimized for steep-angle operation (~15°)

No purchased mats or proprietary parts required

Optimized hydrodynamics for high gold retention

Modular design, easy to clean and adjust

Suitable for hobby and advanced DIY gold prospectors

🚀 Throughput advantage

Compared to traditional flat water tables or bowl-style gravity separators, this vortex-based concentrator is designed for a significantly higher material throughput.

The continuous vortex flow allows:

faster processing of classified material

stable operation at higher feed rates

reduced waiting time per batch

This makes the system especially suitable for users who want to process larger volumes of concentrates while maintaining effective gold recovery.

📦 Included in the download

3MF files for the complete gravity concentrator

3MF file for the TPU micro recovery mat

3MF file for the TPU sealing gasket

Link to demonstration video

🖨️ Printing & material requirements

File format: 3MF

Structural material: PETG

Flexible material: TPU (recovery mat + gasket)

Estimated material usage:

PETG: approx. 2300 g

TPU: approx. 90 g

Recommended print settings:

Nozzle: 0.4 mm

Layer height: 0.2 mm

Perimeters / walls: 5

Infill: 20%

Supports: only where specified in the guide

3MF files preserve correct scale, orientation and material assignment and can be opened with modern slicers such as PrusaSlicer, Cura or Bambu Studio.

⚙️ Tested operating range

Sieve sizes: 20 / 40 / 60 mesh

Main vortex stage: 10° angle

Secondary recovery stage (TPU micro mat): ~15° angle

Water flow: approx. 2–8 L/min (depending on material)

🔩 Additional required components (not included)
🧱 Tubes & pipes

Acrylic tube OD 80 mm / ID 70 mm

1 × 140 mm length

1 × 96 mm length

Acrylic tube OD 25 mm / ID 21 mm

1 × 150 mm length

🚿 Valves & fittings

1 × slide gate valve Ø 40 mm ID

5 × ball valve with G1/4" male thread and 12 mm hose barb

Hose clamps:

10 × for 12 mm hose

2 × for 1" hose

💧 Hoses

5 m water hose 12 mm inner diameter

1 m hose 1 inch (pump to distributor)

🔌 Pump

1 × bilge pump 1100 GPH

1 inch outlet

🔩 Fasteners

2 × screw M6 × 40 mm, incl. nut and washers

2 × screw M6 × 90 mm, incl. nut and washers

💡 Electronics (optional)

1 × LED strip

Length 50 cm

Width 10 mm

With controller

🫙 Containers & monitoring (optional)

1 × glass container 
https://www.amazon.de/dp/B0D49MCX9G?ref_=ppx_hzsearch_conn_dt_b_fed_asin_title_8&th=1

Optional: inline flow meter 
https://www.amazon.de/dp/B0BF59GLYN?ref=ppx_yo2ov_dt_b_fed_asin_title

All listed components are standard, non-proprietary parts and can be sourced locally or online.

⚠️ Important note regarding pump selection

A weaker pump is not suitable for this system.
Insufficient pump pressure will result in unstable flow conditions and improper operation of the vortex stage and recovery mat.

The recommended 1100 GPH bilge pump provides sufficient pressure reserve, even when flow is reduced to the required 2–8 L/min using valves.
This pressure head is necessary to maintain proper vortex formation and consistent material transport.

Using pumps with significantly lower power or pressure may lead to:

unstable vortex behavior

poor material separation

reduced gold recovery

⚠️ Important note regarding water filtration

Water supplied by the pump must be filtered before entering the system.

Unfiltered water may contain coarse particles that can block or damage the vortex channels and negatively affect system performance.

Maximum particle size in pump water: ≤ 1 mm

A simple inline filter, mesh screen, or pre-filter in the water reservoir is sufficient

Especially important when operating in a recirculating water system

Using filtered water ensures:

stable vortex behavior

consistent flow conditions

protection of fine vortex channels

reliable gold recovery

⚠️ License & usage

This file is provided for private use only.
Selling printed units, redistributing, or sharing the files is not permitted.

Commercial license and extended documentation are available separately.

— Deutsche Beschreibung —

Baue deinen eigenen schwerkraftbasierten Goldkonzentrator – komplett 3D-druckbar, inklusive modifizierter TPU-Micro-Rückgewinnungsmatte und TPU-Dichtung.

Das System ist als Zwei-Material-Design ausgelegt:

PETG für alle tragenden und strukturellen Bauteile

TPU für die Micro-Rückgewinnungsmatte und die Dichtung

Die TPU-Micro-Rückgewinnungsmatte ist gezielt angepasst und für den Betrieb bei steilerem Gefälle (ca. 15°) in der Sekundärstufe optimiert.
Leichtes Material wird schnell ausgetragen, während Feingold zuverlässig in den Mikrozellen zurückgehalten wird.

🚀 Durchsatz-Vorteil

Im Vergleich zu klassischen flachen Wassertischen oder schalenbasierten Schwerkraftabscheidern ist dieses wirbelbasierte System auf einen deutlich höheren Materialdurchsatz ausgelegt.

Die kontinuierliche Vortex-Strömung ermöglicht:

schnelleres Verarbeiten von klassiertem Material

stabilen Betrieb bei höheren Zufuhrraten

deutlich kürzere Bearbeitungszeiten pro Charge

Das System eignet sich daher besonders für Anwender, die größere Mengen an Konzentraten effizient aufarbeiten möchten.

🖨️ Druck- & Materialangaben

Druckergröße:
Alle Bauteile sind so ausgelegt, dass sie auf einem Standard-FDM-Drucker mit mindestens 250 × 250 × 250 mm Bauraum gedruckt werden können.

Es sind keine größeren Industrie- oder Sonderdrucker erforderlich.

Dateiformat: 3MF

PETG-Bedarf: ca. 2300 g

TPU-Bedarf: ca. 90 g

Düse: 0,4 mm

Layerhöhe: 0,2 mm

Wandlinien: 5

Infill: 20 %

⚙️ Getesteter Arbeitsbereich

Siebgrößen: 20 / 40 / 60 Mesh

Hauptstufe (Vortex): 10° Neigung

Sekundärstufe (TPU-Matte): ca. 15° Neigung

Wassermenge: ca. 2–8 l/min

🔩 Zusätzlich benötigte Komponenten (nicht enthalten)

(entspricht der englischen Liste oben)

⚠️ Wichtiger Hinweis zur Pumpenauswahl

Eine zu schwache Pumpe ist für dieses System nicht geeignet.
Bei zu geringem Druck entstehen instabile Strömungsverhältnisse, wodurch die Vortex-Stufe und die Rückgewinnungsmatte nicht korrekt arbeiten.

⚠️ Wichtiger Hinweis zur Wasserfiltration

Das durch die Pumpe geförderte Wasser muss vor dem Eintritt in das System gefiltert werden.

Maximale Partikelgröße im Pumpenwasser: ≤ 1 mm

Filter, Sieb oder Vorfilter ausreichend

Besonders wichtig bei Wasserumlaufsystemen

⚠️ Lizenz & Nutzung

Nur für den privaten Gebrauch.
Der Verkauf gedruckter Einheiten sowie die Weitergabe der Dateien ist nicht erlaubt.

Eine kommerzielle Lizenz ist separat erhältlich.

📄 Technical project documentation included (EN/DE)  
Includes system overview, operation concept, assembly notes and adhesive recommendation.

📄 Technische Projektdokumentation enthalten (EN/DE)  
Enthält Systemübersicht, Funktionsprinzip, Montagehinweise und Kleberempfehlung.

🔧 Modular collection system  
Supports optional adjustable collection tubes for extended runtime and variable volume.

🔧 Modulares Sammelsystem  
Unterstützt optional einstellbare Sammelrohre für längere Laufzeiten und variables Volumen.

Developed and tested under real prospecting conditions.

name: Spool Yarn Bowl
description:
I think by now it's pretty well established that I love prints that look like other stuff, and textiles of all kinds have been a long time special interest, so of course spools of thread are ubiquitous in my house. I really wanted to have a big version to fit into my studio, so the Spool Yarn Bowl was born! I have a bowl full of vintage spools I inherited from my grandma, and I wanted the big one to have that feel, so I've used a shimmery bronze for the ends instead of the more modern white - but you could definitely switch it up on yours :).

There are no supports needed on this one, and I've left the hole editable so you can make it a canister if you'd like - it would be so cute to make a few to use as sewing room storage (that's on my list, just haven't gotten there yet). You can switch the filament by selecting the part, and if you If you have a single color machine, swap out at layer 88 to change the spool color! Just remember to switch the "yarn hole" to be a negative part - and just delete it altogether if you don't want it to be a yarn bowl. I have tested these down to 60%, and I probably wouldn't go smaller than that because the walls get pretty thin, but 60% is great for notions. You can go as large as your plate will handle - I keep mine at this size so I can ship them, but if you have the space you can definitely make it bigger. You may also need to scale the top a bit if you resize, so if you find it's not fitting, go up or down by 1% or even 0.5% until it fits the way you like.

If you would like to get a commercial license to sell this print, please join my patreon here: https://patreon.com/measuredandslow?utm_medium=unknown&utm_source=join_link&utm_campaign=creatorshare_creator&utm_content=copyLink

**ASSEMBLY / INSTALL NOTES (how to get the “drop-in charging” feel):**
1. Print the Gridfinity Fanttik T1 Max Auto-Charging Solder Station.
2. Print the Connector Support you want to use. These are different to account for printer and slicer deviation.
2a. Printing the _Custom-Grind Connector Supports will require trimming to fit. These provide the best retention and fitment as they can be made custom to suit your exact print. But, the tab must be sanded to size to work.
3. Insert the USB-C magnetic tip into your Fanttik T1 Max (leave it there permanently).
4. Mount the magnetic cable head into the connector pocket on the bin.
4a. If your printer runs slightly tight/loose, scale XY by ±0.3–0.8% or lightly sand the pocket for a perfect press fit.
5. Install the Connector-Support_xxx that you printed.
5a. If using the _Custom-Grind be sure to sand before performing final install.
6. Install 6x2 Magnets into holes with superglue if desired.
7. Plug into your preferred USB power source.
*Tip: If you want extra security, a tiny dab of hot glue or double-sided tape can lock the magnetic head in place—useful for high-traffic shop drawers.*

**COMPATIBILITY:**
Designed specifically for the Fanttik T1 Max soldering iron body and the included accessories listed above (4 tips, solder sucker, wipe pads).
Magnetic USB-C adapters vary slightly by brand; this model is built around the reference connector above—minor fit tuning (light sanding or tiny XY scale) may be needed.

I designed this speaker mount for the US General mini toolbox. I liked the idea of everyones builds but not how the speakers went out the top under the lid. name: Condensate Drain Hose Adapter for Portable AC Units
description:
Do you have a portable AC unit with a threaded connection in the back? Do you need to attach a drain hose to this connection? 

This may be the part you're looking for.  I made it specifically for Midea portable air conditioning units sold in the United States. The barbs hold the drain hose provided securely, and the files include a TPU washer to prevent leaks.

I ordered a part that was listed as a hose adapter (Midea-branded), but it was just the hose.  I highly recommend pairing this with a small automatic pump that will move the drain water from a reservoir to an actual drain or out a window, depending on your setup. I have used a 5-gallon water bottle as a drain container, but I would sometimes forget to check on it for a few days and end up with water overflowing onto the carpet.  And that's no fun at all.

name: AD5X-Cool (Wolf)
description:
**Hello, FlashForge AD5X users!**
Are you happy with your new printer? `*I'm sure you are!*.

I've noticed that after it's been running for just a little while, it starts to get pretty loud. After ruling out any visible issues, I had no choice but to remove the rear cover—only to find that the driver coolers and the heat sinks themselves were quite insufficient to maintain a temperature that wouldn’t force the fan to run constantly (since it’s a very small **3010**-type blower it produced a rather high-pitched and annoying sound).

I decided to replace it with a larger one and make a mount for it that would also allow for better cable management.

The list of materials is short: Just a **24-volt 5015** blower and two M3 or M4 screws with nuts and washers  22 to 25 mm long to secure the blower to the printer (they can be longer, but you may need to shorten them slightly so they don’t touch the printer’s rear cover). The board is attached to the bottom of the printer using two of the four small screws from the original blower, and to the top using the black hex-head screw that secures the cables for the X-axis motor, the IFS, and the small cooler that we’re replacing. 
It prints with very little filament—less than 22 grams or just over 7 meters; I made it out of PLA, although PETG might be more durable; in reality, you can use any type of filament. In any case, there’s no excess heat thanks to the directed duct system and because I added slightly larger heat sinks attached with LED heat sink adhesive—since, in my opinion, the originals are too small— (here are the links:   https://es.aliexpress.com/item/4000140939991.html   and  https://es.aliexpress.com/item/1005008927992060.html ). 
As you can see in one of the photos, even after extensive use, the heat sink’s contact surface is barely 35 degrees.

This model went through many test versions before I arrived at this final design; it has been tested during long printing sessions, and I can say it works perfectly.

`*Here is the elegant solution to the cooling problems of the FlashForge AD5X’s motor controllers*
details:
- **Material:** PLA, PLA+, PETG. Actually, any of them will work; use your own settings to ensure good layer adhesion
- **Support structures:** YES, tree-type and default style
- **Layer height:** 0.16
- **Color printing**: If you want to use two colors, that’s fine; otherwise, print in a single color and paint it.
- **Two-Color Print Time** 
>Layer: 0.16 = 1 hr 29 min (with my settings and filament).
>Layer: 0.20 = 50 min (with my settings and filament)

- **Single-Color Print Time**
>Layer: 0.16 = 44 min (with my settings and filament).
>Layer: 0.20 = 38 min (with my settings and filament)

The design has a `*generous margin* to rotate and correctly position the 5015 blower. **I DO NOT RECOMMEND THE PRE-CUT ONES** (you might be able to use them, but you’ll need to seal them with silicone); use the standard ones with the small nozzle sticking out.

This download includes both a full external model and a complete internal cutaway, showcasing the simple but deadly striker-spring fuze system that made the PMN-1 one of the most widely deployed mines in modern conflict history.

USE TPU FOR RUBBER COVER

This model is built to a premium standard, capturing:

The Bakelite-style casing

Central fuze well

Pressure plate geometry

Striker, spring, block, and detonator well details

The internal cavity shape and authentic layout

Perfect for EOD training aids, historical displays, museums, and collectors.

Included Files
Full Version

Complete, true-to-scale external PMN-1 mine

Correct ribbed pressure plate

Detailed fuze housing

Internal cavity geometry matched to real design

Cutaway Version

Shows:

Striker assembly

Primary spring

Lead block/safety strip representation

Retention features

Cavity layout

True-to-life fuze architecture

Ideal for classroom use, demonstration, and familiarization training.

Required Materials (Optional – For Internal Movement Functionality)

To complete the internal mechanism with realistic movement, the following additions are recommended:

Metal Rod: 2.5 mm × 53 mm (striker rod)

Music Wire

Lead Strips: For fuze blocking elements

Spring: 14 mm × 0.5 × 10 mm 

Spring: 8 mm × 0.5 × 20 mm

These components allow the striker and retention system to behave similarly to the real PMN-1 mechanism.

Historical Background

The PMN-1 is one of the most recognizable Soviet anti-personnel mines ever produced. Introduced in the 1950s and widely exported, it used a simple pressure-operated striker system housed inside a Bakelite-style casing. Its reliability, ease of manufacture, and ability to function in harsh environments made it a staple of Soviet mine warfare.

The mine activates when sufficient downward pressure on the top plate overcomes the internal retention system, releasing the spring-loaded striker into the detonator. Its simplicity is exactly why it remains a common hazard in many regions today and continues to be an essential training reference for EOD technicians.

Model Features

Full + cutaway versions included

True-to-scale dimensions and accurate internal architecture

Detailed striker, springs, and blocking elements

High-detail fuze retention design

Optimized for display, FDM, and resin printing

Perfect for EOD training aids, collectors, and museum exhibits


⚠️ DISCLAIMER

This is an inert, non-functional training aid.
It contains no energetic materials and cannot be made functional.
For display, educational, and simulation use only.

🛑 FILE USE POLICY

You may not sell, redistribute, or modify these files for resale.
For commercial licensing or custom development, contact:
📩 Redwiresolutions.info@gmail.com

name: Plasma Torch Floating/Fixed Holder
description:
This is a compact plasma torch holder designed for CNC plasma tables. The part is printed from PETG CF (carbon-fiber reinforced PETG) for higher stiffness, better heat resistance, and improved dimensional stability compared to standard PETG.

The design includes embedded threaded inserts (heat-set nuts) that allow mounting additional splash protection against water and cutting debris. This is especially useful on water tables where constant spray and slag are unavoidable.


Update:

Added a floating Z axis version with spring preload for more reliable surface detection and smoother height control.

The clamp securely holds the plasma torch while keeping it well aligned with the Z-axis. The geometry is intentionally simple and rigid to avoid flex during fast moves or height control corrections. The floating design improves tolerance to warped sheets and reduces stress on the Z axis during probing and cutting.

name: Jaw Coupling (Flexible Shaft Coupling)
description:
Jaw Coupling (Flexible Shaft Coupling) – 3D Model

This model represents a flexible jaw coupling, commonly used to connect two rotating shafts in mechanical systems such as electric motor–pump assemblies, compressors, fans, and industrial machinery. The coupling consists of two metallic hubs and a central elastic element (spider), allowing torque transmission while compensating for minor shaft misalignment.

The design helps reduce vibration, absorb shock loads, and protect bearings and shafts from excessive stress. The jaw coupling is widely used in industrial applications due to its simplicity, reliability, and ease of installation and maintenance.

This 3D model is ideal for mechanical assemblies, educational demonstrations, industrial equipment visualization, and prototyping. It integrates perfectly with motor and pump models for complete drivetrain layouts.

name: Practical 3D Essential Holder for Sunlu Filament Connector (1.75mm)
description:
⭐ Le kit de survie ultime pour votre connecteur de filament Sunlu (1,75 mm)
"Vous êtes frustré par votre connecteur de filament Sunlu ? Le filament se déforme instantanément, les joints se brisent ou se cassent lors du refroidissement ? Vous n'êtes pas le seul ! Le " vice " du filament est le grand ennemi de ce dispositif.

Avec Essential 3D Practical Support, cette frustration est terminée. Nous avons transformé un outil compliqué en une solution infaillible.

💡 LE PROCESSUS PARFAIT, ÉTAPE PAR ÉTAPE (Grâce à votre stand)
Coupe de précision : Préparez vos filaments avec une coupe angulaire à chaque extrémité. Cela maximise la surface de contact pour une liaison plus forte.

Astuce : Pour une liaison parfaite, utilisez le manchon fourni dans votre emballage Sunlu. Insérez-y la moitié de chaque filament.

Alignement parfait sur votre support : Placez les pointes des filaments (ou le manchon avec les filaments) dans les guides de votre support pratique Essential 3D. Notre conception garantit que les filaments de 1,75 mm sont parfaitement droits, alignés et centrés.

C'est ici que votre support élimine le "vice" du filament, en le maintenant dans la position idéale !

Fusion stable avec le Sunlu : Faites glisser l'appareil Sunlu sur le support, en l'ajustant parfaitement. Fermez le couvercle pour démarrer le processus de chauffage (par exemple, 3 minutes pour le PLA).

Pression optimale (le secret) : Dans les 3 à 5 secondes qui suivent la fermeture du couvercle (lorsque le filament commence à se ramollir), exercez une légère et brève pression sur les extrémités du filament (à travers le support). Cela améliore considérablement le contact entre les pointes pour une fusion supérieure.

Refroidissement parfait, toujours droit : Lorsque le Sunlu émet un bip, soulevez le couvercle. Retirez immédiatement le Sunlu. Le filament, déjà collé, restera serré et parfaitement droit dans les guides de votre support pendant qu'il refroidit complètement.

Ce support garantit un collage fort, droit et durable à chaque fois. Ne gaspillez plus de filament et faites en sorte que votre Sunlu fonctionne à 100% comme il se doit !

📥 Détails de l'impression
Modèle : Sunlu Essential Filament Connector Holder (V3)

Concepteur : @3DPRACTICO

Matériau recommandé : PLA ou PETG

Filament : 1.75mm
details:

name: Military robot scout
description: Un robot explorador militar es un dispositivo robótico teledirigido o autónomo diseñado para explorar y reconocer entornos peligrosos sin poner en riesgo la vida de los soldados. Estos robots están equipados con cámaras, sensores y sistemas de navegación para recopilar información, detectar amenazas como artefactos explosivos, inspeccionar edificios y operar en terrenos difíciles como escaleras o escombros.
details:
Funciones principales: Se utilizan para misiones como la desactivación de explosivos (EOD), la detección de paquetes sospechosos, el reconocimiento de edificios y la búsqueda de personas.
Características clave:
Movilidad: Pueden ser de oruga o de seis ruedas, permitiéndoles moverse por cualquier tipo de terreno, incluyendo escaleras.
Sensores: Cuentan con múltiples cámaras (infrarrojas, térmicas, con zoom), luces LED y micrófonos para recopilar datos del entorno.
Comunicación: Disponen de sistemas de audio bidireccional para la comunicación y pueden controlarse a distancia, a menudo con un alcance de hasta 1 km o más.
Herramientas: Algunos pueden equiparse con brazos mecánicos para recoger objetos o interactuar con el entorno, como abrir puertas.
Ejemplos: Modelos como el LT2 Bulldog Tactical Robot y el PackBot son ejemplos conocidos de robots exploradores utilizados para tareas peligrosas.

name: Pocket Loom Weaving Kit 4"x4" 12-dent
description:
Take your weaving on the go or use this pocket-size loom to make swatches and samples for large projects, or even patches for visible mending. This convenient, travel-friendly loom kit can make pieces up to 4" x 4" (10cm x 10cm) and comes with several accessories to streamline your weaving experience.

The frame of the loom has diagonal cross bracing to limit how much the loom deforms while warped and under tension. Raised beams next to each set of warp notches help even out the warp and give you just a little more room to work. A pair of V-shaped notches on either side of the loom grab on to each end of your warp yarn and keep it secure while you're working.

The included rigid heddle roller is set up for basic plain weave, and it's simple to change the shed by rocking the roller toward and away from you as you weave. Small bumps built into the loom frame keep the heddle roller securely in position on either end of the warp. The ends of the heddle roller have small handles to make it easy to grip while changing the shed, and the roller itself is labeled with the dent size so you know which roller goes with which loom frame. You can also weave without using the heddle roller, for example if you want to do twill or other patterns.

To pack down each row of weaving, use the matching comb, also labeled with its dent size. The large, sturdy handle makes the comb easy to grip, push, and pull as needed.

The loom kit also comes with a long needle that has a large eye and a blunt tip, just the right size to thread your weft yarn through the warp. It's slightly flexible to help you get your overs and unders in the right order. It also has a shallow line etched into it to use as a guide when placing your warp yarn before packing it down with the comb.

For warp yarn, we recommend Aunt Lydia's Classic 10 crochet cotton. You can use up to a 1-Super Fine or Fingering/Sock weight yarn, but you'll get the best results with crochet cotton as the warp.

For weft, use any yarn up to a 1-Super Fine or Fingering/Sock weight. The samples in the product photo used crochet cotton for the warp and acrylic sock-weight yarn for the weft.

Kit includes loom frame, needle, heddle rocker, comb, and a fabric storage bag. Yarn, thread, and other fiber not included.

description:
Boost your engine's performance with this set of tuned intake velocity stacks (intake trumpets). Designed for carburetors with a 55mm intake diameter, these stacks are engineered to optimize airflow and tailor your engine's power curve.

Low RPM Version: Optimized geometry to maximize torque and throttle response at lower speeds.

Mid RPM Version: The perfect balance for all-around performance and a strong midrange pull.

High RPM Version: Designed for maximum airflow at peak RPM, ideal for top-speed runs and racing.

🔧 Features:
55mm Internal Diameter: Fits standard 55mm carburetor intakes.

Smooth Airflow: carefully modeled curvature to reduce turbulence and increase air velocity into the carburetor.

Interchangeable Design: Quickly test and tune your bike's performance by swapping between the different versions.

The jig will fit inside the clamp of the saw, it also uses the compression from the clamp to then grab a hold of the tube. Adjust the angle of the blade to match the jig and its ready to go.

There are included centreline markers for all the included tubing diameters.

I have included an excel sheet which calculates how much the tube needs to protrude from the jig for a given centreline radius, this can then be set up on a vernier gauge and perfectly symmetrical pie cuts can then be produced.

how to use jigs:
Use the included centreline markers two draw two lines down your tubing 180 degrees apart. You can use the 3 line version which are 90 degrees apart each, this will then give you a reference to measure with the vernier gauge to cut the pieces exactly the same.

Use the calculator to work out how far out the tube needs to protrude from the jig.

Fit the tube into the jig, then into clamp on the saw, make sure the angled cut slides up to the blade

Tighten the clamp down so it is just gripping the tube, adjust the amount of material to be removed to get your first angle, make the first cut, the piece that was removed will make up for the first cut

To cut the first pie section, loosen the clamp, and then roll the tube 180 degrees, set the material to be cut, then tighten back down and make a cut, repeat this for the desired amount of pie cuts.


Included Tubing diameters and angles:
(Matching centreline markers also included)

42.4mm Diameter
9 Degree
15 degree

name: 👉 Venturi funnel for booster - optimized for workshop vacuum cleaners with cyclone & 100 mm system
description:
🚀 Maximale Absaugleistung mit minimalem Aufwand!
Dieser Venturi-Trichter macht aus deinem Werkstattsauger + Booster ein hocheffizientes Absaugsystem. Mehr Unterdruck, stabilerer Luftstrom und spürbar bessere Spanaufnahme – für eine saubere Werkstatt bei geringem Energieverbrauch.

Beschreibung des 3D-Modells

Der Venturi-Trichter wurde speziell für den Einsatz in Kombination mit einem Rohrventilator (Booster) im Werkstatt-Absaugsystem entwickelt.
Durch die präzise berechnete Steigung nutzt er den Venturi-Effekt: Der Luftstrom wird beschleunigt, der Unterdruck stabilisiert – das Ergebnis ist eine spürbar bessere Saugleistung am Absaugpunkt.

✅ Vorteile auf einen Blick

Mehr Saugleistung am Werkstück → effektive Span- und Stauberfassung

Optimierte Strömung → weniger Turbulenzen, stabilerer Luftstrom

Entlastet den Hauptsauger → bessere Effizienz, weniger Belastung

Universell einsetzbar → Frästisch, Kreissäge, Hobel, Bandsäge, Schleifmaschinen

Schutz für den Booster → Einbau nach dem Zyklon hält Späne fern

💡 Besonderheit
Der Trichter besitzt eine speziell berechnete Steigung, die den Luftstrom und den Druck ideal ausbalanciert. Dadurch arbeitet der Booster effizienter, und die Absaugung erreicht fast die Leistung eines doppelt so starken Saugers – bei deutlich geringerem Stromverbrauch und niedriger Lautstärke.

⚠️ Hinweis
Dieses Modell wurde speziell für den Aygrochy 150 mm Rohrventilator (ca. 595 m³/h, 50 W, 32 dB) entwickelt -> https://amzn.to/4gG1OKv . Die Geometrie und Steigung sind exakt auf dieses Modell abgestimmt, sodass die bestmögliche Leistung erzielt wird.

🎥 Mehr Infos im Video

In meinem YouTube-Video erkläre ich die Funktionsweise im Detail und zeige auch den Bau des Systems:
👉 Hier ansehen: https://youtu.be/54eGk4ERnKs?si=9bLMFyxSMZm2zaZg
details:
Dateiformat: STL, bereits korrekt ausgerichtet – direkt in den Slicer laden und drucken

Materialempfehlung:

Silk PLA (wie im Test gedruckt – optisch hochwertig, ausreichend stabil)

PETG (empfohlen für mehr Temperatur- und Schlagfestigkeit)

Druckeinstellungen:

Düsendurchmesser: 0,4 mm oder 0,6 mm möglich

Schichthöhe: 0,20 mm

Wandstärke: 3–4 Perimeter (≥1,2 mm)

name: K1 SE Enclosure Walls V5
description:
This is a personal project for creating a custom, Arduino monitored, enclosure system for the K1 SE. The aim is to reduce warping in ABS and other high temperature materials without buying the higher end K1 models. Arduino monitoring is not essential, but a potential add-on for individuals who just like being able to monitor and automate things. As I continue to iterate and develop parts for the enclosure, I will release new files for purchase and update existing ones. Once the enclosure developments cease, a full enclosure design will be uploaded as a single file.

Additional Materials:
---
1. I highly recommend using flue tape instead of plastic cement to seal the seams of the side walls as the gaps between the panels can vary greatly due to warping. If visuals are important to you, the flue tape can be installed on the interior, I prefer exterior.

https://youtu.be/jC0V9ksiIxo

Optional:
---
1. PLA may work for the side wall application, but I cannot guarantee that the walls will hold up to the potential temperature range of 50-70C. -  (I have confirmed PETG will survive up to 50C with ease.)
2. If you take the time to scale and print near perfect size parts, plastic cement could potentially be used. - (I didn't care as flue tape made it functional, even if it isn't pretty.)

Installation instructions:
---
1. Print all four sidewall parts. 2 bottom, 2 top per side, mirror 1 of each. - (use PVP glue to protect your build plate from the PETG.)
2. Remove support brackets in the corner and center of the printer side walls. - (Caution: My printer had stripped hex screws from the factory; removal may result in the destruction of a few screws depending on the quality of construction from the factory.)
3. Place the panels in position and screw them in using the same hardware from before.
4. Once all panels are screwed in, place flue tape along the seams of the panels for insulation.
5. If you are not using Arduino monitoring, cover the thermocouple hole in the side panels on each side or don't print the ALT version.

Celebrate the cozy side of the season with this set of seamless rollers inspired by autumn’s berry harvest. Elderberries, barberries, cranberries, and lingonberries come together in bold, high-contrast patterns that stamp a rich, abundant look into clay projects.
Each mini roller is 2.4" long (60mm) and 0.7" in diameter (17mm). They generate 52mm (2") wide seamless patterns. The files are easily scalable in slicer to at least 6". The designs are compatible with all home 3D printers, SLA and FDM.
details:

Nozzle: 0.2-0.4mm
Layer Height: 0.1 mm or less
Infill: 15-25%
Seam position - random
Perimeter generator - Arachne
Support: not required
Vertical shell perimeters - 1 (minimum)
Strong adhesion is needed to prevent separating, or/and use brims
Filament: PLA or PETG

name: MERCEDEZ BENZ 2624
description:
El Mercedes-Benz 2624 es un camión pesado de carga de la marca alemana, cuya numeración indica que tiene un peso bruto vehicular de aproximadamente 26 toneladas y una potencia de motor cercana a los 240 caballos de fuerza (caballos de fuerza). Se han producido y utilizado en diversas versiones, como camiones volquete y camiones chasis, e incluso en versiones militares por el Ejército Argentino, siendo un modelo robusto que continúa en servicio en varios países. 
Detalles del Mercedes-Benz 2624
Tipos de vehículos:
El 2624 se ha construido principalmente como camión de carga en diversas configuraciones, incluyendo volquetes (para transporte de materiales) y chasis (para montar diferentes carrocerías). 
Uso militar:
El modelo ha sido utilizado por el Ejército Argentino, lo que demuestra su robustez y capacidad para operar en condiciones exigentes, como se puede ver en publicaciones de Instagram y Instagram. 
Ejemplos de aplicación:
Se ha visto el Mercedes-Benz 2624 en versiones 6x4 (tres ejes con tracción en los dos traseros) y 6x6 (tres ejes con tracción en los tres), con diferentes distancias entre ejes, lo que permite adaptar el camión a distintas tareas. 
Durabilidad:
Es un vehículo conocido por su durabilidad y fiabilidad, ya que se sigue utilizando y encontrando en el mercado de segunda mano a pesar de los años de su fabricación, como se muestra en anuncios de Truck1 Paraguay y otras plataformas. 
Significado de la numeración:
En la nomenclatura de los camiones Mercedes-Benz, los dos primeros números (26) representan el peso bruto vehicular (PBV) en toneladas, mientras que los dos últimos (24) indican la potencia aproximada del motor en caballos de fuerza.

name: MILITARY RADIO
description:
A military radio is a portable or vehicle-mounted communication device that enables the armed forces to transmit and receive voice and data signals securely and reliably on the battlefield and during other operations, with advanced features such as encryption, resistance to adverse conditions, tracking of friendly forces, and high portability. 
Key Features:
Reliability and Durability:
They are designed to operate in harsh environments, withstanding dust, water, and impacts, where communication can be mission-critical. 
Security:
They use encryption to protect communications and prevent interception by the enemy. 
Networked communication:
They can create communication networks to share information, including Blue Force Tracking and situational awareness. 
Portability and flexibility:
There are portable (soldier-grade) models that allow soldiers to communicate over short and medium ranges, while vehicle-mounted or fixed versions can offer greater range and power. 
Advanced features:
Some military radios incorporate GPS for tracking and allow data transmission via Bluetooth or IP networks, expanding their capabilities beyond voice communication. 
Standardized protocols:
They operate under specific protocols that dictate communication rules within the armed forces to ensure the correct transmission of messages. 
Use:
Tactical coordination:
They enable direct communication between soldiers, units, and command to coordinate movements and actions in real time. 
Data transmission:
In addition to voice, they can transmit position data, intelligence, and other types of mission-relevant information. 
Situational awareness:
They help soldiers track the location and status of their comrades, improving coordination and safety.

name: OshKosh MTVR MK23
description:
El Oshkosh MTVR MK23 es un camión de carga de 7 toneladas y 6x6 diseñado para el Cuerpo de Marines de los Estados Unidos y otros usuarios militares. Pertenece a la familia de vehículos tácticos medianos de reemplazo (MTVR) de Oshkosh. El MK23 es una de las variantes del MTVR y se utiliza como camión de carga general. 
Más detalles sobre el MTVR MK23:
Capacidad de carga: Puede transportar hasta 7 toneladas (15,000 libras) en carretera y 7.1 toneladas (15,652 libras) fuera de ella. 
Movilidad: Diseñado para todo tipo de terreno, incluyendo carreteras, autopistas y terrenos accidentados. 
Tecnología TAK-4: Cuenta con la suspensión independiente TAK-4 de Oshkosh, que le permite superar obstáculos. 
Motor: Utiliza un motor Caterpillar C12 de 11.9 litros y 425 caballos de fuerza. 
Transmisión: Cuenta con una transmisión automática Allison. 
Versiones: Además del MK23, existen otras variantes como el MK25 (con cabrestante) y el MK27 (con distancia entre ejes extendida). 
Usos: Se utiliza para transportar personal, equipo y suministros. 
Durabilidad: Está diseñado para ser duradero y operar en condiciones climáticas difíciles. 
Transporte aéreo: Puede ser transportado por aire, por ejemplo, en aviones C-130 Hercules. 
Usuarios: Además del Cuerpo de Marines de EE. UU., otros usuarios incluyen Gran Bretaña y Grecia

details:
Características estructurales
Bloque macizo de 15–25 mm por mitad para resistencia y uso con prensa o tornillos.

Refuerzos laterales para evitar deformación en prensados largos.

Topes de alineación integrados para que las dos mitades encajen sin deslizamientos.

Manijas externas para fácil manipulación.

Canal de drenaje opcional para evitar exceso de pegamento.

Recomendaciones de impresión 3D
Tecnología: FDM o SLA (preferible resina o filamento de alta resistencia).

Material recomendado:

PLA+ (económico y suficiente para uso normal)

PETG o ABS (más resistencia térmica y mecánica)

Resina Tough o ABS-like (si es SLA)

Altura de capa: 0,2 mm o menor para mejor definición.

Relleno: 40–60 % (preferible en patrón cúbico o gyroid).

Perímetros: mínimo 4–5 paredes para rigidez.

Temperatura: según material (PLA+ ~205–215 °C, PETG ~235 °C, ABS ~245 °C).

Postprocesado: Lijar suavemente las superficies internas con lija fina (400–600) para acabado uniforme.

Recomendaciones de uso
Colocar entre 5–7 chapas de madera de 1 mm de espesor (arce recomendado).

Aplicar pegamento PVA o epoxi en capas uniformes.

Centrar las chapas en el molde y cerrar con la mitad superior.

Sujetar con prensa, sargentos o tornillos por al menos 8–12 horas.

Retirar, cortar el contorno y lijar.

name: MILITARY SABLE
description:
Historia:
El sable tiene una larga historia, particularmente asociada con la caballería desde el siglo XIX, aunque sus orígenes se remontan aún más atrás. 
Diseño:
A diferencia de las espadas rectas, la hoja curva del sable está pensada para cortar, lo que lo hacía efectivo para su uso a caballo. 
Simbolismo:
El sable es más que un arma; es un símbolo de rango, valentía y honor en el ámbito militar, especialmente en ceremonias y desfiles. 
Partes:
El sable militar suele tener una empuñadura, una hoja curva y, a menudo, una guarda o protección para la mano. 
Uso actual:
Aunque ya no se usa en combate, el sable sigue siendo una pieza clave del uniforme militar de gala, representando la tradición y el legado de las fuerzas armadas. 
Diferencia con la espada:
La principal diferencia con la espada es la hoja curva y el filo único del sable.

name: Counterfire radar AN/TPQ-53
description:
El AN/TPQ-53 es un radar de adquisición de objetivos de contrafuego, diseñado para detectar y rastrear armas de fuego indirectas enemigas, como morteros, artillería y cohetes, con el fin de proporcionar información precisa para la respuesta con fuego amigo. Es un sistema móvil y de reacción rápida, fabricado por Lockheed Martin. 
Características principales:
Detección y seguimiento:
El radar puede detectar y rastrear proyectiles en vuelo, así como determinar la ubicación de los puntos de disparo de las armas enemigas. 
Contrafuego:
Su función principal es proporcionar información precisa a las fuerzas amigas para que puedan responder con fuego de artillería o misiles y neutralizar las posiciones enemigas. 
Movilidad:
Es un sistema móvil que puede ser desplegado rápidamente en diferentes ubicaciones, transportado por camiones tácticos y aviones. 
Cobertura:
Ofrece una cobertura de 360 grados o de 90 grados, dependiendo de la configuración. 
Tipos de amenazas:
Puede detectar diferentes tipos de amenazas, incluyendo vehículos aéreos no tripulados (UAV) y drones, además de armas de fuego indirectas. 
Interoperabilidad:
Está diseñado para integrarse con otros sistemas de comando y control, lo que permite una mayor flexibilidad en el campo de batalla. 
En resumen, el AN/TPQ-53 es un radar avanzado que proporciona capacidades cruciales de contrafuego y conocimiento de la situación en el campo de batalla moderno.

name: GROUND MASTER 400 RADAR
description:
El Ground Master 400 es un sistema de radar de vigilancia aérea 3D de largo alcance, fabricado por Thales, diseñado para detectar y rastrear objetivos aéreos, incluyendo aviones, misiles de crucero y vehículos aéreos no tripulados (UAVs). Es un sistema móvil, totalmente digital, con matriz de escaneo electrónico, y ofrece capacidades de detección desde altitudes muy altas hasta muy bajas. 
Características principales del Ground Master 400:
Tecnología:
Radar 3D AESA (Antena de Barrido Electrónico) de estado sólido, totalmente digital, con banda S. 
Alcance:
Capaz de detectar cazas a 450 km y misiles de crucero o aeronaves pequeñas a 250 km. 
Movilidad:
Diseñado para ser desplegado rápidamente en camiones tácticos, transportable por avión C-130 o helicóptero. 
Configuración:
Puede ser configurado por una tripulación de cuatro hombres en 30 minutos y operado de forma remota. 
Cobertura:
Ofrece vigilancia aérea en 360 grados de azimut y 40 grados de elevación. 
Funcionalidades:
Incluye modos de funcionamiento digital, doble capacidad Doppler, capacidades de contramedidas electrónicas (ECCM) y capacidad de detección de misiles balísticos tácticos (TBM). 
Variantes:
La familia Ground Master 400 incluye los modelos GM 403 (portátil) y GM 406 (para instalaciones fijas, con mayor alcance). 
Nuevas versiones:
La versión GM400α incorpora mejoras como mayor potencia de procesamiento, alcance extendido y algoritmos de inteligencia artificial.

name: SAMP/T is a medium-range ground-based air defense system.
description:
El SAMP/T es un sistema de defensa aérea terrestre de medio alcance, desarrollado de forma conjunta por Francia e Italia, diseñado para proteger contra diversas amenazas aéreas, incluyendo aviones, misiles de crucero y misiles balísticos tácticos. Es un sistema móvil, lo que le permite proteger tanto campos de batalla como sitios tácticos sensibles. 
Componentes principales del sistema SAMP/T:
Radar multifunción Arabel:
Un radar de escaneo electrónico que proporciona detección, seguimiento de objetivos y guía inicial de los misiles Aster. 
Lanzadores verticales montados en camiones:
Llevan los misiles Aster y pueden disparar hasta ocho misiles en secuencia rápida. 
Misiles Aster 30:
Misiles tierra-aire de largo alcance que pueden interceptar objetivos a alta velocidad y altitud. 
Unidad de control de fuego:
Coordina los componentes del sistema y gestiona la interceptación de objetivos. 
Capacidades del sistema SAMP/T:
Alcance:
El sistema puede interceptar objetivos con un alcance de hasta 100 kilómetros y una altitud de hasta 20 kilómetros, según The Economic Times. 
Intercepción de misiles:
El sistema está diseñado para interceptar misiles balísticos tácticos y misiles de crucero. 
Protección de áreas:
El SAMP/T puede proteger áreas tácticas importantes, como aeropuertos, puertos marítimos, campos de batalla y sitios sensibles. 
Movilidad:
El sistema es móvil, lo que permite un despliegue rápido y flexible en diferentes ubicaciones. 
Interoperabilidad:
El SAMP/T es compatible con otros sistemas de defensa aérea de la OTAN, según Eurosam. 
En resumen, el SAMP/T es un sistema de defensa aérea de última generación que proporciona una protección efectiva contra una variedad de amenazas aéreas, incluyendo misiles balísticos y de crucero.

name: Elegoo 4 Beagle V2 camera mount with height adjustment
description:
I downloaded and tested a few camera mounts for my Elegoo 4 Max.
All of the mounts had one flaw that didn’t meet my needs:
I want to be able to remotely monitor my printer’s operation and intervene if necessary. But during fast prints, vibrations were visible in the image, and with taller projects, the print head simply moved out of the camera’s field of view; and with the camera positioned farther away, I could no longer tell if the print was still proceeding smoothly.

So I made a camera mount to attach to the “Z-axis.” I wanted it to be simple and straightforward.
Now the camera is positioned so that I can closely monitor the print, and the camera’s height always adjusts in parallel with the print head.
The mount consists of two parts and is glued together as shown in the picture. (In the picture, the glue is still curing.)

name: MERCEDEZ BENZ IVECO RENAULT ARMY TRUCK
description:
Un camión militar es un vehículo terrestre diseñado y equipado para transportar personal, equipos y suministros en operaciones militares. Estos camiones varían en tamaño, capacidad y características según su propósito específico, desde transporte general hasta tareas especializadas como ingeniería o logística. 
Tipos de camiones militares:
Camiones de transporte: Son los más comunes, diseñados para transportar tropas, carga general y equipo. 
Camiones de ingeniería: Equipados con herramientas y maquinaria para construcción, reparación de carreteras y puentes, y otras tareas de ingeniería. 
Camiones de logística: Diseñados para el transporte de suministros como alimentos, combustible y municiones. 
Camiones de recuperación: Equipados con grúas y herramientas para remolcar vehículos dañados o averiados. 
Camiones cisterna: Transportan líquidos como agua o combustible. 
Camiones blindados: Ofrecen protección adicional contra armas y explosiones. 
Características comunes:
Tracción:
Muchos camiones militares tienen tracción en todas las ruedas (4x4, 6x6, etc.) para facilitar la movilidad en terrenos difíciles. 
Capacidad de carga:
Varía ampliamente según el modelo, desde unos pocos cientos de kilogramos hasta varias toneladas. 
Protección:
Algunos camiones militares están equipados con blindaje para proteger a la tripulación contra disparos y explosiones. 
Equipamiento especializado:
Dependiendo del propósito, pueden incluir grúas, sistemas de comunicación, equipos de navegación, etc. 
Ejemplos de camiones militares:
Oshkosh FMTV:
Un camión militar multipropósito utilizado por el ejército estadounidense y otros países. 
M939:
Una serie de camiones militares de uso general, fabricados en diferentes variantes y utilizados para diversas aplicaciones. 
REO M35:
Un camión militar ligero utilizado por el ejército estadounidense durante la Guerra Fría. 
Camiones militares 4x4:
Una categoría que incluye varios modelos de diferentes fabricantes con tracción en las cuatro ruedas. 
En Argentina:
El Ejército Argentino ha incorporado camiones militares Oshkosh, así como otros modelos de camiones para diferentes tareas. Se han realizado capacitaciones para conductores y mecánicos en el uso y mantenimiento de estos vehículos.

name: Semi-Pro Spot Welder (for 18650 battery, 21700, etc...)
description:
💡 Why Get This Design?
This design is perfect for 3D printer builders, and hands-on makers who want a reliable and professional-looking spot welder built at workshop/home.

If you've ever built a 3D printer, upgraded a Creality, or assembled a CNC frame — this project will feel natural to you.
It’s also ideal for people who love functional DIY builds that not only work well, but look sharp on the workbench.
Unlike many random wood-plank welders, this one is engineered for precision, alignment, and sturdiness — and feels like a real machine.

⚠️ Warning – Electrical Safety
This project runs on AC 220V, and working with high current involves serious risks.
You should only attempt this if you have basic electrical knowledge and know how to handle power electronics.
Improper wiring can lead to shock, fire, or component failure — so, as always: Safety First!

🧰 What You Need Before Printing
Here's the full list of components required to build the machine:

🔌 1. Microwave Transformer (MOT)
Sourced from a used microwave oven

My build used a 1200W Electrolux MOT

Core size: 95mm x 65mm x 80mm

Primary coil removed and replaced with AWG 000 (3/0) copper wire (~10.4mm diameter)

Wound 3 turns, resulting in ~3.3V output

🧱 2. Insulation Base Plate
I used 15mm thick PVC

You can also use wood, plastic, or any insulating material available

This plate isolates the transformer from the metal frame

🔩 3. Mechanical Parts (Mostly from 3D Printer Hardware)
4× Smooth rods: ⌀8mm × 190mm

6× LM8UU linear bearings

1× Aluminum extrusion: 4020, length 100mm

2× Heatblock clones (E3D V6 MK3 style)

2× Cast corner brackets: for 2020 profile, or 1 for 4020

4× RC car suspension springs (90–100mm length)

I used cheap Tamiya 1/10 scale shocks

1× Reprap mechanical endstop switch (or equivalent)

Screws: M3, M5, M6 + nuts & washers

🧲 4. Electrical Contacts & Wiring
1× Copper rod for welding tips:

CuCrZr (C18150) or CuCr (C18200) – RWMA Class 2

Diameter: ⌀3mm

Length: 10mm, or 2× rods of 40–50mm

2× Flexible copper cables:

Gauge: 6–4 AWG

Length: 20–22cm

With copper lugs (hole 6–8mm)

2× Heavy-duty copper lugs for AWG 000 wire

Strongly recommended to use pure copper for best conductivity

🧠 5. Electronics & Spot Welder Controller
If you’re not familiar with making custom PCBs, I recommend using a ready-made spot welder control board, such as:

NY-D01 — widely available, easy to use

Works with BTA41-600B or BTA100-800B triacs

⚠️ Note: There are many clones/OEM versions of this board. In my experience, some cheaper versions tend to malfunction (timing issues, misfire, or stuck triac). So choose your board carefully and consider a trusted source.

📎 Further Documentation
All detailed measurements, diagrams, and wiring tips are included in the download package.
Print it, build it, and weld it — safely and efficiently.

Of course, this can also be done for the inch measurement system - at 100%, the measurement is 2.6 inches.

name: Weighted Glock 17 Magazine/Sirt110
description:
This magazine will fit any standard 9mm glock. Also works in SIRT training pistols. SIRT training pistols, as well as airsoft pistols, use slightly smaller magazines to ensure real ones can not be accidentally inserted. These have been run for multiple weeks in a training facility with no issues. Designed to be printed vertically and filled with standard .177 Daisy BBs and resin to replicate weight. If you don't elect to fill them, either modify it to be solid, or just use it as a light magazine. 
This was created as a cost effective and more durable option to SIRT pistol magazines. The spilt injection mold design tends to spilt apart and become enlarged as they are heavily used. Almost all of the original magazines at the facility are unusable after just 6 months. Replacement magazines range from $20-$30 a pop. Multiply that over 100 magazines, and a recurring purchase every 6 months, that adds up. This is an amazing alternative to save some money, as well as be a little more durable.
details:
Ideally print with ABS. Print vertically on the baseplate. Standard operation for ABS, raft, hot, enclosed printer, blah blah blah. 

With a 6000 pack of BBs I can fill about 18 magazines. I use about 0.25-0.5 ounces of resin to fill the cavity. I strongly suggest printing a funnel and staggering BBs and Resin until it is full(1/4 full with BBs, 1/4 full with resin, and so on) . This will ensure the cavity is completely full, weight is closer to a real magazine, and you don't hear a BB rattling around.
